description.zh: 绿史莱姆的专用技能。 跳向敌人发动攻击。
description.en: Green Slime's exclusive skill. Leaps toward the enemy and delivers an attack.

description.zh: 【泰拉瑞亚联动】 来自异世界的怪物。 在这里似乎可以将其驯服。
description.en: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间可高高跃起。
description.en: Can be ridden. Can jump high into the air while mounted.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成砂砾龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 身体如树汁一般，是一种非常不可思议的帕鲁。 如果失去了头顶的新芽，便会渐渐枯萎。 最终走向腐烂殆尽的结局。
description.en: A strange Pal with a body resembling tree sap. It gradually loses strength if it has nothing to cover its body with, eventually rotting away.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家伐木时造成的伤害将提升(30~50)%，所有木材种类的重量都将减轻(40~60)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, improves logging efficiency by (30~50)% and reduces weight of all types of wood by (40~60)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 棉悠悠的专用技能。 咕噜咕噜地滚动并追击敌人。 攻击后会因晕眩而无法动弹。
description.en: Lamball's exclusive skill. Curls into a ball, rolling after any enemies in its way. Becomes dizzy and unable to move after the attack ends.

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 赌上性命引发爆炸。 使用后会陷入无法战斗的状态。
description.en: Risks its life to cause a violent explosion. Becomes incapacitated afterwards.

description.zh: 发射雷电球 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires an electric ball that slowly pursues an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 它只要走在坡道上就肯定会跌倒并滚动起来。 而且还会因为眼冒金星而无法动弹， 非常容易被当做是猎物，是食物链的底层。
description.en: A walk up a hill tends to end with this Pal tumbling back down. This causes it to become dizzy and unable to move, making it easy to capture and kill. As a result, this Pal has tumbled down to the very bottom of the food chain itself.

description.zh: 发动后，它会化身为装备在玩家身上的盾牌。 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会掉落羊毛。 Lv.Item1
description.en: When activated, equips to the player and becomes a shield. Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch. Lv.Item1

description.zh: 捣蛋猫的专用技能。 挥舞双臂追击敌人， 连续挥出利拳。
description.en: Cattiva's exclusive skill. Chases after enemies, swinging both arms and delivering a flurry of punches.

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.
Attack -10%

description.zh: 它装出一副威风凛凛的样子，其实胆小软弱。 如果被捣蛋猫看不起， 某种意义上可谓奇耻大辱。
description.en: At a glance it appears full of confidence, but it is in fact weak and cowardly. Being toyed with by a Cattiva is in many ways the greatest of disgraces.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，捣蛋猫就会帮忙载运行李，玩家的负重上限将提高(100~200)。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, Cattiva helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity by (100~200). (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 皮皮鸡的专用技能。 瞄准并飞扑向敌人后，用尖喙突袭敌人。
description.en: Chikipi's exclusive skill. Flies at enemies in its sights, attacking them with its sharp beak.

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 赌上性命引发爆炸。 使用后会陷入无法战斗的状态。
description.en: Risks its life to cause a violent explosion. Becomes incapacitated afterwards.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成砂砾龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成炙热的龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two flaming tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 它非常弱小，却又非常美味。 与棉悠悠同样都是极为弱小的帕鲁。 但不论再怎么对这种帕鲁展开围猎，它们也还是会从某处冒出来。
description.en: Extremely weak and far too delicious. It is one of the weakest Pals alongside [[Lamball]]. No matter how many are hunted, they just keep appearing.

description.zh: 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会产下蛋。 Lv.Item1
description.en: Sometimes lays an Egg when assigned to Ranch. Lv.Item1

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 用地下尖锐的根部追击敌人 并从脚下贯穿敌人。
description.en: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 拥有等同于5至7岁儿童的智力。 虽然很适合作为伙伴，但也有不少的记录显示， 有些个体在学会使用武器后杀害了自己的主人。
description.en: Intelligent as a five to seven-year-old human child. It makes a wonderful partner, but there have been more than a few cases where they've killed their master after learning to use weapons.

description.zh: 发动后它会坐在玩家的头上，配合玩家的攻击用冲锋枪进行追击。
description.en: When activated, leaps on top of the player's head and uses a submachine gun to follow up the players attacks.

description.zh: 发射水弹 笔直飞向对方。
description.en: Hurls a ball of water straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 朝敌人发射高速水弹。
description.en: Hurls a high speed ball of water at an enemy.

description.zh: 在上空生成尖锐的冰柱 瞄准敌人后发射冰柱。
description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.zh: 发射大量泡沫 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大水球 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of water and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 猛烈地释放出水流 并向前方大范围横扫。
description.en: Shoots pressurized water at extreme velocities, sweeping over a wide area in front of it.

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh: 它产生的水可在任何地方形成波浪。 在事态紧急时可用身体冲浪形式移动。 但经常因为势头过猛，而发生撞墙而死的惨剧。
description.en: Using its own body water, this Pal can create waves anywhere. It body surfs when in a hurry, but the resulting speed often ends in a fatal collision.

description.zh: 发动后，冲浪鸭会乘着浪头冲向敌人。 levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, Fuack body surfs towards an enemy and slams into them. levelvalue1

description.zh: 瞄准后发射可笔直飞向敌人 的火焰弹。
description.en: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 发射大量泡沫 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 面向敌人释放火焰， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Shoots flames at an enemy, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 在敌人的位置燃起火焰之墙。 火墙将持续一段时间， 对碰到的敌人造成伤害。
description.en: Creates a wall of flames at the enemy's location. The wall of flames will remain for a while, and deal damage to the enemies it touches.

description.zh: 用压缩水流一扫前方。 被扫过的区域会在片刻后喷出水柱。
description.en: Mows down the frontal area with a blast of compressed water. The area struck by the blast erupts with water after a short delay.

description.zh: 向上空喷射无数熔岩弹。 一段时间后，射出的熔岩弹将如雨一般散落在周围。
description.en: Fires countless volcanic bombs into the sky. After a while, the bombs rain down around their originator.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 腹部的摩擦系数很高， 身体冲浪时会产生火花。 经常因为势头过猛，从而变成一团火球。
description.en:
With a belly built for friction, this pal sparks flames as it body surfs.
But when it gets carried away, it often ends up a rolling fireball.

description.zh: 发动后，热浪鸭会乘着焰浪冲向敌人。 levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, Fuack Ignis fire surfs towards an enemy and slams into them. levelvalue1

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。

description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 帕洛斯群岛的偶像。 胆敢欺负玉藻狐的人， 会在转眼间成为全民公敌。
description.en: The idol of Palpagos Island. If you bully a Vixy, you best be prepared to become enemies with the whole world.

description.zh: 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会从地里挖出道具。 Lv.Item1
description.en: Sometimes digs up items from the ground when assigned to Ranch. Lv.Item1

description.zh: 朝敌人发射高速水弹。
description.en: Hurls a high speed ball of water at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射水弹 笔直飞向对方。
description.en: Hurls a ball of water straight at an enemy.

description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.en: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.en: Shoots pressurized water at extreme velocities, sweeping over a wide area in front of it.

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh: 它会乘着风任其带它翱翔四方。 只要在旅途中找到命中之人， 就会结束自己的旅程。
description.en: Riding the wind, this Pal travels where it pleases. Should it find a partner along the way, the encounter will mark its journey's end.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，会改变滑翔伞的性能，并使玩家免受坠落伤害。 滑翔期间能够长时间快速移动。
description.en: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Prevents fall damage and extends the duration of high-speed gliding.

description.zh: 向敌人发射高速直线飞行的雷枪。
description.en: Fires a high-speed lightning spear straight ahead towards the enemy.

description.zh: 快速放电 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

description.zh: 发射大量泡沫 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 生成可笔直前进的雷击。
description.en: Generates a lightning bolt that moves forward in a line.

description.zh: 召唤一束直线前进的水柱。
description.en: Generates a column of water that travels in a straight line.

description.zh: 向前方发射高压水流。 片刻后，水流会向左右分岔。
description.en: Fires a high-pressure stream of water forward. After a short delay, the stream branches off to the left and right.

description.zh: 积蓄雷电之力 瞄准敌人释放强劲电击。
description.en: Charges electric energy before blasting enemies with a powerful shock.

description.zh: 召唤巨大的雷属性龙卷风。 龙卷风将追踪敌人缓慢移动。
description.en: Generates a huge tornado of lightning that moves slowly towards the enemy.

description.zh: 鲜艳的外表能帮助它找到命中之人。 自古以来，就有因为雷米儿而触电的事故。 现今的岛上，黄黑相间的纹理被认作危险的颜色。
description.en: Its flashy patterns help it attract a partner. But after a long history of electrocution incidents involving Celaray Lux, yellow-and-black stripes are now seen across the island as a sign of danger.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，会改变滑翔伞的性能，并使玩家免受坠落伤害。 滑翔期间能够长时间快速移动。
description.en: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Prevents fall damage and extends the duration of high-speed gliding.

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的雷电球。
description.en: Releases lightning orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 快速放电 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 积蓄雷电之力 瞄准敌人释放强劲电击。
description.en: Charges electric energy before blasting enemies with a powerful shock.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 与棉悠悠相较，这种帕鲁的毛质更加优良， 个性也更适合作为家畜。 但历史上这种帕鲁总是被当成宠物。 毕竟可爱就是正义。
description.en:
Compared to [[Lamball]], it has finer wool and a temperament more suited for domestication.
However, it has historically always been kept as a pet.
Cuteness is considered a virtue.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，无属性帕鲁的攻击力会提升(15~30)%。（不可叠加） 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会掉落羊毛。 levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases Attack of Neutral Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch. levelvalue1

description.zh: 发射水弹 笔直飞向对方。
description.en: Hurls a ball of water straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射大量泡沫 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 生成酸性云朵 在敌人头上下酸雨。
description.en: Creates acidic clouds that pour down acid rain on enemies.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大水球 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of water and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 召唤一束直线前进的水柱。
description.en: Generates a column of water that travels in a straight line.

description.zh: 连续在敌人的脚下生成水柱结成的墙壁。
description.en: Continously creates walls made from water columns at the enemy's location.

description.zh: 猛烈地释放出水流 并向前方大范围横扫。
description.en: Shoots pressurized water at extreme velocities, sweeping over a wide area in front of it.

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh: 族群中犯下大错的个体会被逼迫自裁。 用树枝刺穿自己那膨胀到极限的鸣囊， 就会像泄气的气球一样飞向大气圈的远方，魂归天国。
description.en: Those who disgrace the honor of the herd are forced to take their own life. By piercing their inflated vocal sac with a tree branch, they are blown away into the atmosphere and return to the afterlife.

description.zh: 发动后，武道蛙会靠忠诚心和膨胀的腹部积蓄力量。玩家在踩上去后能高高跳起。 在落地前，玩家的攻击力提升(50~86)%。 levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, Croajiro channels its loyalty and puffs up its abdomen to store energy. Climbing on top will propel the player high into the air. While airborne, the player's Attack is increased by (50~86)%. levelvalue1

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射逐渐加速的黑暗能量弹
description.en: Fires a dark energy projectile that accelerates over time.

description.zh: 使用暗之力连续发射数支高速箭追击敌人。
description.en: Fires off dark energy that homes in on an enemy.

description.zh: 生成酸性云朵 在敌人头上下酸雨。
description.en: Creates acidic clouds that pour down acid rain on enemies.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 用压缩水流一扫前方。 被扫过的区域会在片刻后喷出水柱。
description.en: Mows down the frontal area with a blast of compressed water. The area struck by the blast erupts with water after a short delay.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 抛弃荣誉的武道蛙聚集在一起，衍生出的分支族群。 不论用上多么下作的手段也要狩猎掉盯上的猎物。 如果在午夜遇到了一群极道蛙， 那魂归天国的就是这边了。
description.en: The {{p|Croajiro

description.zh: 发动后，极道蛙会靠忠诚心和膨胀的腹部积蓄力量。玩家在踩上去后能高高跳起。 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁以暗属性攻击克制的属性时伤害提升(25~40)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, Croajiro Noct channels its loyalty and puffs up its abdomen to store energy. Climbing on top will propel the player high into the air. While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals' Dark attacks when hitting the enemy's elemental weakness by (25~40)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 扇形发射锋利的气刃。
description.en: Sends out sharp blades of air in a fan shape.

description.zh: 达鼠泥的专用技能。 短暂蓄力后高速撞击敌人， 同时做出后空翻动作。
description.en: Herbil's exclusive skill. After a brief moment of preparation, charges at the enemy at high speed, finishing with a flip.

description.zh: 发射风刃， 在击中敌人或树木时反弹并连续造成攻击， 最多可反弹4次。
description.en: Launches a blade of wind that rebounds off enemies or trees, striking repeatedly. Can ricochet up to four times.

description.zh: 在敌人前方生成风刃， 并对其发动十字斩击。
description.en: Conjures blades of wind in front of the enemy, converging to deliver a cutting cross attack.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 在达鼠泥看来，坏了的东西只要捶一下就好了。 而它的力道掌控，对人类而言堪称完美。 只要被其捶一下，停止跳动的心脏就能顺利起搏。
description.en:
When in doubt, punch it till it works—that’s Herbil's approach to fixing things.
With strength perfectly tuned for humans, sometimes just one punch is enough to restart a stopped heart.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，达鼠泥会在玩家陷入濒死状态时，通过疗愈能力让玩家以最大HP(30~60)%的状态复活。
description.en: While in party, Herbil uses its healing powers to restore (30~60)% of the player's Max Health when incapacitated.

description.zh: 发射水弹 笔直飞向对方。
description.en: Hurls a ball of water straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 朝敌人发射高速水弹。
description.en: Hurls a high speed ball of water at an enemy.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射大量泡沫 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 生成酸性云朵 在敌人头上下酸雨。
description.en: Creates acidic clouds that pour down acid rain on enemies.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大水球 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of water and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 猛烈地释放出水流 并向前方大范围横扫。
description.en: Shoots pressurized water at extreme velocities, sweeping over a wide area in front of it.

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh: 它那被认为是鼻子的器官会喷出大量的水。 虽然也有人指出那只是鼻涕罢了， 但是研究者们仍然为此进行了热烈的讨论。
description.en: Large amounts of water pour from what is thought to be its nose, though some say that it is, in fact, just snot. This has sparked a fierce debate among Pal scholars.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，若玩家的生命值低于30%，恢复(20~40)%的生命值。（不可叠加） ※发动后需120秒冷却方可再次触发 levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, restores (20~40)% of the player's Health when Health falls below 30%. (Does not stack) (120-second cooldown after activation) levelvalue1

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成砂砾龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 身体如树汁一般，是一种非常不可思议的帕鲁。 如果失去了头顶的新芽，便会渐渐枯萎。 最终走向腐烂殆尽的结局。
description.en: A strange Pal with a body resembling tree sap. It gradually loses strength if it has nothing to cover its body with, eventually rotting away.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家伐木时造成的伤害将提升(30~50)%，所有木材种类的重量都将减轻(40~60)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, improves logging efficiency by (30~50)% and reduces weight of all types of wood by (40~60)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 互相紧盯然后拔刀一闪，这便是宗铭丸间的领地争夺。 说起来，最好不要训练被饲养的个体「等下」命令， 它会无法忍耐接到「好」的命令之后，发自本能的拔刀行为。
description.en: Pupperai territorial disputes begin with a staredown and end in a single, quick strike. Training them to |stay| is risky business, as the |go| command triggers that same attack instinct.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家使用近战武器时的伤害提升(10~35)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases the player's melee weapon damage by (10~35)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 曾经存在过额头上的叶子有3片以上的个体， 但是因为被当作了幸运的象征，叶片多的个体被滥捕， 最终导致整个种族开始向着叶片数量少的方向进化了。
description.en: Some individuals once had three or more leaves on their foreheads. Regarded as symbols of good fortune, those with more leaves were heavily hunted, leading the species to evolve fewer leaves over time.

description.zh: 若它在据点里，其他据点帕鲁的采集工作适应性等级+1。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While at a base, increases the Gathering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 快速放电 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 发射雷电球 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires an electric ball that slowly pursues an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 在敌人头上生成3次落雷。
description.en: Generates lightning that strikes an enemy three times from above.

description.zh: 生成可笔直前进的雷击。
description.en: Generates a lightning bolt that moves forward in a line.

description.zh: 积蓄雷电之力 瞄准敌人释放强劲电击。
description.en: Charges electric energy before blasting enemies with a powerful shock.

description.zh: 它在受到冲击后会释放储存的电力。 它的电压超过1000万伏特。 将它扔出去的话，威力比普通的重型炮弹危险得多。
description.en:
It releases the electricity stored in its body when under attack.
The voltage it generates exceeds 10 million volts, making it more lethal than any conventional heavy firearms when thrown.

description.zh: 发动后就能将电棘鼠装备在手上，若将它投向敌人且命中目标，便会引发雷属性爆炸。
description.en: When activated, equips Jolthog to the player to be thrown at an enemy, causing an Electric explosion upon impact.

description.zh: 在上空生成尖锐的冰柱 瞄准敌人后发射冰柱。
description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的冰刃。
description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 朝敌人喷出冰冷空气， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 它在受到冲击后会释放储存的冷气。 它发射的冷气呈放射状，可冻结大气。 攻击它的对象会被击穿身体。
description.en:
It releases the cold air stored in its body when under attack.
The frigid blast it radiates is cold enough to freeze the surrounding air and easily pierces through any attacker's body.

description.zh: 发动后就能将冰刺鼠装备在手上，若将它投向敌人且命中目标，便会引发冰属性爆炸。
description.en: When activated, equips Jolthog Cryst to the player to be thrown at an enemy, causing an Ice explosion upon impact.

description.en: It has few friends because of the perpetually grouchy look on its face, but it is in fact kindhearted. Some have seen it feeding [[Vixy]] who have strayed from their pack.

description.zh: 发动后，瞅什魔会大量饮用能量饮料，瞅什魔的移动速度和工作速度会因此提升(100~900)%。 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会掉落毒腺。 Lv.Skill1
description.en: When activated, Depresso chugs an entire energy drink, increasing its Movement Speed and Work Speed by (100~900)%. Sometimes drops Venom Gland when assigned to Ranch. Lv.Skill1

description.en: The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, but sadly, its desire to fly has remained as strong as ever. Even now, it tries to fly again in any way it can.

description.zh: 发动后玩家将装备火箭发射器，并可将企丸丸当作炮弹射出。 命中目标后企丸丸会爆炸，并陷入濒死状态。
description.en: When activated, the player equips a Rocket Launcher and fires Pengullet as ammunition. Pengullet explodes on contact and is incapacitated.

description.en: Fires a high-speed lightning spear straight ahead towards the enemy.

description.zh: 同时发射直线飞行的高速雷球， 和追踪敌人的慢速雷球。
description.en: A high-speed lightning ball that flies in a straight line. Simultaneously fires slow lightning balls that track the enemy.

description.zh: 让自己化作避雷针引来雷电， 并在原地引发闪电爆炸。
description.en: Acts as a lightning rod, calling down thunderbolts that electrocute the surrounding area.

description.zh: 召唤巨大的雷属性龙卷风。 龙卷风将追踪敌人缓慢移动。
description.en: Generates a huge tornado of lightning that moves slowly towards the enemy.

description.zh: 它的翅膀已完全退化，无法飞翔。 对天空的向往逐渐变成嫉妒 为了击落天空中会飞的家伙，得到了雷电的力量！
description.en:
The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, and it can no longer fly.
Yet its longing for the sky has turned to jealousy— so it harnessed electricity to strike down those who still soar.

description.zh: 发动后玩家将装备火箭发射器，并可将闪丸丸当作炮弹射出。 命中目标后闪丸丸会爆炸，并陷入濒死状态。
description.en: When activated, the player equips a Rocket Launcher to fire Pengullet Lux as ammunition. Pengullet Lux explodes on impact and is incapacitated.

description.zh: 其实它与企丸丸是毫无关系的物种。 但因为什么都不做就能获得大家的追捧， 所以就努力摆出一副高傲的态度。
description.en:
Surprisingly, it is unrelated to [[Pengullet]].
However, since this Pal gets pampered as it pleases, for now, it's doing its best to strut arrogantly.

description.en: While in party, Fire Pals drop (40~80)% more items when defeated. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.en:
Its body changed color after gaining electricity to improve underwater hunting.
As a result, it lost the affection of {{p|Pengullet

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成砂砾龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 这类帕鲁经常会陷入沉思， 且会因过度思考而失眠。 「我思故我在」。
description.en: ''Often lost in thought, it sometimes finds it difficult to sleep. "I think, therefore I am."'

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，暗属性帕鲁的攻击力会提升(15~30)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases Attack of Dark Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 美露帕的专用技能。 散发出可爱的气场并朝向前方冲刺。
description.en: Melpaca's exclusive skill. Charges forward while surrounded by an adorable aura.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 快速放电 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 可别被它那毛茸茸的外表给骗了。 若挨下由它那双长腿甩出的一记超高速踢击， 整个人可是会飞到地球的另一端。
description.en: Don't be fooled by this Pal's fluffy appearance. A hypersonic kick from one of its long legs may send you flying to the other side of the world.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，君王美露帕的防御力和移动速度将会提升。 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会掉落羊毛。
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, increases Kingpaca's Defense and Movement Speed. Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 君王美露帕及亚种的专用技能。 向上高高跳起后， 用丰满的庞大身躯辗压敌人。
description.en: Kingpaca's exclusive skill. Leaps high into the air before smashing into an enemy with its chubby, massive body.

description.zh: 在敌人头上生成3次落雷。
description.en: Generates lightning that strikes an enemy three times from above.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的岩石长矛。
description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh:
防御力+20%
免疫击退
description.en:
Defense +20%
Immune to Knockback

description.zh: 统领着美露帕们。 君王美露帕之间的决斗，会以族群的统治权为赌注。 孤身一只的个体就是输家。
description.en: Melpaca serve this Pal. Contests between Kingpaca offer up their vassals as a wager. Those seen alone are losers of such contests.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 此帕鲁的防御力和移动速度会按照队伍中美露帕的数量提升，每只增加(5~14)%。
description.en: Can be ridden. This Pal's Defense and Movement Speed increase by (5~14)% for each Melpaca in party.

description.zh: 在上空生成尖锐的冰柱 瞄准敌人后发射冰柱。
description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的冰刃。
description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.zh: 君王美露帕及亚种的专用技能。 向上高高跳起后， 用丰满的庞大身躯辗压敌人。
description.en: Kingpaca's exclusive skill. Leaps high into the air before smashing into an enemy with its chubby, massive body.

description.zh: 朝敌人喷出冰冷空气， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大水球 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of water and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 冰帝美露帕的专用技能。 向上高高跳起后， 用自身庞大的身躯及冰晶辗压敌人。
description.en: Kingpaca Cryst's exclusive skill. Leaps high into the air before smashing into an enemy with ice and its chubby, massive body.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh:
防御力+20%
免疫击退
description.en:
Defense +20%
Immune to Knockback

description.zh: 这种帕鲁性格冷淡，不擅长表达情感。 这个孤独的个体对美露帕来说没有什么价值，简直是个悲剧。
description.en: With a heart of ice, this Pal is terrible at expressing its emotions. A solitary individual is pitiable, seen as too clumsy in the eyes of a Melpaca.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 此帕鲁的防御力和移动速度会按照队伍中美露帕的数量提升，每只增加(5~14)%。
description.en: Can be ridden. This Pal's Defense and Movement Speed increase by (5~14)% for each Melpaca in party.

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.zh: 快速释放黑暗之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 朝敌人喷出冰冷空气， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 它可以使心仪的对象陷入熟睡当中， 并使对方永远做着幸福的美梦。 直到死亡来临之前都不会醒来。
description.en: It puts those it is interested in to sleep and shows them an endless stream of happy dreams. Those who fall under its spell are never to wake until death takes them.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，就会出现于玩家身边。 它会用暗属性的魔弹追击敌对个体。 且该追击不会使猎物毙命。
description.en: While in party, appears near the player. Attacks hostile enemies with Dark magic bullets. These bullets will not reduce the target's Health below 1.

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 将岩石从眼前的地上吸附起来 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 在古时这种帕鲁会使用树枝等细长状的物品作为武器。 但在它们与人类频繁接触后，便不再使用这些物品。 因为它们发现了同样细长，却更为高效的「枪械」。
description.en: Long ago, this Pal used long objects like tree branches as weapons. After coming into contact with humans, however, it found something slightly more effective: guns.

description.zh: 发动后，新叶猿会在一定时间内用突击步枪猛烈扫射附近的敌人。
description.en: When activated, Tanzee will mercilessly fire an assault rifle at nearby enemies for a limited time.

description.zh: 瞄准后发射可笔直飞向敌人 的火焰弹。
description.en: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 连续发射3支高速火箭 并追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three flaming arrows in succession that home in on an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人的位置燃起火焰之墙。 火墙将持续一段时间， 对碰到的敌人造成伤害。
description.en: Creates a wall of flames at the enemy's location. The wall of flames will remain for a while, and deal damage to the enemies it touches.

description.zh: 使用火焰的力量做出复数个球体， 然后向敌人发射无数火球。
description.en: Creates multiple spheres of fiery energy, from which countless fireballs shoot towards the enemy.

description.zh: 向上空喷射无数熔岩弹。 一段时间后，射出的熔岩弹将如雨一般散落在周围。
description.en: Fires countless volcanic bombs into the sky. After a while, the bombs rain down around their originator.

description.zh: 使敌人周围地面活性化， 并在一定时间后爆炸。
description.en: Infuses the surrounding ground with energy, causing it to explode after a set amount of time.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 手掌部位得到了进化， 能够握住烧红的物品而不被烫伤。 若是把子弹打光了，说不定能够握住高温的枪管， 然后抡起枪身揍人。
description.en: Its palms have evolved to handle burning objects without getting scorched. When its gun runs out of ammo, it may grab the heated barrel with its bare hands and use it to club its foes.

description.zh: 发动后，秋叶猿会在一定时间内以火属性突击步枪猛烈扫射附近的敌人。
description.en: When activated, Tanzee Ignis will mercilessly fire a Fire assault rifle at nearby enemies for a limited time.

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 如果在夜路上发现了露娜蒂的毛， 最好不要將它捡起，而是直接原路返回。 因为那是通往无尽黑夜的单程票。
description.en: If you find Nox hair in your bedding, you should leave it where it lays and leave immediately. Picking it up is a one-way-ticket to a never ending night.

description.zh: 发动后，它会探测附近的帕鲁雕像。 Lv.RangeExtend Range per Sec 11500030002160003500318000400042100045005250005000 levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, detects the location of nearby Pal Effigies. Lv.RangeExtend Range per Sec 11500030002160003500318000400042100045005250005000 levelvalue1

description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 这种帕鲁哭泣时流的不是眼泪，而是岩浆。 而这些岩浆更会被身体吸收，使它的躯体越来越炎热。 换言之，流过的眼泪越多，它就越强。
description.en: When it starts crying, this Pal produces magma in place of tears. The magma that pours out is absorbed back into its body, causing it to get hotter and hotter. The more it cries, the stronger it becomes.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，非战斗时每秒令玩家与队伍帕鲁的生命值恢复(0.1~0.5)%。（不可叠加） 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会掉落喷火器官。 levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, recovers Health of the player and Party Pals by (0.1~0.5)% per second outside of combat. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch. levelvalue1

description.en: Wild Rooby surprisingly never gets sick. Eating one piece of charcoal a day, made by burning a branch, is the secret to its eternal health.

description.zh: 它尾部的硬化组织即使割下后也不会发生劣化。 人们迷信它的尾部能够招来财运， 导致许多喵丝特因此殒命。
description.en:
Its hard tail does not deteriorate even when cut off.
Some believed these severed tails bring good luck, but for the innumerable Mau who were poached as a result, they were anything but.

description.zh: 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会从地里挖出金币。 Lv.Item1
description.en: Sometimes digs up Gold Coin when assigned to Ranch. Lv.Item1

description.en:
Its crystalline tail is beautiful, but shatters when this Pal dies.
Some believe it is good luck to raise them, so Mau Cryst in captivity are treated with great care.

description.zh: 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会掉落结冰器官。 Lv.Item1
description.en: Sometimes drops Ice Organ when assigned to Ranch. Lv.Item1

description.zh: 草莽猪的专用技能。 瞄准敌人后，猛烈地冲向敌人。
description.en: Rushoar's exclusive skill. Takes aim at a foe and rushes at them with a fierce charge.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的岩石长矛。
description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 它十分好战，会在弄清双方力量差距前挑事。 虽然身材娇小，但拥有惊人的冲锋威力， 甚至能弹飞巨大岩石。
description.en:
Being an extremely aggressive Pal, it often picks fights before gauging its opponents' strength.
Though small, its powerful charge can even send boulders flying.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间破坏岩石的效率将提升(500~2000)%。
description.en: Can be ridden. While mounted, increases efficiency of destroying Stone by (500~2000)%.

description.zh: 瞄准后发射可笔直飞向敌人 的火焰弹。
description.en: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 连续发射3支高速火箭 并追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three flaming arrows in succession that home in on an enemy.

description.zh: 面向敌人释放火焰， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Shoots flames at an enemy, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 召唤大量小陨石 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Summons numerous small meteorites and launches them at an enemy.

description.zh: 它刚出生时无法很好地操纵火焰， 动不动就不小心喷出火焰，结果呛到自己。 火绒狐的喷嚏会引起森林火灾。
description.en: It is unskilled at controlling fire from the moment it is born and tends to choke on the flames it breathes unintentionally. Foxparks sneezes are one of the leading causes of forest fires.

description.zh: 发动后，它会化身为装备在玩家身上的火焰喷射器。
description.en: When activated, equips to the player and transforms into a flamethrower.

description.zh: 在上空生成尖锐的冰柱 瞄准敌人后发射冰柱。
description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.zh: 朝敌人发射高速水弹。
description.en: Hurls a high speed ball of water at an enemy.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的冰刃。
description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.zh: 朝敌人喷出冰冷空气， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 在空中生成复数个冰锥， 瞄准敌人一齐射出。
description.en: Generates multiple sharp ice blocks in the sky and fires them at the enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 它刚出生时无法很好地操纵冷气 动不动就不小心喷出冷气，结果噎住自己。 感冒时鼻涕会结冰，导致呼吸困难，手足无措。
description.en: It is unskilled at controlling cold air from the moment it is born and tends to choke on the frost it breathes unintentionally. When Foxparks Cryst catches a cold, its nasal discharge freezes, making it difficult to breathe and causing it to panic.

description.zh: 发动后，它会化身为装备在玩家身上的冷冻喷射器。
description.en: When activated, equips to the player and attacks using frigid air.

description.zh: 朝敌人发射高速水弹。
description.en: Hurls a high speed ball of water at an enemy.

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.zh: 快速释放黑暗之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 生成酸性云朵 在敌人头上下酸雨。
description.en: Creates acidic clouds that pour down acid rain on enemies.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 它会咬住敌人的脖子，将对方身体吸干。 帕鲁木乃伊极为罕见， 而它们基本上都是勾魂鱿的牺牲品。
description.en:
It wraps itself around an enemy's head, sucking out their insides.
Pal mummies are occasionally found, but these are in fact Killamari victims.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，会改变滑翔伞的性能。 滑翔期间能够长时间漂浮在空中。
description.en: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables gentle floating while gliding for an extended time.

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 发射大量泡沫 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 生成酸性云朵 在敌人头上下酸雨。
description.en: Creates acidic clouds that pour down acid rain on enemies.

description.zh: 向前方发射高压水流。 片刻后，水流会向左右分岔。
description.en: Fires a high-pressure stream of water forward. After a short delay, the stream branches off to the left and right.

description.zh: 猛烈地释放出水流 并向前方大范围横扫。
description.en: Shoots pressurized water at extreme velocities, sweeping over a wide area in front of it.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 它会咬住敌人的脖子，将对方浑身血液吸干。 蚀魂鱿同族之间互相咬住的话， 因为双方都想要将对手吸干， 在任意一方被榨干之前，彼此将无法分开。
description.en:
It sinks its fangs into the enemy’s neck, draining every last drop of blood.
When two Killamari Primos latch onto each other, they become locked in a relentless struggle—each trying to suck the other dry until one withers away.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，会改变滑翔伞的性能。 滑翔期间能够长时间漂浮在空中。
description.en: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables gentle floating while gliding for an extended time.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 遁地鼠的专用技能。 潜入地下，从脚下猛然窜出突袭敌人。
description.en: Fuddler's exclusive skill. Burrows underground and bursts out from beneath enemies.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 将岩石从眼前的地上吸附起来 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成砂砾龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的岩石长矛。
description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 它的巨大爪子的硬度宛如钻石般坚固。 因为磨爪子需要消耗不少能量， 所以有时候等它磨完爪子，一天就过去了。
description.en: Its large claws boast of diamond-like hardness. However, sharpening these claws consumes most of its energy, leading it to sometimes spending entire days doing nothing else.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家采矿时造成的伤害将提升(30~60)%，石头的重量将减轻(80~100)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, improves player mining efficiency by (30~60)% and reduces Stone weight by (80~100)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 紫霞鹿及亚种的专用技能。 面向敌人冲刺，扬起尖角攻击敌人。 如在骑乘时发动，可操控前进方向。
description.en: Eikthyrdeer's exclusive skill. Charges at foes and uses antlers to launch them into the air. When used while riding, the direction of the charge can be controlled.

description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 拥有最富有力量感的双角的个体，会成为这种帕鲁的领袖。 犄角断裂时，内心也会大受打击。 这时候它就会默默离开族群，在远离人烟的地方结束一生。
description.en: The one who possesses the most impressive antlers becomes the leader of the herd. If their antlers are broken, they become depressed and leave the herd never to be seen again.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间可以进行2段跳跃，破坏树木的效率也会提升(220~500)%。
description.en: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted and increases lumbering efficiency by (220~500)%.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 紫霞鹿及亚种的专用技能。 面向敌人冲刺，扬起尖角攻击敌人。 如在骑乘时发动，可操控前进方向。
description.en: Eikthyrdeer's exclusive skill. Charges at foes and uses antlers to launch them into the air. When used while riding, the direction of the charge can be controlled.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 祇岳鹿的专用技能。 面向敌人冲刺，用尖角卷起泥土攻击敌人。 如在骑乘时发动，可操控前进方向。
description.en: Eikthyrdeer Terra's exclusive skill. Charges at foes and uses its antlers to whip mud at them. When used while riding, the direction of the charge can be controlled.

description.zh: 将岩石从眼前的地上吸附起来 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.en: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的岩石长矛。
description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 拥有最坚硬双角的个体，会成为这种帕鲁的领袖。 一旦失去了角，它的领袖地位也将不复存在。 这时候它只能在同伴的目送下离开，悄然回归尘土。
description.en: The individual with the hardest horns becomes the leader. Once the horns are lost, so too is its leadership status. It leaves the herd amidst farewell glances and quietly returns to the earth.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间可以进行2段跳跃。 若它在据点里，其他据点帕鲁的伐木工作适应性等级+1。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. While at a base, increases the Lumbering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 快速连续向敌人进行啃咬攻击。
description.en: Launches a rapid succession of bites at the enemy.

description.zh: 快速地向敌人飞扑，咬住敌人进行攻击。
description.en: Swiftly leaps at an enemy and bites into them.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 猎狼与人类之间的关联早已淡化， 但过去与人类共同狩猎的模式， 构成了它们如今的狩猎体系。
description.en: Long ago Direhowl would hunt alongside humans but over the years this bond faded.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间的移动速度会稍微变快一点。
description.en: Can be ridden. Moves slightly faster than most mounts.

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 用地下尖锐的根部追击敌人 并从脚下贯穿敌人。
description.en: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 只要它肚子不饿，它背上的草丛就会结出野莓。 若它遇见中意的对象，它会请对方吃掉自己的野莓， 抓住了对方的胃，就诞生了一对新的伴侣。
description.en: The shrub on this pal's back produces berries as long as it is properly fed. It offers these berries to potential mates, and if the flavor is to their liking, romance blossoms.

description.zh: 将它分派到家畜牧场，就有机会从背上掉落红色野莓。 若它在队伍中，每5分钟会让当前饱腹度最低的帕鲁恢复(100~200)点饱腹度。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: Sometimes drops Red Berries from its back when assigned to Ranch. While in party, restores (100~200) Pal's Hunger to the Pal with the lowest Hunger every 5 minutes. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 于前方制造毒雾， 使目标陷入中毒状态。
description.en: Generates a fog of poison in front, causing the opponent to become poisoned.

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.zh: 瞄准敌人发射 3发直线飞行的超高速风刃。
description.en: The user fires three high-speed blades of wind in quick succession that fly straight at enemies.

description.zh: 使出浑身力量 向各个方向喷洒毒球。
description.en: Focuses energy into the body and scatters poison orbs in all directions.

description.zh: 在敌人的位置和其周围刺出尖锐的根刺。
description.en: Sprouts sharp roots in and around the enemy's location.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 它背上的灌木结出的果实，会根据其精神状态改变味道。 越是在恶劣的环境下生长，味道就会越来越甜 所以被饲养的绝大多数郁木羊，都不曾知晓爱。
description.en: The berries that grow on its back change flavor according to its emotions. The harsher the environment it grows in, the sweeter the berries become. This is why most Caprity Noct raised in captivity have never known love.

description.zh: 将它分派到家畜牧场，有机会从背上掉落毒腺。 若它在队伍中，每5分钟会让当前饱腹度最低的帕鲁恢复(100~200)点饱腹度。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: Sometimes drops Venom Gland from its back when assigned to Ranch. While in party, restores (100~200) Pal's Hunger to the Pal with the lowest Hunger every 5 minutes. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 在地面爬行，并以微小的有机物为食的帕鲁。 摄入的没营养的物质一段时间后会排出体外。 将它用作拖把进行清洁的话，就能构筑双赢的关系。
description.en: Crawling along the ground, it eats microscopic organic matter. After a while, it discharges any substances that provide no nutrition. By using it as a mop for cleaning, everyone wins!

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，毛老爹的防御力和攻击力会有所提升。
description.en: While in party, increases Attack and Defense of Sweepa.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 在上空生成尖锐的冰柱 瞄准敌人后发射冰柱。
description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的冰刃。
description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.zh: 朝敌人喷出冰冷空气， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 由于它拥有相当丰厚的体毛， 因此在冬眠期间会有大量的毛掸儿躲在它的体毛里。 过去的最高记录竟然高达101只。
description.en: While hibernating, a large number of Swee hide within its voluminous body hair. The most ever recorded is 101.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 此帕鲁的防御力和攻击力会按照队伍中毛掸儿的数量提升，每只增加(12~24)%。
description.en: Can be ridden. This Pal's Attack and Defense increase by (12~24)% for each Swee in party.

description.zh: 朝敌人发射高速水弹。
description.en: Hurls a high speed ball of water at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射大量泡沫 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 盔盔仔及亚种的专用技能。 利用水流喷射推进力， 一边高速旋转一边向敌人飞旋而去。
description.en: Turtacle's exclusive skill. Uses jet-powered propulsion to spin rapidly and launch itself at the enemy.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大水球 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of water and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方发射高压水流。 片刻后，水流会向左右分岔。
description.en: Fires a high-pressure stream of water forward. After a short delay, the stream branches off to the left and right.

description.zh: 用压缩水流一扫前方。 被扫过的区域会在片刻后喷出水柱。
description.en: Mows down the frontal area with a blast of compressed water. The area struck by the blast erupts with water after a short delay.

description.zh: 猛烈地释放出水流 并向前方大范围横扫。
description.en: Shoots pressurized water at extreme velocities, sweeping over a wide area in front of it.

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh: 为保护脆弱的本体，获得了坚硬的甲壳。 作为代价则完全舍弃了本体的防御力， 现在的它甚至会因为挠痒而陷入昏厥。
description.en:
To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell.
Unfortunately, it's utterly defenseless underneath.
Even a little tickle could knock it out cold.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，金属矿石的重量会减轻(80~100)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, reduces the weight of the item Ore by (80~100)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.en: Causes the ground to shake before hurling a massive stone mass at its surroundings.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的岩石长矛。
description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh: 为保护脆弱的本体，获得了坚硬的甲壳。 大半的触觉神经都集中在了手部和甲壳上， 偷偷摸一下它的本体也不会被发现。
description.en:
To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell.
With most of its senses concentrated in its limbs and shell, it can’t even tell if someone quietly touches its core.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，硫磺和石炭的重量将减轻(80~100)%，且玩家和帕鲁以地属性攻击克制的属性时伤害提升(25~40)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, reduces weight of Sulfur and Coal by (80~100)%. Also increases damage dealt by Player and Pals' Ground attacks when hitting the enemy's elemental weakness by (25~40)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.en: Its gigantic arms can rip apart even iron. As a particularly cruel form of execution, serious criminals would be strung up in a public square, and a Hangyu would tear the skin right from their bones.

description.en: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables slow ascension while gliding.

description.zh: 它全身上下都比糖还要甜18000倍。 被其气味吸引的肉食性帕鲁，若是咬上一口， 就会被甜到翻白眼昏迷。
description.en: Its entire body is 18,000 times sweeter than sugar. Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent will find themselves overwhelmed by sweetness and even pass out should they take a bite of this Pal.

description.zh: 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会掉落棉花糖。 若它在据点里，据点帕鲁的饱腹度的减少幅度将会(-10~-20)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: Sometimes drops Cotton Candy when assigned to Ranch. While at a base, reduces Hunger depletion rate of Base Pals by (-10~-20)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.en: Creates multiple sand tornadoes. The tornadoes continuously spin in circles.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 虽然棉毛上散发出香甜浓郁的气息，但是肉质却苦涩到令人战栗。 被其气味吸引的肉食性帕鲁，若是咬上一口， 就会因难以忍受的苦味，翻着白眼再起不能。
description.en: Its fur emits a sweet smell, but its meat is disgustingly bitter. Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent into taking a bite will find themselves overwhelmed by the foul taste and pass out.

description.zh: 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会掉落焦糖棉花糖。 若它在据点里，据点帕鲁的饱腹度的减少幅度将会(-15~-25)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1

description.zh: 这种帕鲁不须特意照料，无论其性别为何， 都会像水龙头般地分泌大量牛奶。 这就是生命的神秘之处吧。
description.en: Milk pours from this Pal like water from an open faucet, regardless of its gender. It's truly a mystery of life, although this mystery may be better left unsolved.

description.zh: 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会产出牛奶。 Lv.Item1
description.en: Sometimes drops Milk when assigned to Ranch. Lv.Item1

description.en:
This Pal’s white ribbon continuously absorbs heat from its surroundings, yet its temperature remains curiously unchanged.
This strange ability once made it a target of relentless hunting, leaving it with a deep mistrust of humans to this day.

description.en: During the dry season, this Pal is always on the verge of blowing a fuse. Sparks can fly with even the slightest provocation, even amongst allies.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，雷属性帕鲁的攻击力会提升(15~30)%。（不可叠加） 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会掉落发电器官。 levelvalue1

description.zh: 它的性格会因出生地水质的不同而有所差异。 诞生于肮脏水源地的水灵儿大多都性格恶劣， 一副街边混混的派头。
description.en: Its personality changes depending on the quality of the water it was born into. Kelpsea born into polluted waters are generally ill-tempered and quickly become delinquents.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，水属性帕鲁的攻击力会提升(15~30)%。（不可叠加） 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会掉落水栖帕鲁的黏液。 levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases Attack of Water Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Aquatic Pal Fluids when assigned to Ranch. levelvalue1

description.zh: 瞄准后发射可笔直飞向敌人 的火焰弹。
description.en: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 用蕴藏龙之力的能量弹 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with draconic energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 连续发射3支高速火箭 并追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three flaming arrows in succession that home in on an enemy.

description.zh: 快速释放龙之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges draconic energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 面向敌人释放火焰， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Shoots flames at an enemy, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 召唤大量小陨石 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Summons numerous small meteorites and launches them at an enemy.

description.zh: 它的性格会因出生地水温的不同而有所差异。 诞生于温暖水源地的水灵儿往往较为热情， 充满源源不绝的干劲。
description.en:
Its personality changes depending on the temperature of the water it was born into.
Kelpsea born in warm waters generally have a passionate, motivated personality.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，火属性帕鲁的攻击力会提升(15~30)%。（不可叠加） 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会掉落喷火器官。 levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases Attack of Fire Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch. levelvalue1

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 在上空生成尖锐的冰柱 瞄准敌人后发射冰柱。
description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的冰刃。
description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 这种帕鲁的脸上总是挂著微笑。 捣蛋猫偶尔会恶作剧，把它的缎带打成死结， 只有这种时候它才会露出恶鬼般的神色。
description.en: A Pal that's never without a bright smile. Occasionally, its tentacles get tied up in knots by Cattiva's pranks. During those moments, its expression turns demonic.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，无属性帕鲁的攻击力会提升(15~30)%。（不可叠加） 若它在据点里，其他据点帕鲁的手工作业工作适应性等级+1。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases Attack of Neutral Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack) While at a base, increases the Handiwork Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.en: A Pal that can easily take flight even while grasping a human. It is, however, prone to letting go when tired, which has led to the sudden demise of more than a few souls.

description.en: The ghostly hands behind it embody the souls of all humans who have raised its kind. Lately, they seem to have reached a unanimous consensus to dote on Wispaw.

description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 这类帕鲁产下的蛋会爆炸，相当恐怖。 平时会将从屁股射出的蛋用作武器， 不过若它无计可施，它就会采取自爆手段了。
description.en: A frightening Pal that produces exploding eggs. It often fires these eggs from its rear end as a form of defense, but when spent, the Pal itself explodes.

description.zh: 发动后会化身为装备在玩家身上的发射器，并制造出会爆炸的蛋。
description.en: When activated, equips to the player and transforms into an egg launcher.

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的雷电球。
description.en: Releases lightning orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 快速放电 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

description.zh: 雷角马的专用技能。 在自己的周围降下落雷， 同时猛力冲向敌人。
description.en: Univolt's exclusive skill. Generates bolts of lightning all around while charging at its target.

description.zh: 瞄准敌人后 发射超高速的雷电激光。
description.en: Takes aim at an enemy before firing a super high speed laser.

description.zh: 生成可笔直前进的雷击。
description.en: Generates a lightning bolt that moves forward in a line.

description.zh: 在敌人头上生成3次落雷。
description.en: Generates lightning that strikes an enemy three times from above.

description.zh: 让自己化作避雷针引来雷电， 并在原地引发闪电爆炸。
description.en: Acts as a lightning rod, calling down thunderbolts that electrocute the surrounding area.

description.zh: 积蓄雷电之力 瞄准敌人释放强劲电击。
description.en: Charges electric energy before blasting enemies with a powerful shock.

description.zh: 以前，它被认为是雷神的使者，不会被人类狩猎。 然而，当有人目击到它被闪电击中后死亡， 信仰逐渐消失，它也字面意思上沦落到当牛做马。
description.en: It used to be considered an emissary of the Thunder God, and thus was not hunted by people. However, after witnesses observed one die from a lightning strike, its reverence faded, and it quite literally fell into the role of a workhorse.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁以雷属性攻击克制的属性时伤害提升(25~40)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals' Electric attacks when hitting the enemy's elemental weakness by (25~40)%. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 在上空生成尖锐的冰柱 瞄准敌人后发射冰柱。
description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的冰刃。
description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.zh: 从地面召唤出冰墙。 冰墙会持续一段时间， 并在承受一定伤害后碎裂。
description.en: Creates a wall of ice that rises from the ground. The ice wall remains standing for a while, and breaks after taking enough damage.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 大范围的在敌人脚下生成冰柱穿刺。
description.en: Throws icicles in a wide area from under the enemy's feet.

description.zh: 凌角马的专用技能。 在自己的周围凝聚冰柱， 同时猛力冲向敌人。
description.en: Univolt Cryst's exclusive skill. Generates ice pillars around itself while charging toward enemies.

description.zh: 昔日，它被视为冬之神的使者，无人敢猎捕。 然而当有人目睹它在冰面滑倒的瞬间， 信仰逐渐消失，一失足即成千古牛马。
description.en: It used to be considered an emissary of the Winter God, and thus was not hunted by people. However, after witnesses observed one lose its footing on the ice, its reverence faded, and it quite literally slid into the role of a workhorse.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间玩家的攻击会转变为冰属性，且攻击力提升(5~20)%。
description.en: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Ice and increases Attack by (5~20)%.

description.zh: 朝敌人发射高速水弹。
description.en: Hurls a high speed ball of water at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 发射水弹 笔直飞向对方。
description.en: Hurls a ball of water straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射大量泡沫 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大水球 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of water and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 猛烈地释放出水流 并向前方大范围横扫。
description.en: Shoots pressurized water at extreme velocities, sweeping over a wide area in front of it.

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh: 这种帕鲁在很久以前是相当强大的巨型水栖帕鲁， 但食物减少后，它们就搬到了陆地上。 由于走路会消耗许多能量， 导致它们的体型逐渐变小，现在已经是非常弱小的帕鲁了。
description.en: Long ago, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal. However, as food became scarce, it evolved to live on land. Since walking requires much energy, it gradually became smaller and is now a small and puny Pal.

description.zh: 发动后会以水枪攻击锁定的目标敌人。 此帕鲁使用的水枪的威力将提升至(1.1~2.5)倍。 若它在队伍中，玩家的攻击力提升(10~20)%。 levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Aqua Gun. When this Pal uses Aqua Gun, it has a x(1.1~2.5) damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's Attack by (10~20)%. levelvalue1

description.zh: 瞄准后发射可笔直飞向敌人 的火焰弹。
description.en: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 连续发射3支高速火箭 并追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three flaming arrows in succession that home in on an enemy.

description.zh: 生成可笔直前进的雷击。
description.en: Generates a lightning bolt that moves forward in a line.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 使敌人周围地面活性化， 并在一定时间后爆炸。
description.en: Infuses the surrounding ground with energy, causing it to explode after a set amount of time.

description.zh: 召唤巨大的雷属性龙卷风。 龙卷风将追踪敌人缓慢移动。
description.en: Generates a huge tornado of lightning that moves slowly towards the enemy.

description.zh: 这种帕鲁在很久以前是相当强大的巨型水栖帕鲁， 但食物减少后，它们就搬到了陆地上。 由于走路会燃烧许多热量， 意外地让它们体内的火之力量觉醒了！
description.en: Long ago, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal. However, as food became scarce, it evolved to live on land. Since walking burns many calories, it astonishingly awakened its power to control fire!

description.zh: 发动后会以烈焰溅射攻击锁定的目标敌人。 此帕鲁使用的烈焰溅射的威力将提升至(1.1~2.5)倍。 若它在队伍中，玩家的攻击力提升(10~20)%。 levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Spirit Fire. When this Pal uses Spirit Fire, it has a x(1.1~2.5) damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's Attack by (10~20)%. levelvalue1

description.zh: 月镰魔的专用技能。 向前一跃，迅速斩下两击。 且每次斩击都充满了暗属性的力量。
description.en: Loupmoon's exclusive skill. Leaps forward and attacks twice with vicious claws imbued with dark energy.

description.zh: 快速释放黑暗之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 它头上的角可通过沐浴月光生长。 虽然这种帕鲁并不讨厌阳光， 可是它的角在被太阳照射时会发痒。
description.en: The horns on its head grow under the moonlight. It doesn't hate the sun, but its horns itch when sunlight hits them.

description.zh: 发动后会以飞跃爪击攻击锁定的目标敌人。 此帕鲁使用的飞跃爪击的威力将提升至(1.1~2.5)倍。 若它在队伍中，玩家的近战武器攻击速度提升(15~30)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Jumping Claw. When this Pal uses Jumping Claw, it has a x(1.1~2.5) damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's melee weapon attack speed by (15~30)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 在上空生成尖锐的冰柱 瞄准敌人后发射冰柱。
description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 霜镰魔的专用技能。 向前一跃，迅速斩下两击。 且每次斩击都充满了冰属性的力量。
description.en: Loupmoon Cryst's exclusive skill. Leaps forward and attacks twice with vicious claws imbued with ice element.

description.zh: 从地面召唤出冰墙。 冰墙会持续一段时间， 并在承受一定伤害后碎裂。
description.en: Creates a wall of ice that rises from the ground. The ice wall remains standing for a while, and breaks after taking enough damage.

description.zh: 在空中生成复数个冰锥， 瞄准敌人一齐射出。
description.en: Generates multiple sharp ice blocks in the sky and fires them at the enemy.

description.zh: 召唤朝前方三个方向推进的冰柱
description.en: Generates pillars of ice that move in a straight line in three directions.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 它头上的角是绝对不会融化的，不可思议的冰。 用它折断的角制成的刨冰，那可真称的上是绝顶美味， 无论是吃刨冰的人，还是霜镰魔，头都很疼。
description.en: The horns on its head are made of a mysterious ice that never melts. Shaved ice made by breaking off a horn is truly exquisite, but both the one who tries it and Loupmoon Cryst end up with a headache.

description.zh: 发动后会以吹雪爪击攻击锁定的目标敌人。 此帕鲁使用的吹雪爪击的威力将提升至(1.1~2.5)倍。 若它在队伍中，玩家的近战武器攻击速度提升(15~30)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Snow Claw. When this Pal uses Snow Claw, it has a x(1.1~2.5) damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's melee weapon attack speed by (15~30)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 黑鸦隐士的专用技能。 瞬间移动至敌人身旁， 再以鸟喙发动攻击。
description.en: Cawgnito's exclusive skill. Teleports next to an enemy before attacking with its beak.

description.zh: 快速释放黑暗之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 它曾经在天空中自由翱翔， 但在与天擒鸟的竞争中败北， 于是舍弃天空，过起了与黑夜共生的低调生活。
description.en: Long ago it freely soared the skies. After losing a contest with Galeclaw, it abandoned the skies, and now lives a secretive life in the dark of night.

description.zh: 发动后可以使用夜视，即使在黑暗中也能看得一清二楚。 再次发动即可解除该效果。 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会从地里挖出骨头。 Lv.Item1
description.en: When activated, grants Night Vision to see in dark places. Activate again to turn off. Sometimes digs up Bone when assigned to Ranch. Lv.Item1

description.zh: 瞄准后发射可笔直飞向敌人 的火焰弹。
description.en: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 炽焰牛的专用技能。 锁定敌人后， 以凶猛气势顶着锐利牛角冲向对方。
description.en: Arsox's exclusive skill. Takes aim and charges with fierce momentum while raising its horn.

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 连续发射3支高速火箭 并追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three flaming arrows in succession that home in on an enemy.

description.zh: 面向敌人释放火焰， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Shoots flames at an enemy, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 使敌人周围地面活性化， 并在一定时间后爆炸。
description.en: Infuses the surrounding ground with energy, causing it to explode after a set amount of time.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 昔日这种帕鲁常常被肉食帕鲁所猎杀。 炽焰牛对此深感不平， 于是这股愤怒化作炽热的火焰，在世代之间代代相传。
description.en: In ancient times, carnivorous Pals pursued them relentlessly. The absurd fury in the cries of Arsox transformed into a raging inferno, which has been passed on to this day.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，玩家的耐寒能力+2。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party,the player gains Cold Resistance +2. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 扇形发射锋利的气刃。
description.en: Sends out sharp blades of air in a fan shape.

description.zh: 朝敌人喷出冰冷空气， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 在空中生成复数个冰锥， 瞄准敌人一齐射出。
description.en: Generates multiple sharp ice blocks in the sky and fires them at the enemy.

description.zh: 召唤朝前方三个方向推进的冰柱
description.en: Generates pillars of ice that move in a straight line in three directions.
