description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 它脸颊周围的绒毛能吸收冲击力。 就算被击飞几米也没什么大不了的， 但整理羽毛很麻烦，痒的地方又挠不到， 总觉得有些烦乱、郁闷。
description.en: Its soft facial fluff softens any hit, but it cannot groom itself well nor scratch its itches, leaving it in a constant state of mild frustration.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，提升对陷入冻结状态帕鲁的捕获概率。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases the capture rate of Pals afflicted with Freeze. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 在上空生成尖锐的冰柱 瞄准敌人后发射冰柱。
description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的冰刃。
description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.zh: 用地下尖锐的根部追击敌人 并从脚下贯穿敌人。
description.en: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 它的刺上有毒，被刺到会有危险。 与幻悦蝶关系很好， 只有让它吸花蜜时，才会露出开心的表情。
description.en: This prickly Pal's thorns are highly poisonous. It is friendly with Cinnamoth and only smiles while a Cinnamoth is drinking its nectar.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，草属性帕鲁的攻击力会提升(15~30)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases Attack of Grass Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 于前方制造毒雾， 使目标陷入中毒状态。
description.en: Generates a fog of poison in front, causing the opponent to become poisoned.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成砂砾龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 吸入它的鳞粉后，会获得升天般的愉悦感。 虽然有人试图对这种帕鲁严加管理， 但受到帕鲁保护团体的反对，至今没有进展。
description.en: Sniffing its scales produces a feeling of unparalleled euphoria. There was some effort to further regulate this byproduct, but the Free Pal Alliance have vehemently opposed these measures, putting a stop to them.

description.zh: 发动后会以毒雾攻击锁定的目标敌人。 若它在据点里，其他据点帕鲁的牧场的工作适应性等级+1。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, attacks the targeted enemy with Poison Fog. While at a base, increases the Farming Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 快速连续向敌人进行啃咬攻击。
description.en: Bites rapidly in succession to attack enemies.

description.zh: 快速地向敌人飞扑，咬住敌人进行攻击。
description.en: Quickly lunges at the enemy and bites to deal damage.

description.zh: 快速放电 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

description.zh: 发射雷电球 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires an electric ball that slowly pursues an enemy.

description.zh: 同时发射直线飞行的高速雷球， 和追踪敌人的慢速雷球。
description.en: A high-speed lightning ball that flies in a straight line. Simultaneously fires slow lightning balls that track the enemy.

description.zh: 让自己化作避雷针引来雷电， 并在原地引发闪电爆炸。
description.en: Acts as a lightning rod, calling down thunderbolts that electrocute the surrounding area.

description.zh: 积蓄雷电之力 瞄准敌人释放强劲电击。
description.en: Charges electric energy before blasting enemies with a powerful shock.

description.zh: 向八个方向召唤直线推进的雷击。
description.en: Generates lightning strikes that travel in a straight line in all directions.

description.zh: 泡在水里的话，蓬松的毛会大量吸水。 在它抖动身体甩干水分时，会伴随剧烈的放电， 和它一起泡澡可是赌命的行为。
description.en:
Its fluffy fur absorbs tremendous amounts of water when soaked.
Shaking it dry releases a powerful electrical discharge, making bath time together a serious gamble.

description.zh: 若它在据点里，其他据点帕鲁的发电工作适应性等级+1。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While at a base, increases the Generating Electricity Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 用蕴藏龙之力的能量弹 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with draconic energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 快速释放龙之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges draconic energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 连续发射3支高速火箭 并追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three flaming arrows in succession that home in on an enemy.

description.zh: 精灵龙及亚种的专用技能。 发射2股蕴含不可思议能力的龙卷风， 追击敌人。
description.en: Elphidran's exclusive skill. Generates twin whirlwinds imbued with a mysterious power that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 向前方呼出蕴含龙之力的气息 ，持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Exhales breath imbued with draconic energy, dealing continuous damage to those in front of it.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 召唤大量小陨石 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Summons numerous small meteorites and launches them at an enemy.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 它的性格正如外表一样单纯无害。 正因为如此，它无法很好地区分善恶， 容易被内心歹毒的人利用。
description.en: It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it is sometimes unable to discern good from evil, often allowing wrongdoers to take advantage of it.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 飞行时移动速度会提升。 若它在队伍中，击倒暗属性帕鲁时获得的掉落道具增加(40~80)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, Movement Speed is increased. While in party, Dark Pals drop (40~80)% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 发射水弹 笔直飞向对方。
description.en: Hurls a ball of water straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 用蕴藏龙之力的能量弹 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with draconic energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 快速释放龙之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges draconic energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 精灵龙及亚种的专用技能。 发射2股蕴含不可思议能力的龙卷风， 追击敌人。
description.en: Elphidran's exclusive skill. Generates twin whirlwinds imbued with a mysterious power that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 生成酸性云朵 在敌人头上下酸雨。
description.en: Creates acidic clouds that pour down acid rain on enemies.

description.zh: 猛烈地释放出水流 并向前方大范围横扫。
description.en: Shoots pressurized water at extreme velocities, sweeping over a wide area in front of it.

description.zh: 召唤大量小陨石 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Summons numerous small meteorites and launches them at an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh: 它的性格正如外表一样单纯无害。 正因为如此，它所采取的所有行动都无恶意， 即便是杀死了谁，也不会有任何想法。
description.en: It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it harbors no ill will in any of its actions and is indifferent even after killing someone.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 飞行时移动速度会提升。 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁受到的火属性伤害减轻(15~30)%，并且不会陷入点燃状态。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, Movement Speed is increased. While in party, player and party Pals take (15~30)% less Fire damage and are immune to Burn. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 瞄准后发射可笔直飞向敌人 的火焰弹。
description.en: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 面向敌人释放火焰， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Shoots flames at an enemy, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 烽歌龙的专用技能。 一边从口部喷出火焰一边前进。
description.en: Vanwyrms exclusive skill. Advances while breathing fire from its mouth.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 据说用烽歌龙的外骨骼制成的笛子， 所奏的笛声可越遍千山万水， 因此在古代战事中通常会被用来发出攻击信号。
description.en:
The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm are said to cross whole mountain ranges.
In ages past, such flutes were used to signal an attack.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 若它在队伍中，玩家攻击敌方弱点部位造成的伤害将提升(20~40)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases damage player deals to enemy weak points by (20~40)%. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 在上空生成尖锐的冰柱 瞄准敌人后发射冰柱。
description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 朝敌人喷出冰冷空气， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 霜歌龙的专用技能。 一边从口部呼出冷气一边前进。
description.en: Vanwyrm Cryst's exclusive skill. Advances while exhaling cold air from its mouth.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 据说用霜歌龙的外骨骼制成的笛子， 所奏的笛声可越遍千山万水， 因此在古代战事中通常会被用来吹奏胜利凯歌。
description.en: The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm Cryst are said to cross whole mountain ranges. In ages past, such flutes were used to signal victory in battle.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 若它在队伍中，玩家攻击敌方弱点部位造成的伤害将提升(30~50)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases damage player deals to enemy weak points by (30~50)%. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.zh: 快速释放黑暗之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 使敌人周围地面活性化， 并在一定时间后爆炸。
description.en: Infuses the surrounding ground with energy, causing it to explode after a set amount of time.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 它会在黑暗中袭击猎物，用斗篷般的翅膀将其包裹起来。 至于翅膀内侧到底发生了什么，以及为什么会沾染上红色， 这类问题还是不要深究为妙。
description.en:
Attacking from the shadows, this Pal traps its prey within its cloak-like wings.
It's probably best not to know what happens within them, or why the inside of its wings are stained red.

description.zh: 与它并肩作战时，会为玩家和夜幕魔蝠赋予生命窃取效果，攻击造成伤害时将恢复等同于伤害量(5~9)%的HP。 levelvalue1
description.en: While fighting together, grants the player and Felbat a life steal effect that restores (5~9)% of damage dealt as Health. levelvalue1

description.zh: 于前方制造毒雾， 使目标陷入中毒状态。
description.en: Generates a fog of poison in front, causing the opponent to become poisoned.

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 城堡里开满了国王最喜欢的花朵。 但大型战争爆发，战火即将波及城堡。 这时，一只花朵精灵凭空出现了。 ──摘自童话《国王的花朵》。
description.en: The castle was filled with the king's favorite flowers. A great battle ensued, and flames approached the castle. Amidst the chaos, the spirit of a flower appeared. - From the fairy tale, |The King's Flower.|

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，击倒地属性帕鲁时获得的掉落道具增加(40~80)%。（不可叠加） 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会掉落各种各样的种子。 levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, Ground Pals drop (40~80)% more items when defeated. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops various seeds when assigned to Ranch. levelvalue1

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 骑士蜂的专用技能。 朝向敌人高速突刺。 最后使出致命一击贯穿敌人。
description.en: Beegarde's exclusive skill. Charges at the enemy at high speed, delivering a final thrust with a spear.

description.zh: 赌上性命引发爆炸。 是种为了荣誉而牺牲自己的技能。
description.en: Risks its life to cause a violent explosion, but receives the honor of falling in battle.

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.zh: 生成酸性云朵 在敌人头上下酸雨。
description.en: Creates acidic clouds that pour down acid rain on enemies.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 它是发誓效忠女皇蜂的仆人。 誓死消灭对女王有害的一切事物。 甚至不惜采取自爆手段，也要守卫女王到最后一刻。
description.en: A servant that pledges loyalty to Elizabee. Any that cause harm to the queen are immediately expelled from the hive. It will gladly give its life to protect its queen.

description.zh: 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会掉落蜂蜜。 若它在队伍中，女皇蜂的攻击力会有所提升。 Lv.Item1
description.en: While in party, increases Elizabee's Attack. Sometimes drops Honey when assigned to Ranch. Lv.Item1

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.zh: 女皇蜂的专用技能。 以法杖聚集力量后，再旋转法杖来释放能量。
description.en: Elizabee's exclusive skill. Channels power into its staff, and unleashes it in a whirl.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 用地下尖锐的根部追击敌人 并从脚下贯穿敌人。
description.en: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 它是统御骑士蜂的天选女王。 为伟大女王效力的喜悦 让无数甘愿为其劳动至死的仆人络绎不绝。
description.en: A chosen queen to rule over Beegardes. There is a never ending stream of servants willing to work themselves to death for the pleasure of serving their queen.

description.zh: 此帕鲁的攻击力会按照队伍中骑士蜂的数量提升，每只增加(12~24)%。 levelvalue1
description.en: This Pal's Attack increases by (12~24)% for each Beegarde in party. levelvalue1

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.zh: 快速释放黑暗之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 生成酸性云朵 在敌人头上下酸雨。
description.en: Creates acidic clouds that pour down acid rain on enemies.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 使出浑身力量 向各个方向喷洒毒球。
description.en: Focuses energy into the body and scatters poison orbs in all directions.

description.zh: 赌上性命引发爆炸。 使用后会陷入无法战斗的状态。
description.en: Risks its life to cause a violent explosion. Becomes incapacitated afterwards.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 无属性伤害减少10%
description.en: 10% decrease in incoming Neutral damage.

description.zh: 它总是为了寻求一夜之欢而纠缠他人。 一开始只对帕鲁有兴趣， 但近年来，它的魔爪也开始伸向人类。
description.en: Seeking a night of love, it is always chasing someone around. At first it only showed interest in other Pals, but in recent years even humans have become the target of its debauchery.

description.zh: 与它并肩作战时，会为玩家和博爱蜥赋予生命窃取效果，攻击造成伤害时将恢复等同于伤害量(5~9)%的HP。 levelvalue1
description.en: While fighting together, grants the player and Lovander the life steal effect which absorbs some of the received damage and restores HP.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 笑魇猫的专用技能。 带着无所畏惧的笑容跳起， 再用全身的力量辗压敌人。
description.en: Grintale's exclusive skill. Grins menacingly before leaping into the air and smashing foes with its body.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 将岩石从眼前的地上吸附起来 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 如果进入笑魇猫的领地， 它监视来者的眼睛就会闪闪发光。 这并不是比喻，而是真的会发光。
description.en:
Grintale's eyes light up the moment anyone enters its territory.
This is no figure of speech—its eyes literally light up.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，捡到帕鲁蛋时将有(50~75)%的概率再捡到1颗。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, picking up a Pal Egg has a (50~75)% chance of receiving one extra. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 于前方制造毒雾， 使目标陷入中毒状态。
description.en: Generates a fog of poison in front, causing the opponent to become poisoned.

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的高速暗黑球。
description.en: Fires high-speed dark orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 使用暗之力连续发射数支高速箭追击敌人。
description.en: Fires off dark energy that homes in on an enemy.

description.zh: 桃蛛娘的专用技能。 吐出丝线缠绕住猎物。 之后全速冲向猎物所在位置， 打出三段攻击以使其毙命。
description.en: Tarantriss's exclusive skill. Spits out a ball of thread, entangling the target it hits. Then, rushes at full speed to the trapped target and delivers three slashing strikes to finish it off.

description.zh: 使出浑身力量 向各个方向喷洒毒球。
description.en: Focuses energy into the body and scatters poison orbs in all directions.

description.zh: 于敌人周围生成数个暗黑龙卷风。
description.en: Generates several dark vortexes around the enemy.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 它非常的粘人，字面意义上的如胶似漆。 越是想要甩开它，就会粘的越紧。 以上就是它的「性格」特征。
description.en: Extremely sticky and clingy. The more it's resisted, the more tenacious it becomes. Such is its |personality.|

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间可以进行2段跳跃， 并向射击地点发射蜘蛛丝，牵引身体快速移动。
description.en: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. Additionally, can shoot spider web to grapple and move at high speed.

description.zh: 在上空生成尖锐的冰柱 瞄准敌人后发射冰柱。
description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.zh: 发射水弹 笔直飞向对方。
description.en: Hurls a ball of water straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的冰刃。
description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.zh: 召唤一束直线前进的水柱。
description.en: Generates a column of water that travels in a straight line.

description.zh: 从地面召唤出冰墙。 冰墙会持续一段时间， 并在承受一定伤害后碎裂。
description.en: Creates a wall of ice that rises from the ground. The ice wall remains standing for a while, and breaks after taking enough damage.

description.zh: 召唤朝前方三个方向推进的冰柱
description.en: Generates pillars of ice that move in a straight line in three directions.

description.zh: 在敌人四周掀起波浪并涌向敌人， 最后在中心点爆炸，喷出高高的水柱。
description.en: Generates waves that surge around the enemy from all sides. They converge and explode at the center, erupting into a column of water.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 种群内能在雪上滑行最快的个体，就是最了不起的个体。 有时会有因为冲太快飞跃起来的个体突然从天而降， 在争夺首领地位时这种情况尤其多发。 今天晴转多云，部分地区大到「豹」雨。
description.en:
Among Polapups, the fastest slider on the snow earns the highest respect.
Sometimes, a too-forceful leap sends one tumbling from the sky— a common sight during territorial season.
Forecast: clear skies with a chance of flying Polapups.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 在雪地上时，移动速度提升(80~160)%。 并且可以在斜坡处快速向下滑行。
description.en: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased by (80~160)% while mounted on snow. Can also slide quickly down slopes.

description.zh: 在上空生成尖锐的冰柱 瞄准敌人后发射冰柱。
description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的冰刃。
description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.zh: 撼动地面， 使大块岩石射向四面八方
description.en: Causes the ground to shake before hurling a massive stone mass at its surroundings.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 生成复数个砂龙卷。 龙卷风们将一边自旋一边绕中心旋转。
description.en: Creates multiple sand tornadoes. The tornadoes continuously spin in circles.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 种群内能在雪上滑行最快的个体，就是最了不起的个体。 有时会有因为冲太快飞跃起来的个体一头扎进雪里。 在争夺首领地位时这种情况尤其多发。 今日路况拥挤，当心连环「豹扎」。
description.en: Among Polapup Terras, the fastest slider on the snow earns the highest respect. Sometimes, a too-forceful leap leaves one buried in the snow— a common sight during particularly competitive seasons. Traffic forecast: heavy Polapup Terra congestion.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 在雪地上时，移动速度提升(80~160)%。 并且可以在斜坡处快速向下滑行。 滑行时初始速度较慢，但最高速度更快。
description.en: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased by (80~160)% while mounted on snow. Can also slide quickly down slopes. While it starts out slow, the top speed it can hit while sliding is no joke.

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.zh: 快速释放黑暗之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 面向敌人释放火焰， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Shoots flames at an enemy, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 这种帕鲁对站姿的讲究异常执着。 它总是追求着最帅气的姿势。 给它一面镜子的话，它能为研究姿势而站一整天。
description.en: A Pal that always takes great care to maintain a stylish stance. Always on the hunt for the coolest poses, if given a mirror it will spend all day posing in front of it.

description.zh: 发动后(10~20)秒内，朋克蜥与玩家将变得透明，在敌方视野中隐去身形。 levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, Leezpunk and the player become invisible, making them undetectable to enemies for (10~20) seconds. levelvalue1

description.zh: 瞄准后发射可笔直飞向敌人 的火焰弹。
description.en: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 面向敌人释放火焰， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Shoots flames at an enemy, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成炙热的龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two flaming tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 使敌人周围地面活性化， 并在一定时间后爆炸。
description.en: Infuses the surrounding ground with energy, causing it to explode after a set amount of time.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 召唤巨大的雷属性龙卷风。 龙卷风将追踪敌人缓慢移动。
description.en: Generates a huge tornado of lightning that moves slowly towards the enemy.

description.zh: 这种帕鲁对站姿的讲究异常执着。 它总是在寻找最热血的姿势， 因此它的饲主会被迫整天欣赏热血到让人烦躁的姿势。
description.en: A Pal that has an unusual obsession with their standing posture. Always in search of the hottest pose, this Pal's owner is constantly presented with fervent stances.

description.zh: 发动后(10~20)秒内，热血蜥与玩家将变得透明，在敌方视野中隐去身形。 levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, Leezpunk Ignis and the player become invisible, making them undetectable to enemies for (10~20) seconds. levelvalue1

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 铁拳猿及亚种的专用技能。 猛击地面两次后高高跳起， 再赏给对方强力的一拳。
description.en: Gorirat's exclusive skill. Pounds the ground twice before leaping into the air and delivers a powerful punch.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh:
攻击 +15%
工作速度 -10%
description.en:
Attack +15%
Work Speed -10%

description.zh: 它会用不同的节奏敲击地面与同伴沟通。 每种节奏所对应的意思会根据族群有所差异， 但人类至今仍未能完全理解其具体分类。
description.en: It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades. The meaning of each rhythm differs by troop, but the distinction between them is still largely unknown.

description.zh: 发动后会解放野性之力，并在一定时间内铁拳猿的攻击力将提升(75~300)%。 Lv.Skill1
description.en: When activated, unleashes a primal fury that increases Gorirat's Attack by (75~300)% for a limited time. Lv.Skill1

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 将岩石从眼前的地上吸附起来 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 铁拳猿及亚种的专用技能。 猛击地面两次后高高跳起， 再赏给对方强力的一拳。
description.en: Gorirat's exclusive skill. Pounds the ground twice before leaping into the air and delivers a powerful punch.

description.zh: 石掌猿的专用技能。 猛击地面两次后高高跳起， 再赏给对方汇聚大地之力的一拳。
description.en: Gorirat Terra's exclusive skill. Pounds the ground twice before leaping into the air and delivers a powerful punch infused with the Power of Gaia.

description.zh: 撼动地面， 使大块岩石射向四面八方
description.en: Causes the ground to shake before hurling a massive stone mass at its surroundings.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的岩石长矛。
description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh:
攻击 +15%
工作速度 -10%
description.en:
Attack +15%
Work Speed -10%

description.zh: 它会用不同的节奏敲击地面与同伴沟通。 有着比铁拳猿更霸道的腕力， 假如所有的石掌猿同时捶击大地， 帕洛斯群岛将在1秒内沉没。
description.en: It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades. Stronger than Gorirat, if every Gorirat Terra hit the ground at the same time, the island would sink in 1 second.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家的攀爬速度提升(50~100)%。（不可叠加） Lv.Skill1
description.en: While in party, increases the player's climbing speed by (50~100)%. (Does not stack) Lv.Skill1

description.zh: 朝敌人发射高速水弹。
description.en: Hurls a high speed ball of water at an enemy.

description.zh: 用蕴藏龙之力的能量弹 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with draconic energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射水弹 笔直飞向对方。
description.en: Hurls a ball of water straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射大量泡沫 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 快速释放龙之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges draconic energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 向前方呼出蕴含龙之力的气息 ，持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Exhales breath imbued with draconic energy, dealing continuous damage to those in front of it.

description.zh: 猛烈地释放出水流 并向前方大范围横扫。
description.en: Shoots pressurized water at extreme velocities, sweeping over a wide area in front of it.

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh: 它流线型的外形很适合在水上活动。 因此经常被非法捕鱼团捕捉， 并被拿来代替冲浪板使用。
description.en: Its hydrodynamic form is well suited for activities on water. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在水上移动。 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会掉落皮革。
description.en: Can be ridden to travel on water. Sometimes drops Leather when assigned to Ranch.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 用蕴藏龙之力的能量弹 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with draconic energy at an enemy.

description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 将岩石从眼前的地上吸附起来 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成砂砾龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.en: Exhales breath imbued with draconic energy, dealing continuous damage to those in front of it.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的岩石长矛。
description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 它流线型的外形很适合在沙上活动。 因此经常被非法捕鱼团捕捉， 并被拿来代替冲浪板使用。
description.en: Its aerodynamic form is well suited for activities on sand. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，会为玩家的攻击附加(2~6)点泥泞异常状态值。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, the player's attacks increase Muddy buildup by (2~6). (Does not stack)

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 羽箭射手及亚种的专用技能。 拉满弓弦全神贯注瞄准敌人后， 对敌人进行射击。
description.en: Robinquill's exclusive skill. Takes aim while drawing its bow before releasing a powerful shot at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 用地下尖锐的根部追击敌人 并从脚下贯穿敌人。
description.en: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 这类帕鲁在森林里过着狩猎生活，特征习性等与人类十分接近。 在远古时代，便走上了与人类不同的进化之路。 但也许它们就是能解答「帕鲁为何物」这个问题的关键。
description.en: A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the forests. It may prove to be a key for understanding what Pals are and how they diverged from humans in the distant past.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家使用弓箭时的伤害提升(10~35)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases the player's bow damage by (10~35)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 羽箭射手及亚种的专用技能。 拉满弓弦全神贯注瞄准敌人后， 对敌人进行射击。

description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成砂砾龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的岩石长矛。
description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 这类帕鲁在岩石地带过着狩猎生活，特征习性等与人类十分接近。 每当从遗址中发现山岳射手的骨头时， 那里总是一定会有人类的骨头。
description.en: A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the rocky areas. When Robinquill Terra bones are found in ruins, there are always human bones found nearby as well.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家使用弓箭时的蓄力速度提升(15~30)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases the player's bow charge speed by (15~30)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 朝敌人发射高速水弹。
description.en: Hurls a high speed ball of water at an enemy.

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 发射大量泡沫 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 它喜欢植物众多的地方， 但是最近，波娜兔似乎集体染上了花粉症。
description.en: It prefers places that have an abundance of vegetation, but hay fever has apparently become a problem for Flopie as of late.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，就会出现在玩家身边。 它会自动前去拾取附近的道具。
description.en: While in party, appears near the player. Automatically picks up nearby items.

description.zh: 瞄准后发射可笔直飞向敌人 的火焰弹。
description.en: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 连续发射3支高速火箭 并追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three flaming arrows in succession that home in on an enemy.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成炙热的龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two flaming tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 召唤大量小陨石 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Summons numerous small meteorites and launches them at an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.en:

description.en:
It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell.
Those who dies from Helzephyr's lightning are sure to have their soul sent to the underworld.

description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Dark and increases Attack by (5~20)%.

description.en: Causes the ground to shake before hurling a massive stone mass at its surroundings.

description.en: The leaf on its horn cannot be removed, no matter how hard it is pulled. When the leaf falls on its own, Elgrove accepts its time has come.

description.zh: 发动后，密林陶洛斯会将力量分给玩家，让玩家的攻击转变为草属性，且攻击力提升(30~50)%。 Lv.Skill1

description.en: Its frozen horn stays solid through its life. When water begins to drip from this ice, Elgrove Cryst feels the chill of its own life slipping away.

description.en: In ages past, it was believed that drawing a picture of Fenglope Lux would result in being struck down by lightning. As time passes, artworks depicting Fenglope Lux became revered as charms to ward off lightning, making them a common presence.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间可以进行2段跳跃。 若它在队伍中，击倒水属性帕鲁时获得的掉落道具增加(40~80)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. While in party,Water Pals drop (40~80)% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 花冠龙及亚种的专用技能。 使用巨大的尾巴拍打前方地面， 对直线范围造成冲击。
description.en: Dinossom's exclusive skill. Uses its large tail to strike the ground in front of it, delivering a shockwave in a straight line.

description.zh: 快速释放龙之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges draconic energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 向前方呼出蕴含龙之力的气息 ，持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Exhales breath imbued with draconic energy, dealing continuous damage to those in front of it.

description.zh: 用地下尖锐的根部追击敌人 并从脚下贯穿敌人。
description.en: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 它只要生气便会暴走，如同烈火一般不受控制。 因此「踩了花冠龙尾巴」这句话就是 指激怒某人的意思。
description.en: A Pal who once angered cannot be pacified. It rages on and on like an inferno. The phrase |step on a Dinossom's tail| has come to mean enraging someone.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，龙属性帕鲁的防御力会提升(15~30)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, increase Defense of Dragon Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 快速放电 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

description.zh: 生成两个蕴含雷电能量的球 然后瞄准敌人，从中发射无数雷球。
description.en: Creates two balls of electric energy that fire numerous lightning orbs at enemies.

description.zh: 花冠龙及亚种的专用技能。 使用巨大的尾巴拍打前方地面， 对直线范围造成冲击。
description.en: Dinossom's exclusive skill. Uses its large tail to strike the ground in front of it, delivering a shockwave in a straight line.

description.zh: 向前方呼出蕴含龙之力的气息 ，持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Exhales breath imbued with draconic energy, dealing continuous damage to those in front of it.

description.zh: 在敌人头上生成3次落雷。
description.en: Generates lightning that strikes an enemy three times from above.

description.zh: 雷冠龙的专用技能。 使用巨大的尾巴拍打前方地面， 对直线范围造成雷击。
description.en: Dinossom Lux's exclusive skill. Uses its large tail to strike the ground in front of it, delivering a bolt of lightning in a straight line.

description.zh: 让自己化作避雷针引来雷电， 并在原地引发闪电爆炸。
description.en: Acts as a lightning rod, calling down thunderbolts that electrocute the surrounding area.

description.zh: 积蓄雷电之力 瞄准敌人释放强劲电击。
description.en: Charges electric energy before blasting enemies with a powerful shock.

description.zh: 召唤巨大的雷属性龙卷风。 龙卷风将追踪敌人缓慢移动。
description.en: Generates a huge tornado of lightning that moves slowly towards the enemy.

description.zh: 它曾被落雷击中，但幸运地捡回一条命。 因此「雷落雷冠龙」这句话就是 指九死一生，大难不死的意思。
description.en: Though struck by lightning, it lives on. The phrase "struck by a Dinossom Lux's bolt" has come to mean narrowly escaping death.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，雷属性帕鲁的防御力会提升(15~30)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, increases Defense of Electric Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 瞄准后发射可笔直飞向敌人 的火焰弹。
description.en: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 浪刃武士及亚种的专用技能。 摆出迎战姿势后瞬间移动至敌人面前， 并使出超高速的拔刀攻击。
description.en: Bushi's exclusive skill. Taking hold of the sword, it appears in front of an enemy in an instant and unleashes an ultra-fast sword draw attack.

description.zh: 面向敌人释放火焰， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Shoots flames at an enemy, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 让自己化作避雷针引来雷电， 并在原地引发闪电爆炸。
description.en: Acts as a lightning rod, calling down thunderbolts that electrocute the surrounding area.

description.zh: 使敌人周围地面活性化， 并在一定时间后爆炸。
description.en: Infuses the surrounding ground with energy, causing it to explode after a set amount of time.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 它在死亡时身体会化为刀，由下一代继承。 浪刃武士以外的生物拿到这把刀时， 会因承受不住它的亡者之声而发狂。
description.en:
Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation.
If someone other than a Bushi wields this blade, the soul within torments them until they are driven mad.

description.zh: 发动后会以居合斩攻击锁定的目标敌人。 此帕鲁使用的居合斩的威力将提升至(1.1~2.5)倍。 levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Iaigiri. When this Pal uses Iaigiri, it has a x(1.1~2.5) damage multiplier. levelvalue1

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的高速暗黑球。
description.en: Fires high-speed dark orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 将带有黑暗力量的高速能量弹射向敌人。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with dark energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 浪刃武士及亚种的专用技能。 摆出迎战姿势后瞬间移动至敌人面前， 并使出超高速的拔刀攻击。
description.en: Bushi's exclusive skill. Taking hold of the sword, it appears in front of an enemy in an instant and unleashes an ultra-fast sword draw attack.

description.zh: 使用暗之力连续发射数支高速箭追击敌人。
description.en: Fires off dark energy that homes in on an enemy.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人的位置燃起火焰之墙。 火墙将持续一段时间， 对碰到的敌人造成伤害。
description.en: Creates a wall of flames at the enemy's location. The wall of flames will remain for a while, and deal damage to the enemies it touches.

description.zh: 于敌人周围生成数个暗黑龙卷风。
description.en: Generates several dark vortexes around the enemy.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 它在死亡时身体会化为刀，由下一代继承。 若是继承的浪刃武士内心懦弱， 就会因为承受不住刀内亡魂的咒怨 化身为鬼刃武士，四处徘徊。
description.en: Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation. If the Bushi who inherits it has a weak heart, the voices of the dead will drive it mad. The madness turns it into Bushi Noct that endlessly wanders.

description.zh: 发动后会以居合斩攻击锁定的目标敌人。 此帕鲁使用的居合斩的威力将提升至(1.1~2.5)倍。 若它在队伍中，玩家的近战武器攻击伤害在非战斗时提升(30~65)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Iaigiri. When this Pal uses Iaigiri, it has a x(1.1~2.5) damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's melee weapon damage by (30~65)% but only when not in combat. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 发射水弹 笔直飞向对方。
description.en: Hurls a ball of water straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 朝敌人喷出冰冷空气， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 肚肚鳄的专用技能。 连续喷吐3颗体内尚未消化 但已经冷却的手榴弹进行攻击。 有时还会喷出更危险的东西……？
description.en: Munchill's exclusive skill. Coughs up three cold grenades kept undigested inside its body and lobs them at enemies. May occasionally spit out something more dangerous...?

description.zh: 从地面召唤出冰墙。 冰墙会持续一段时间， 并在承受一定伤害后碎裂。
description.en: Creates a wall of ice that rises from the ground. The ice wall remains standing for a while, and breaks after taking enough damage.

description.zh: 向前方发射高压水流。 片刻后，水流会向左右分岔。
description.en: Fires a high-pressure stream of water forward. After a short delay, the stream branches off to the left and right.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh: 它的口腔内部十分凉爽，只要把嘴闭上就是移动冷库。 其唾液中所含的特殊成份也有食品保鲜的作用。 虽然也不是不能被人类当做保存食物的冰箱， 至于卫生方面的问题，还是闭上嘴比较好。
description.en:
The inside of its mouth stays pleasantly cold, making it a natural fridge when closed.
Its saliva contains enzymes that prevent food from rotting.
Thus, it can serve as a food locker for humans— whether it is sanitary or not is another matter entirely.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，食材和料理的重量会减轻(30~60)%。并在冰属性帕鲁原有的防腐效果基础上，让腐败速度进一步(-30~-80)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, reduces the weight of ingredient and food by (30~60)%. When paired with another Ice Pal, their Rot Speed also reduces by (-30~-80)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 森猛犸及亚种的专用技能。 以巨大的身躯撼动大地， 对四周大范围的目标造成伤害。
description.en: Mammorest's exclusive skill. Uses its massive body to shake the earth, dealing damage over a wide area.

description.zh: 用地下尖锐的根部追击敌人 并从脚下贯穿敌人。
description.en: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh:
防御力+20%
免疫击退
description.en:
Defense +20%
Immune to Knockback

description.zh: 这种帕鲁背部的植被因个体而异。 有段时间曾被视为观赏帕鲁而受人喜爱 甚至曾经出现过森猛犸的专业修剪师。
description.en: The vegetation on its back varies between individuals. There is a long history of appreciating this veritable garden of a Pal, and there are even Mammorest pruning specialists.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间破坏树木的效率会提高(220~500)%，破坏矿石的效率会提高(500~2000)%。
description.en: Can be ridden. While mounted, increases logging efficiency by (220~500)% and mining efficiency by (500~2000)%.

description.zh: 将岩石从眼前的地上吸附起来 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的冰刃。
description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.zh: 森猛犸及亚种的专用技能。 以巨大的身躯撼动大地， 对四周大范围的目标造成伤害。
description.en: Mammorest's exclusive skill. Uses its massive body to shake the earth, dealing damage over a wide area.

description.en: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh:
防御力+20%
免疫击退
description.en:
Defense +20%
Immune to Knockback

description.zh: 这种帕鲁背部的植被因个体而异。 在雪猛犸的背上曾发现过被认为已经灭绝的冰冻植物种子， 在冷冻状态下保存良好。
description.en: The vegetation on its back varies between individuals. There was a time when seeds of presumed extinct plants were found still frozen on the back of a Mammorest Cryst.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间破坏树木的效率会提高(220~500)%，破坏矿石的效率会提高(500~2000)%。
description.en: Can be ridden. While mounted, increases logging efficiency by (220~500)% and mining efficiency by (500~2000)%.

description.zh: 发射水弹 笔直飞向对方。
description.en: Hurls a ball of water straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射大量泡沫 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 向前方发射高压水流。 片刻后，水流会向左右分岔。
description.en: Fires a high-pressure stream of water forward. After a short delay, the stream branches off to the left and right.

description.zh: 布偶鲨及亚种的专用技能。 从口中取出两把水枪， 左右轮流射出6发水弹。 最后双枪合并，射出一发强力水弹。
description.en: Finsider's exclusive skill. Draws twin water blasters from its mouth, firing six shots alternately left and right, then finishes by combining both blasters to unleash one powerful shot.

description.zh: 连续在敌人的脚下生成水柱结成的墙壁。
description.en: Continously creates walls made from water columns at the enemy's location.

description.zh: 猛烈地释放出水流 并向前方大范围横扫。
description.en: Shoots pressurized water at extreme velocities, sweeping over a wide area in front of it.

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh: 虽然看上去就像是什么生物自布偶中向外窥视一样， 但是试着将手探进去却又什么也摸不到。 不仅如此，手甚至可以无止境地向深处伸去， 也许，这里面就是宇宙吧。
description.en:
It looks like something is peeking out from inside a costume, but even if you reach inside, there’s nothing there.
In fact, you can keep reaching deeper and deeper.
Perhaps the universe itself lies within.

description.zh: 发动后，布偶鲨会将力量分给玩家，让玩家的攻击转变为水属性，且攻击力提升(30~50)%。 Lv.Skill1
description.en: When activated, Finsider changes the player's attack type to Water and increases Attack by (30~50)%. Lv.Skill1

description.zh: 瞄准后发射可笔直飞向敌人 的火焰弹。
description.en: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 面向敌人释放火焰， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Shoots flames at an enemy, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 召唤一束直线前进的水柱。
description.en: Generates a column of water that travels in a straight line.

description.zh: 布偶鲨及亚种的专用技能。 从口中取出两把水枪， 左右轮流射出6发水弹。 最后双枪合并，射出一发强力水弹。
description.en: Finsider's exclusive skill. Draws twin water blasters from its mouth, firing six shots alternately left and right, then finishes by combining both blasters to unleash one powerful shot.

description.zh: 使用火焰的力量做出复数个球体， 然后向敌人发射无数火球。
description.en: Creates multiple spheres of fiery energy, from which countless fireballs shoot towards the enemy.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh: 从口部伸手进去也什么都摸不到，甚至能无止境地探向深处。 认为这是某种异次元空间的研究者们，突发奇想将其当作睡袋 试图把整个身子挤进去，但却导致它干呕了。 看来，还是有体内这个概念的。
description.en:
Even if you reach into its mouth, there’s nothing inside—it just keeps going.
Thinking it might be an interdimensional space, one researcher tried climbing in like a sleeping bag.
But when the gag reflex kicked in, they realized...
it’s definitely part of the creature’s body.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，粉粉布偶鲨会帮忙分担负重，背包内武器的重量减轻(60~100)%，且玩家和帕鲁以火属性攻击克制的属性时伤害提升(25~40)%。（不可叠加） Lv.Skill1
description.en: While in party, Finsider Ignis helps carry supplies, reducing the weight of weapons in your inventory by (60~100)%. Also increases damage dealt by Player and Pals' Fire attacks when hitting the enemy's elemental weakness by (25~40)%. (Does not stack) Lv.Skill1

description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.en: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 它在寿命已尽时，会变成一株巨大的植物。 之后每十年绽放出美丽的花朵， 而新的花丽娜将会从中诞生。
description.en: A pal that transforms into a massive plant when at the end of its life. Once every ten years, a beautiful flower blooms and a new Petallia is born.

description.zh: 发动后，它会用花朵的治愈之力让玩家的生命值恢复(75~85)%。 若它在据点里，其他据点帕鲁的播种工作适应性等级+1。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, soothing blossoms restore the player's Health by (75~85)%. While at a base, increases the Planting Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 瞄准后发射可笔直飞向敌人 的火焰弹。
description.en: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 连续发射3支高速火箭 并追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three flaming arrows in succession that home in on an enemy.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成炙热的龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two flaming tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 使敌人周围地面活性化， 并在一定时间后爆炸。
description.en: Infuses the surrounding ground with energy, causing it to explode after a set amount of time.

description.zh: 使用火焰的力量做出复数个球体， 然后向敌人发射无数火球。
description.en: Creates multiple spheres of fiery energy, from which countless fireballs shoot towards the enemy.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 它在寿命已尽时，会自燃化作灰烬。 这周围的土壤则会因此变得非常肥沃， 此后的10年左右，无数的草木在此繁荣茂盛。
description.en: A Pal that burns away into a pile of ash upon the end of its life. The surrounding soil becomes incredibly fertile, allowing an abundance of vegetation to thrive for the following decade.

description.zh: 发动后，它会用花朵的治愈之力让玩家的生命值恢复(80~90)%。 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁受到的草属性伤害减轻(15~30)%，并且不会陷入缠绕状态。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, soothing blossoms restore the player's Health by (80~90)%. While in party, player and party Pals take (15~30)% less Grass damage, and are immune to Ivy-Covered. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 瞄准敌人发射 3发直线飞行的超高速风刃。
description.en: The user fires three high-speed blades of wind in quick succession that fly straight at enemies.

description.zh: 扇形射出锐利的风刃。
description.en: Launches sharp blades of air that fan out.

description.zh: 莉芳的专用技能。 迅速连续施展回旋踢后，释放气功波进行攻击。
description.en: Leafan's exclusive skill. Rapidly delivers a series of consecutive roundhouse kicks, finishing with an energy blast.
Shoots countless wind swords that fly straight towards the enemy.

description.zh: 发射风刃， 在击中敌人或树木时反弹并连续造成攻击， 最多可反弹4次。
description.en: Launches a blade of wind that rebounds off enemies or trees, striking repeatedly. Can ricochet up to four times.

description.zh: 在敌人前方生成风刃， 并对其发动十字斩击。
description.en: Conjures blades of wind in front of the enemy, converging to deliver a cutting cross attack.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 磨砺一脉相传的武术，唯有日日精进！ 沉溺情爱乃荒唐无稽！唯有日日修行！ 时机已至！向心仪之人发起攻势！唯有失恋！ 恋爱之术未曾传承！此情唯有未竟！
description.en: To hone the martial art passed down through a single bloodline: Daily training is the only way! Being distracted by romance? Unthinkable! Daily discipline is the only way! The time has come! Shoot my shot! Instant rejection, that’s all there is! The techniques of love were never passed down... Lingering regret, that’s all there is!

description.zh: 莉芳的攻击力和防御力，会随着队伍中其他草属性帕鲁的数量提升，每只增加(2~6)%。 levelvalue1
description.en: This Pal's Attack and Defense increase by (2~6)% for each other Grass Pal in your party. levelvalue1

description.en: Fires three flaming arrows in succession that home in on an enemy.

description.zh: 炎魔羊及亚种的专用技能。 接近目标后跳起同时以左手爪子向上挥击， 再用右手爪子迅速向下挥砍。
description.en: Incineram's exclusive skill. Draws near enemies using its left claw to slash them into the air before cutting them down with its right claw.

description.zh: 快速释放黑暗之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 它会在夜晚捕猎后，将猎物带回自己的领地。 那些被抓住的帕鲁，之后会遭受何种对待， 就不难想象了。
description.en: In the dark of night, this Pal snatches prey to bring back to its territory. What happens to those poor souls afterwards isn't too hard to imagine.

description.zh: 发动后会以狱火爪攻击锁定的目标敌人。 此帕鲁使用的狱火爪的威力将提升至(1.1~2.5)倍。 levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, attacks the targeted enemy with Hellfire Claw. When this Pal uses Hellfire Claw, it has a x(1.1~2.5) damage multiplier. levelvalue1

description.en: Incineram Noct's exclusive skill. Draws near enemies using its left dark claw to slash them into the air before cutting them down with its right dark claw.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 它只对帕鲁幼崽感兴趣，会将其掠走带回自己的领地。 不难想象，那些被夺走幼崽的帕鲁们会陷入多么绝望的境地。
description.en: It specifically targets baby Pals, taking them back to its domain. One can only imagine the profound despair of a parent whose child has been taken away.

description.zh: 发动后会以恶梦爪攻击锁定的目标敌人。 此帕鲁使用的恶梦爪的威力将提升至(1.1~2.5)倍。 levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, attacks the targeted enemy with Nightmare Claw. When this Pal uses Nightmare Claw, it has a x(1.1~2.5) damage multiplier. levelvalue1

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 快速放电 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

description.zh: 生成酸性云朵 在敌人头上下酸雨。
description.en: Creates acidic clouds that pour down acid rain on enemies.

description.zh: 生成可笔直前进的雷击。
description.en: Generates a lightning bolt that moves forward in a line.

description.zh: 在敌人头上生成3次落雷。
description.en: Generates lightning that strikes an enemy three times from above.

description.zh: 让自己化作避雷针引来雷电， 并在原地引发闪电爆炸。
description.en: Acts as a lightning rod, calling down thunderbolts that electrocute the surrounding area.

description.zh: 积蓄雷电之力 瞄准敌人释放强劲电击。
description.en: Charges electric energy before blasting enemies with a powerful shock.

description.zh: 召唤巨大的雷属性龙卷风。 龙卷风将追踪敌人缓慢移动。
description.en: Generates a huge tornado of lightning that moves slowly towards the enemy.

description.zh: 它对落单的帕鲁往往很和蔼可亲。 但要是有误会了什么的帕鲁因此缠上它， 它就会立即找来落雷解决掉对方。
description.en: Often kind to lonely Pals. However, the moment a Pal mistakes this for actual friendship, it seizes the opportunity to blast them with a thunderbolt.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，就会出现于玩家身边。 它会用雷属性的落雷追击敌对个体。 且该追击不会使猎物毙命。
description.en: While in party, appears near the player. Attacks hostile enemies with Electric bolts. These bolts will not reduce the target's Health below 1.

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 快速释放黑暗之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

description.en: Fires off dark energy that homes in on an enemy.

description.zh: 生成酸性云朵 在敌人头上下酸雨。
description.en: Creates acidic clouds that pour down acid rain on enemies.

description.zh: 在敌人头上生成3次落雷。
description.en: Generates lightning that strikes an enemy three times from above.

description.zh: 于敌人周围生成数个暗黑龙卷风。
description.en: Generates several dark vortexes around the enemy.

description.zh: 召唤雷电 在一定时间后生成大量落电。
description.en: Calls lightning that strikes an enemy after a set amount of time has passed.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 会温柔的对待落单的帕鲁 趁放松警惕时，招来落雷解决对方。 虽然是这么打算的，但是由于抓不住时机 结果就那么一直和睦相处了。
description.en: Often kind to lonely Pals, it plots to lure them into dropping their guard before striking them down. Yet, unable to find the right moment, it ends up making friends with them instead.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，就会出现于玩家身边。 它会用暗属性的落雷追击敌对个体。 且该追击不会使猎物毙命。
description.en: While in party, appears near the player. Attacks hostile enemies with Dark bolts. These bolts will not reduce the target's Health below 1.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.en: Fires three flaming arrows in succession that home in on an enemy.

description.zh: 火麒麟的专用技能。 带着缠绕全身的火焰向前猛冲。 途经之处均会留下滚滚火焰。
description.en: Pyrin's exclusive skill. Charges forward while engulfed in a veil of flames. Flames continue to burn in its path.

description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 这种帕鲁全身都是高效的散热器官， 使它能够发挥惊人的耐力。 当有人坐在它身上时，它会注意不烫伤对方。
description.en: Its entire body has evolved into a highly efficient radiator, gifting it with astounding stamina. If someone rides it, this Pal takes caution not to burn them.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间玩家的攻击会转变为火属性，且攻击力提升(5~20)%。
description.en: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Fire and increases Attack by (5~20)%.

description.en: Shoots flames at an enemy, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 这种帕鲁会燃烧神秘的暗物质以获取能量， 并将剩余的暗粒子排出体外。 当有人坐在它身上时，会控制排放量，以免该人被黑暗侵蚀。
description.en: It burns mysterious dark matter as energy and expels the remaining particles from its body. If someone rides it, they should take care so as not to gallop down the path of darkness.

description.en: Hurls a ball of water straight at an enemy.

description.en: Quickly discharges draconic energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 发射大量泡沫 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方呼出蕴含龙之力的气息 ，持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Exhales breath imbued with draconic energy, dealing continuous damage to those in front of it.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大水球 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of water and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 召唤大量小陨石 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Summons numerous small meteorites and launches them at an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh: 增加饱腹度下降速度+10.0%
description.en: Hunger decreases +10.0% faster.

description.zh: 虽然看起来无精打采，但实际上相当凶猛。 它将眼中所见之物全部视为食物， 并不惜一切代价捕食。
description.en: Contrary to its blasé appearance, it's quite ferocious. It perceives everything in its sight as prey and will stop at nothing to devour it.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间它还能用导弹发射器连续攻击。
description.en: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的雷电球。
description.en: Releases lightning orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 佩克龙突发奇想， 是时候让自己做出些改变了。 那个瞬间，灵感就像雷电贯穿了它的全身！
description.en: One day, Relaxaurus had an idea. Maybe it was about time for a change. Just then, an electric shock raced through its body!

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间它还能用导弹发射器连续攻击。
description.en: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 在上空生成尖锐的冰柱 瞄准敌人后发射冰柱。
description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的冰刃。
description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.zh: 朝敌人喷出冰冷空气， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 当极光在夜空中闪耀时， 这种帕鲁会仰望天空，以美妙的嗓音歌唱。 但这个习性也让它非常容易被敌人锁定。
description.en: On nights when the aurora is visible, it looks up towards the sky and begins to howl a beautiful song. This does, however, leave it vulnerable to attacks from enemies.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，冰属性帕鲁的攻击力会提升(15~30)%。（不可叠加） 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会掉落结冰器官。 levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases Attack of Ice Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Ice Organ when assigned to Ranch. levelvalue1

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的雷电球。
description.en: Releases lightning orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 快速放电 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

description.zh: 生成可笔直前进的雷击。
description.en: Generates a lightning bolt that moves forward in a line.

description.zh: 迅雷鸟的专用技能。 先在敌人所在位置降下落雷。 然后在空中突进的同时，于左右两侧召唤落雷。
description.en: Beakon's exclusive skill. First, it strikes the enemy's location with lightning. Then, while gliding forward, it drops lightning to the left and right.

description.zh: 在敌人头上生成3次落雷。
description.en: Generates lightning that strikes an enemy three times from above.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成砂砾龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄雷电之力 瞄准敌人释放强劲电击。
description.en: Charges electric energy before blasting enemies with a powerful shock.

description.zh: 召唤巨大的雷属性龙卷风。 龙卷风将追踪敌人缓慢移动。
description.en: Generates a huge tornado of lightning that moves slowly towards the enemy.

description.zh: 虽说与燧火鸟外形相似，但并无任何关系。 它会采用快速俯冲，并用尖锐的喙击败敌人。 那身姿宛如落雷一般。
description.en: Some think it is a related species to [[Ragnahawk]], but there is in fact no connection. Using its sharp beak, it descends on its prey in a quick motion that resembles a bolt of lightning.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 骑乘期间玩家的攻击会转变为雷属性，且攻击力提升(5~20)%。 迅雷鸟的移动速度，会随着队伍中其他雷属性帕鲁的数量提升，每只增加(5~25)%。
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Electric and increases Attack by (5~20)%. This Pal's Movement Speed increases by (5~25)% for each other Electric Pal in your party. (Excluding Beakon)

description.zh: 在上空生成尖锐的冰柱 瞄准敌人后发射冰柱。
description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的冰刃。
description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.zh: 朝敌人喷出冰冷空气， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 在空中生成复数个冰锥， 瞄准敌人一齐射出。
description.en: Generates multiple sharp ice blocks in the sky and fires them at the enemy.

description.zh: 召唤朝前方三个方向推进的冰柱
description.en: Generates pillars of ice that move in a straight line in three directions.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 疾霜鸟的专用技能。 先从敌人脚下突起冰柱。 然后在空中突进的同时，于左右两侧接连升起冰柱。
description.en: Beakon Cryst's exclusive skill Ice first erupts from the ground at the target's location. Then glides forward in a rushing charge, causing ice to burst from the ground on both sides along its path.

description.zh: 特化适应了寒冷环境，即便身形纤细也能抵御严寒。 从高空俯冲攻击的威力惊人， 要比喻的话，就像巨大的冰锥从天而降一般。
description.en: Perfectly adapted to colder environments, it hardly feels the cold despite its slender form. Its diving plunge carries tremendous force, as if a giant icicle were dropping straight from the sky.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 骑乘期间玩家的攻击会转变为冰属性，且攻击力提升(5~20)%。 疾霜鸟的移动速度，会随着队伍中其他冰属性帕鲁的数量提升，每只增加(5~25)%。
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Ice and increases Attack by (5~20)%. This Pal's Movement Speed increases by (5~25)% for each other Ice Pal in your party. (Excluding Beakon Cryst)

description.zh: 散发着光芒的拟饵照亮了黑暗。 被这光亮吸引来的帕鲁如果被冥灯鱼发现的话，那可是插翅难逃了。 它会一直作为其向导，直到该帕鲁平安返回自己的家。
description.en:
With its shining lure, it illuminates the darkness.
The wandering Pals drawn in by the light stand no chance of escape once spotted by Ghangler.
No matter how far, it will keep guiding them until they get home safe and sound.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在水上移动。 冥灯鱼的移动速度，会随着队伍中其他暗属性或水属性帕鲁的数量提升，每只增加(5~25)%。
description.en: Can be ridden to travel on water. This Pal's Movement Speed increases by (5~25)% for each other Dark or Water Pal in your party. (Excluding Ghangler)

description.zh: 剧烈燃烧的拟饵，在烧烤猎物时也能用上。 被烤肉香气吸引来的帕鲁如果被炙灯鱼发现的话，那可是插翅难逃了。 它会一直热情款待，直到被吸引来的帕鲁肚子吃撑。
description.en:
Its blazing lure doubles as a grill for roasting prey.
Drawn in by the delicious aroma, Pals have no hope of escape once Ghangler Ignis sets its sights on them.
In the end, they’re treated to a hearty meal—until everyone’s full.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在水上移动。 炙灯鱼的移动速度，会随着队伍中其他火属性或水属性帕鲁的数量提升，每只增加(5~25)%。
description.en: Can be ridden to travel on water. This Pal's Movement Speed increases by (5~25)% for each other Fire or Water Pal in your party. (Excluding Ghangler Ignis)

description.zh: 快速连续向敌人进行啃咬攻击。
description.en: Bites rapidly in succession to attack enemies.

description.zh: 快速地向敌人飞扑，咬住敌人进行攻击。
description.en: Quickly lunges at the enemy and bites to deal damage.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 快速放电 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的雷电球。
description.en: Releases lightning orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 霹雳犬的专用技能。 在前方呼唤连续不断的雷击， 在落下的雷电间高速突进。
description.en: Rayhound's exclusive skill. Summons lightning one after another in front, then charges forward at high speed through the gaps between the falling bolts.

description.zh: 发射雷电球 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires an electric ball that slowly pursues an enemy.

description.zh: 生成可笔直前进的雷击。
description.en: Generates a lightning bolt that moves forward in a line.

description.zh: 积蓄雷电之力 瞄准敌人释放强劲电击。
description.en: Charges electric energy before blasting enemies with a powerful shock.

description.zh: 召唤巨大的雷属性龙卷风。 龙卷风将追踪敌人缓慢移动。
description.en: Generates a huge tornado of lightning that moves slowly towards the enemy.

description.zh: 当它全速冲刺时就宛如一道闪电一般。 如果霹雳犬同类之间发生冲突， 更会不断响起雷鸣般的轰隆声。
description.en: At full speed, it could be mistaken for a bolt of lightning. When two Rayhounds collide, a thunderous roar echoes through the air.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间可以进行2段跳跃。 霹雳犬的移动速度，会随着队伍中其他雷属性帕鲁的数量提升，每只增加(5~25)%。
description.en: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. This Pal's Movement Speed increases by (5~25)% for each other Electric Pal in your party. (Excluding Rayhound)

description.zh: 快速连续向敌人进行啃咬攻击。
description.en: Bites rapidly in succession to attack enemies.

description.zh: 快速地向敌人飞扑，咬住敌人进行攻击。
description.en: Quickly lunges at the enemy and bites to deal damage.

description.en: Rayhound Cryst's exclusive skill. Generates ice pillars ahead and charges forward at high speed through the gaps between them.

description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 它若在雪原上全速奔跑，就会扬起大量飞雪。 由于完全看不到彼此， 导致凛光犬间经常发生交通事故。
description.en: Sprinting across the tundra at full speed kicks up a blinding blizzard, leading to constant Rayhound Cryst collisions due to zero visibility.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间可以进行2段跳跃。 若它在队伍中，冰属性帕鲁的防御力会提升(15~30)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. While in party, increases Defense of Ice Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.zh: 快速释放黑暗之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 将岩石从眼前的地上吸附起来 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 冥铠蝎及亚种的专用技能。 高高跃起，用尾巴狠狠地将猎物刺穿。 尾部含有毒素。
description.en: Menasting's exclusive skill. Jumps high and forcefully stabs its prey with its tail. The poison from the tail is deadly.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的岩石长矛。
description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 它的本体是一种能量体，内部是空的。 它会将猎物活生生地塞进外壳并将其吸收。 周围总是不断回响着地狱般的呻吟声。
description.en: Being made of pure energy, its insides are completely hollow. This Pal crams still-living prey into its hollow body, where it absorbs them. Hellish screams of pain can often be heard coming from inside this Pal.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家的防御力将提升(5~10)%，且击倒雷属性帕鲁时获得的掉落道具增加(40~80)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, player's Defense increases by (5~10)%, and Electric Pals drop (40~80)% more items when defeated. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成砂砾龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.
