description.en: Menasting's exclusive skill. Jumps high and forcefully stabs its prey with its tail. The poison from the tail is deadly.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的岩石长矛。
description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 撼动地面， 使大块岩石射向四面八方
description.en: Causes the ground to shake before hurling a massive stone mass at its surroundings.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 它的本体是一种能量体，内部是空的。 通过将砂石和矿物填充进外壳，得以实现了压倒性的质量。 被其击中的生物只能发出如地狱般的呻吟声。
description.en: Being made of pure energy, its insides are completely hollow. It stuffs earth and minerals into its outer shell, achieving overwhelming mass. Those who are struck by it can only let out hellish groans.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家的防御力将提升(5~10)%，且击倒雷属性帕鲁时获得的掉落道具增加(40~80)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, player's Defense increases by (5~10)%, and Electric Pals drop (40~80)% more items when defeated. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 用地下尖锐的根部追击敌人 并从脚下贯穿敌人。
description.en: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

description.zh: 在敌人的位置和其周围刺出尖锐的根刺。
description.en: Sprouts sharp roots in and around the enemy's location.

description.zh: 发射风刃， 在击中敌人或树木时反弹并连续造成攻击， 最多可反弹4次。
description.en: Launches a blade of wind that rebounds off enemies or trees, striking repeatedly. Can ricochet up to four times.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 在敌人前方生成风刃， 并对其发动十字斩击。
description.en: Conjures blades of wind in front of the enemy, converging to deliver a cutting cross attack.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 当某种感情变得强烈时，它的尖刺就会伸缩。 被精心养育的球抱苞，会令人忍不住想要拥入怀中， 但是十有八九都是悲剧结尾。
description.en: Its spikes react to its emotions. A dearly cherished Needoll is something one may instinctively want to embrace. But more often than not, it ends in a tragic accident.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁对缠绕状态的敌人造成的伤害将提升(50~65)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Ivy-Covered by (50~65)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.en: Focuses energy into the body and scatters poison orbs in all directions.

description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 当某种感情变得强烈时，它的尖刺就会伸缩。 在满满的爱意中成长的妖抱苞， 总是动不动就爱往主人怀里钻， 但若要接纳它的爱，就要一并接纳它带来的痛。
description.en: Its spikes react to its emotions. A well-loved Needoll Noct clings to its owner, but accepting that love means accepting the pain too.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，会为玩家的攻击附加(2~6)点缠绕异常状态值。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, the player's attacks increase Ivy-Covered buildup by (2~6). (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.en: Reindrix's exclusive skill. Charges at an enemy with antlers adorned in ice.

description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.en: Its transparent cerulean antlers glow with the cold of absolute zero. Any who touch them with their bare hands are instantly frozen and smashed to pieces.

description.en: Mossanda's exclusive skill. Winds up its right arm before striking an enemy with a devastating punch.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 用地下尖锐的根部追击敌人 并从脚下贯穿敌人。
description.en: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 它拥有令人难以置信的力量。 在某次实验中，它甚至可以轻松撕破3000张叠在一起的纸。 你我都该庆幸它并不是肉食性帕鲁。
description.en: A Pal so powerful it's hard to believe. In one experiment, this Pal tore through 3,000 sheets of paper at once! It's only by some miracle that this Pal isn't a meat-eater.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间它还能用榴弹发射器连续攻击。
description.en: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a grenade launcher while mounted.

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的雷电球。
description.en: Releases lightning orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 快速放电 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

description.zh: 生成可笔直前进的雷击。
description.en: Generates a lightning bolt that moves forward in a line.

description.zh: 雷胖达的专用技能。 不停转动右臂，向前方挥出带电拳击。
description.en: Mossanda Lux's exclusive skill. Winds up its right arm before delivering an electrically charged punch.

description.zh: 在敌人头上生成3次落雷。
description.en: Generates lightning that strikes an enemy three times from above.

description.zh: 让自己化作避雷针引来雷电， 并在原地引发闪电爆炸。
description.en: Acts as a lightning rod, calling down thunderbolts that electrocute the surrounding area.

description.zh: 积蓄雷电之力 瞄准敌人释放强劲电击。
description.en: Charges electric energy before blasting enemies with a powerful shock.

description.zh: 它拥有令人难以置信的力量。 可以将电力转为神经信号，突破身体能力的极限。 只要提到最强生物，就必定有它。
description.en: A Pal whose power is truly shocking. By altering the electrical currents in its body, this Pal's been able to overload its own strength. When it comes to sheer power, this Pal may be top of the list.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间它还能用榴弹发射器连续攻击。
description.en: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a grenade launcher while mounted.

description.zh: 在上空生成尖锐的冰柱 瞄准敌人后发射冰柱。
description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.zh: 用蕴藏龙之力的能量弹 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with draconic energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 疾旋鼬及亚种的专用技能。 短时间蓄力后，向前跃起。 在着地时因为害怕一直都是紧闭着眼睛。
description.en: Chillet's exclusive skill. Gathers a bit of strength and leaps forward. Always shuts its eyes tight in fear when landing.

description.zh: 快速释放龙之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges draconic energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 向前方呼出蕴含龙之力的气息 ，持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Exhales breath imbued with draconic energy, dealing continuous damage to those in front of it.

description.zh: 朝敌人喷出冰冷空气， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 召唤大量小陨石 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Summons numerous small meteorites and launches them at an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 它能将身体蜷缩起来，并以迅疾的速度旋转移动。 过去人们会在被驯服的疾旋鼬身上装上放牛奶的袋子再放牧， 以此利用它的旋转能力来制作黄油。
description.en:
It can curl up its body and roll around at extremely high speeds.
Long ago, people would tie bags of milk to domesticated Chillet as they grazed to produce butter using this spinning force.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间玩家的攻击会转变为龙属性，且攻击力提升(5~20)%。
description.en: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Dragon and increases Attack by (5~20)%.

description.zh: 瞄准后发射可笔直飞向敌人 的火焰弹。
description.en: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 快速释放龙之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges draconic energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 连续发射3支高速火箭 并追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three flaming arrows in succession that home in on an enemy.

description.zh: 面向敌人释放火焰， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Shoots flames at an enemy, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 疾旋鼬及亚种的专用技能。 短时间蓄力后，向前跃起。 在着地时因为害怕一直都是紧闭着眼睛。
description.en: Chillet's exclusive skill. Gathers a bit of strength and leaps forward. Always shuts its eyes tight in fear when landing.

description.zh: 在敌人的位置燃起火焰之墙。 火墙将持续一段时间， 对碰到的敌人造成伤害。
description.en: Creates a wall of flames at the enemy's location. The wall of flames will remain for a while, and deal damage to the enemies it touches.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 召唤大量小陨石 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Summons numerous small meteorites and launches them at an enemy.

description.zh: 它能将身体蜷缩起来，一路火花带闪电地旋转移动。 另外在情绪激动时也会放出火花。 如果过度抚摸就会燃起来。
description.en: It can curl up its body and roll around so fast that sparks fly. Sparks also fly when it feels excited. If you stroke it too much, this pal will get fired up, literally!

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间玩家的攻击会转变为火属性，且攻击力提升(5~20)%。
description.en: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Fire and increases Attack by (5~20)%.

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 连续发射3支高速火箭 并追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three flaming arrows in succession that home in on an enemy.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成砂砾龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 燧火鸟的专用技能。 飞向前方的同时，朝正前、右、左啄击， 并通过点火引发小规模的爆炸。
description.en: Ragnahawk's exclusive skill. While flapping forward, it strikes with its beak to ignite fires in front, right, and left, causing a small explosion.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成炙热的龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two flaming tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 面向敌人释放火焰， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Shoots flames at an enemy, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 召唤巨大的雷属性龙卷风。 龙卷风将追踪敌人缓慢移动。
description.en: Generates a huge tornado of lightning that moves slowly towards the enemy.

description.zh: 虽说与迅雷鸟外形相似，但并无任何关系。 它主要以岩石为食，因此经年累月后， 不只是鸟喙，它的整个头部也变得十分坚硬。
description.en: Some think it is a related species to [[Beakon]], but there is in fact no connection. It mainly eats rocks, and after many long years its beak and head have hardened to accommodate this diet.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 骑乘期间玩家的攻击会转变为火属性，且攻击力提升(5~20)%。
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Fire and increases Attack by (5~20)%.

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 面向敌人释放火焰， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Shoots flames at an enemy, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 在敌人的位置燃起火焰之墙。 火墙将持续一段时间， 对碰到的敌人造成伤害。
description.en: Creates a wall of flames at the enemy's location. The wall of flames will remain for a while, and deal damage to the enemies it touches.

description.zh: 撼动地面， 使大块岩石射向四面八方
description.en: Causes the ground to shake before hurling a massive stone mass at its surroundings.

description.zh: 向上空喷射无数熔岩弹。 一段时间后，射出的熔岩弹将如雨一般散落在周围。
description.en: Fires countless volcanic bombs into the sky. After a while, the bombs rain down around their originator.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 流焰龙的专用技能。 从口中吐出岩浆团进行攻击。 在落点形成岩浆池， 对碰到的敌人造成伤害。
description.en: Moldron's exclusive skill. Spits a mass of magma from its mouth. The impact creates magma pools that damage enemies on contact.

description.zh: 流焰龙的专用技能。 从口中喷涌而出炽热光束，焚烧大地。 灼热的地面会形成岩浆池， 对碰到的敌人造成伤害。
description.en: Moldron's exclusive skill. Emits a thermal beam from its mouth that scorches the ground. Heated ground forms magma pools that damage enemies on contact.

description.zh: 健康的个体，背部熔岩的流动也会十分顺畅。 如果生活习惯不健康，熔岩流动也会越来越滞涩。 最坏会发生熔岩堵塞，最后突然大爆发。
description.en: In a healthy individual, the lava on its back flows smoothly. However, a poor lifestyle will gradually worsen its circulation, eventually causing a lava clog that results in a sudden, massive explosion.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 流焰龙的攻击力，会随着队伍中其他火属性或地属性帕鲁的数量提升，每只增加(4~8)%。
description.en: Can be ridden as a mount. This Pal's Attack increases by (4~8)% for each other Fire or Ground Pal in your party.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的冰刃。
description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.zh: 朝敌人喷出冰冷空气， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 召唤朝前方三个方向推进的冰柱
description.en: Generates pillars of ice that move in a straight line in three directions.

description.zh: 撼动地面， 使大块岩石射向四面八方
description.en: Causes the ground to shake before hurling a massive stone mass at its surroundings.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 川霜龙的专用技能。 从口中吐出冰块进行攻击。 落地后会使地面冻结，并形成霜层， 冻结碰到的敌人并对其造成伤害。
description.en: Moldron Cryst's exclusive skill. Spits a chunk of ice from its mouth. The impact creates frost pools that freeze and damage enemies on contact.

description.zh: 川霜龙的专用技能。 从口中喷吐冻结光线，使大地结冰。 冻结的地面会形成霜层， 冻结碰到的敌人并对其造成伤害。
description.en: Moldron Cryst's exclusive skill. Fires a freezing beam from the mouth that coats the ground in ice. Frozen ground forms frost pools that freeze and damage enemies on contact.

description.zh: 健康的个体，背部物质的温度也会十分稳定。 但一旦心跳过快，温度便会失去稳定。 最坏会发生气化或凝固， 最后突然休克而亡。
description.en: In a healthy individual, the substance flowing along its back maintains a stable temperature. However, if its heartbeat quickens, the temperature destabilizes, eventually triggering vaporization or crystallization that results in a sudden, abrupt death from shock.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁以冰属性攻击克制的属性时伤害提升(25~40)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals' Ice attacks when hitting the enemy's elemental weakness by (25~40)%. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 扇形射出锐利的风刃。
description.en: Launches sharp blades of air that fan out.

description.zh: 咕咕桑葩的专用技能。 冲刺助跑后向敌人发动猛烈踢击。
description.en: Palumba's exclusive skill. Dashes to build up speed, then launches a devastating airborne kick at its target.

description.zh: 发射风刃， 在击中敌人或树木时反弹并连续造成攻击， 最多可反弹4次。
description.en: Launches a blade of wind that rebounds off enemies or trees, striking repeatedly. Can ricochet up to four times.

description.zh: 在敌人前方生成风刃， 并对其发动十字斩击。
description.en: Conjures blades of wind in front of the enemy, converging to deliver a cutting cross attack.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 会用其独特的舞蹈打乱对手的节奏。 在领地争夺时，首先被对方带节奏的那一方就是败者。 求爱、消遣、万事唯有舞蹈！ 话说，当它面向人类跳舞时，那又代表着什么意思呢？
description.en:
Disrupts enemies’ rhythm with a signature dance.
In turf battles, the first to fall in sync with the other’s rhythm loses.
Courtship, boredom, battle—it all comes down to dance!
Now then, what could a dance aimed at a human possibly mean?

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 在草地上时，移动速度提高(155~240)%。
description.en: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased by (155~240)% while mounted on grass.

description.zh: 发射水弹 笔直飞向对方。
description.en: Hurls a ball of water straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 碎岩龟的专用技能。 以全身高速旋转的方式移动， 并以钻头刨削敌人，持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Digtoise's exclusive skill. Moves while spinning its whole body at high speed. Drills through enemies, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 将岩石从眼前的地上吸附起来 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成砂砾龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大水球 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of water and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的岩石长矛。
description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.
Defense +10%

description.zh: 过去有则寓言故事叫做「碎岩龟的钻头」。 那是个关于拥有最强甲壳和钻头的碎岩龟 思考矛盾的道德故事。
description.en: A Digtoise possessing the strongest shell and the only drill capable of piercing it, ponders the contradictions of the world in the popular children's tale, |Digtoise's Fable|.

description.zh: 发动后会进入甲壳回旋状态。 它会一边旋转一边跟随玩家，且破坏矿石的效率将提升(800~2000)%。
description.en: When activated, enters the Shell Spin state. Follows the player while spinning, increasing ore mining efficiency by (800~2000)%.

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 连理龙及亚种的专用技能。 侧身站立， 然后向前猛撞敌人，并将其击飞。
description.en: Broncherry's exclusive skill. Turns sideways before tackling enemies in front of it, sending them flying into the air.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 用地下尖锐的根部追击敌人 并从脚下贯穿敌人。
description.en: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh:
防御力+20%
免疫击退
description.en:
Defense +20%
Immune to Knockback

description.zh: 它在交配前后，体味会发生巨大变化。 人们认为它找到伴侣后的香味芳香迷人， 并将其称为「初恋之香」。
description.en: Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing. It exudes a pleasing aroma after finding a partner, which is called the |Fragrance of First Love.|

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，捡到的帕鲁蛋将有(35~45)%的概率变为头目帕鲁蛋。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, Pal Eggs you pick up have a (35~45)% chance of becoming an Alpha Pal Egg. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 发射水弹 笔直飞向对方。
description.en: Hurls a ball of water straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射大量泡沫 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 连理龙及亚种的专用技能。 侧身站立， 然后向前猛撞敌人，并将其击飞。
description.en: Broncherry's exclusive skill. Turns sideways before tackling enemies in front of it, sending them flying into the air.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 海誓龙的专用技能。 侧身站立，然后向前猛撞敌人， 溅起水花并将其击飞。
description.en: Broncherry Aqua's exclusive skill. Turns sideways before tackling enemies in front of it, sending them flying with a burst of water.

description.zh: 用地下尖锐的根部追击敌人 并从脚下贯穿敌人。
description.en: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大水球 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of water and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 猛烈地释放出水流 并向前方大范围横扫。
description.en: Shoots pressurized water at extreme velocities, sweeping over a wide area in front of it.

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh:
防御力+20%
免疫击退
description.en:
Defense +20%
Immune to Knockback

description.zh: 它在交配前后，体味会发生巨大变化。 人们认为它找到伴侣前的香味芳香迷人， 将其称为「纯洁之香」。
description.en: Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing. It exudes a pleasing aroma before finding a partner, which is called the "perfume of purity."

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，捡到的帕鲁蛋将有(45~55)%的概率变为头目帕鲁蛋。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, Pal Eggs you pick up have a (45~55)% chance of becoming an Alpha Pal Egg. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 发射水弹 笔直飞向对方。
description.en: Hurls a ball of water straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 发射大量泡沫 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大水球 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of water and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的岩石长矛。
description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 猛烈地释放出水流 并向前方大范围横扫。
description.en: Shoots pressurized water at extreme velocities, sweeping over a wide area in front of it.

description.zh: 这种帕鲁过于放松时，所有反应都会变得极为迟缓。 即使身中28刀，大概也要到隔天早上 它才会发现自己早该死去。
description.en: When too relaxed, its reaction time drastically declines. Even if it were sliced from head to tail, it probably wouldn't even realize that it should be dead until the next morning.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，地属性帕鲁的攻击力会提升(15~30)%。（不可叠加） 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会掉落优质帕鲁油。 levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases Attack of Ground Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops High Quality Pal Oil when assigned to Ranch. levelvalue1

description.zh: 身体表面有着惊人的反射率。 不仅如此，它各处神经的反射速度比趴趴鲶还慢！
description.en: Its body reflects light with astounding clarity. Even more shocking, its reflexes are somehow even slower than Dumud.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，打倒的敌人掉落的金币提升(100~200)%。（不可叠加） 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就会掉落优质帕鲁油或者小概率掉落金币。 levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases amount of Gold Coin dropped by enemies by +(100~200)%. Sometimes drops High Quality Pal Oil when assigned to Ranch, with a small chance to drop Gold Coin. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 用地下尖锐的根部追击敌人 并从脚下贯穿敌人。
description.en: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

description.zh: 梁叶龙的专用技能。 从修长的颈部缓缓释放出草属性的气息， 逐渐向四周扩散。
description.en: Braloha's exclusive skill. From the base of its long neck to the tip of its snout, it gradually spreads the breath of grass element.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh:
防御力+20%
免疫击退
description.en:
Defense +20%
Immune to Knockback

description.zh: 吐息中混合着的疑似花粉的， 无论什么植物都能授粉成功的奇妙物质。 对于那些身上长有植物的帕鲁而言，这是个令兽心情复杂的家伙。
description.en:
Its breath carries a miraculous, pollen-like substance that pollinates any plant it touches.
For plant-based Pals, being near it can be a bit… complicated.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在据点里，分派到配种牧场的帕鲁产蛋速度加快(20~50)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in your base, increases the egg production speed of Pals assigned to Breeding Farm by (20~50)%. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 快速连续向敌人进行啃咬攻击。
description.en: Bites rapidly in succession to attack enemies.

description.zh: 快速地向敌人飞扑，咬住敌人进行攻击。
description.en: Quickly lunges at the enemy and bites to deal damage.

description.zh: 瞄准后发射可笔直飞向敌人 的火焰弹。
description.en: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 苍焰狼的专用技能。 带着缠绕全身的青蓝火焰，气势汹汹地向前猛冲。
description.en: Kitsun's exclusive skill. Charges forward with great speed while enveloped in intense blue flames.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成炙热的龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two flaming tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 使敌人周围地面活性化， 并在一定时间后爆炸。
description.en: Infuses the surrounding ground with energy, causing it to explode after a set amount of time.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 性格极为纤细敏感， 遇到讨厌的事物，就会躲在洞窟里不愿出来。 而古人们也认为，若苍焰狼躲藏起来则是一种不吉之兆。
description.en:
Despite its appearance, Kitsun is extremely sensitive and will flee into a cave when spooked.
Long ago, it was considered an ill omen if one ran away from you.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁受到的冰属性伤害减轻(15~30)%，并且不会陷入冻结状态。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take (15~30)% less Ice damage and are immune to Freeze. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 召唤巨大的雷属性龙卷风。 龙卷风将追踪敌人缓慢移动。
description.en: Generates a huge tornado of lightning that moves slowly towards the enemy.

description.zh: 它比较喜欢吃生肉，但每次吃到肚里的都成了全熟的肉。 这是因为它以灼热利爪为武器， 但却不知猎物会因此被烤成焦炭。

While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating tainted meat.
This is due to its dark claws, which it uses as its weapon—it simply doesn't realize its prey gets cursed.

description.en: Creates a wall of ice that rises from the ground. The ice wall remains standing for a while, and breaks after taking enough damage.

description.zh: 在空中生成复数个冰锥， 瞄准敌人一齐射出。
description.en: Generates multiple sharp ice blocks in the sky and fires them at the enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 大范围的在敌人脚下生成冰柱穿刺。
description.en: Throws icicles in a wide area from under the enemy's feet.

description.zh: 对时间很敏感，每天早晨必然在固定的时间醒来。 帕洛斯群岛的一天之所以被分为24个片段， 据说就是因为从正面看开屏的白真雪雀时， 尾羽上分割的空白区域有24个的缘故。
description.en:
So precise is its sense of time that it awakens at the exact same hour every morning.
According to Palpagos lore, a day was divided into 24 parts because when Frostplume spreads its tail feathers wide, it reveals a pattern with 24 distinct spaces.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，受到白真雪雀释放的冷气影响，玩家会更专注，武器重新装弹的速度提升(20~50)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, Frostplume's icy aura sharpens focus, increasing the player's reload speeds by (20~50)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.en: Fires countless volcanic bombs into the sky. After a while, the bombs rain down around their originator.

description.zh: 虽然摆出一副双手叉腰，一副如画般的神气姿态， 但是实际上，由于尾巴和头发过于沉重， 它不过是为了不摔倒而拼命保持平衡罢了。
description.en: It appears to be striking a heroic pose, but the reality is that it's simply bracing itself against the weight of its tail and hair to avoid toppling over.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家的攻击击中点燃状态的敌人时，会使敌人周边燃烧，对碰到火焰的敌人持续造成相当于玩家攻击力(15~30)%的伤害。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Burn, the enemy creates flames around itself, dealing continuous damage equal to (15~30)% of the player's attack damage to enemies that come into contact with them. (Does not stack.) levelvalue1

description.zh: 在上空生成尖锐的冰柱 瞄准敌人后发射冰柱。
description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的冰刃。
description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.zh: 朝敌人喷出冰冷空气， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大水球 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of water and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 它喜欢下雨天气，每当下雨， 它总会站在原地不动享受雨水。 火绒狐会常常跑来躲雨。
description.en: A Pal that likes the rain, and will often bask in rain showers until the weather clears up. On rainy days, Foxparks can often be found taking shelter beneath it.

description.zh: 发动后会以钻石星辰攻击锁定的目标敌人。 此帕鲁使用的钻石星辰的威力将提升至(1.1~2.5)倍。 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会制造出优质的布。 levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Blizzard Spike. When this Pal uses Blizzard Spike, it has a x(1.1~2.5) damage multiplier. Sometimes makes High Quality Cloth when assigned to Ranch. levelvalue1

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 扇形发射锋利的气刃。
description.en: Sends out sharp blades of air in a fan shape.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 它喜欢凝望天空， 常常静静地伫立在那里。 经常成为小型帕鲁们聚会的场所。
description.en: A Pal that loves gazing into the void, and will often remain completely still. It frequently becomes a gathering spot for smaller Pals.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，无属性帕鲁的防御力会提升(15~30)%。（不可叠加） 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会制作优质的布。 levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases Defense of Neutral Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack) Sometimes makes High Quality Cloth when assigned to Ranch. levelvalue1

description.zh: 瞄准后发射可笔直飞向敌人 的火焰弹。
description.en: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 连续发射3支高速火箭 并追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three flaming arrows in succession that home in on an enemy.

description.zh: 快速释放黑暗之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 噬魂兽的专用技能。 缓慢奔跑的同时，不断召唤摇曳的火球飞向敌人。
description.en: Maraith's exclusive skill. While running slowly, it continuously launches flickering fireballs toward the enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 它喜欢生物濒死时身体所散发的独特气味。 因此一旦被噬魂兽黏上了， 也就代表着大限将至。
description.en: It relishes the peculiar scent living things give off when they are near death. If a Maraith has taken a liking to you, it is safe to assume that is why.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，每次打倒敌人时，全体队伍帕鲁的主动技能冷却时间缩短(30~60)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, all Party Pals' Active Skill cooldowns are reduced by (30~60)% whenever you defeat an enemy. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 用地下尖锐的根部追击敌人 并从脚下贯穿敌人。
description.en: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

description.zh: 在敌人的位置和其周围刺出尖锐的根刺。
description.en: Sprouts sharp roots in and around the enemy's location.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 吸入了大量菇咚的孢子会陷入一种神志不清的状态。 偶尔会见到它呆站着一动不动， 它这不是在模仿蘑菇， 而是吸自己的孢子吸嗨了。
description.en: Inhaling large amounts of its spores will put you into a trance. Sometimes, if Shroomer appears motionless, it's not because it's mimicking a mushroom, but rather because it's high off its own spores.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会掉落蘑菇或者洞穴蘑菇。
description.en: Can be ridden. Sometimes drops Mushroom or Cavern Mushroom when assigned to Ranch.

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 散布的大量孢子可以轻易遮挡阳光。 偶尔会见到它呆站着一动不动， 它这不是在模仿蘑菇， 而是被自己的孢子遮住，什么都看不见。
description.en: The abundance of spores released by this Pal blocks out sunlight. Sometimes, if Shroomer Noct appears motionless, it's not because it's mimicking a mushroom, but rather because its own spores don't let it see anything.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在据点里，菇波的神奇孢子将会使据点内帕鲁的SAN值下降速度减缓(10~15)%。
description.en: Can be ridden. While at a base, its mysterious spores slow the rate at which the SAN value of allies at the base decreases by (10~15)%.

description.en: Creates a wall of ice that rises from the ground. The ice wall remains standing for a while, and breaks after taking enough damage.

description.zh: 大范围的在敌人脚下生成冰柱穿刺。
description.en: Throws icicles in a wide area from under the enemy's feet.

description.zh: 就算身体会在酷暑时融化，它还是痴迷于日光浴。 就算身体会在高温时融化，它依然痴迷于泡温泉。 反正最终都是一死，那么不如融化在艳阳高照的露天温泉里。
description.en:
Though its body melts in the heat, it just can't resist sunbathing.
Though its body melts in the warmth, it likes hot springs too much.
If it's going to melt anyway, it hopes it'll be in a steaming outdoor bath under a clear blue sky.

description.zh: 发动后，冰姬灵会将力量分给玩家，让玩家的攻击转变为冰属性，且攻击力提升(30~50)%。 Lv.Skill1
description.en: When activated, Icelyn changes the player's attack type to Ice and increases Attack by (30~50)%. Lv.Skill1

description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 缚乃伊的专用技能。 从手中伸长绷带，对敌人进行连续攻击。
description.en: Gildra's exclusive skill. Extends bandages from its hands to deliver a series of attacks.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 如同金色绷带般的器官有着伸缩自如的特性。 若是处于极端干燥的环境下会发生断裂， 所以每天检查保湿必不可少。
description.en: The golden, bandage-like organs covering its body are highly elastic. However, they are prone to tearing under extremely dry conditions, so daily moisture checks are absolutely essential.

description.zh: 与玩家并肩作战时，若缚乃伊陷入濒死状态，缚乃伊会消耗全部的饱腹度并复活。 levelvalue1
description.en: While fighting together, when Gildra is incapacitated, it revives with its Hunger reduced to 0. levelvalue1

description.en: Hurls a ball of water straight at an enemy.

description.en: Exhales breath imbued with draconic energy, dealing continuous damage to those in front of it.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大水球 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of water and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人头上生成3次落雷。
description.en: Generates lightning that strikes an enemy three times from above.

description.en: Jormuntide's exclusive skill. Letting out a roar, it charges toward the enemy, twisting its water-covered body as it advances.

description.zh: 猛烈地释放出水流 并向前方大范围横扫。
description.en: Shoots pressurized water at extreme velocities, sweeping over a wide area in front of it.

description.zh: 召唤大量小陨石 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Summons numerous small meteorites and launches them at an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh: 水属性攻击伤害增加30%
description.en: 30% increase in Water attack damage.

description.zh: 传说有位贤者因冤罪而被推入漩涡， 随后以覆海龙之姿重生， 并一举毁灭了整个国家。
description.en: Legend says the Jormuntide was once a wise man who, after being wrongly convicted and cast into a whirlpool, returned as this Pal to annihilate the kingdom.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在水上移动。 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁对浸湿状态的敌人造成的伤害将提升(50~65)%。（不可叠加）

description.zh: 召唤巨大的雷属性龙卷风。 龙卷风将追踪敌人缓慢移动。
description.en: Generates a huge tornado of lightning that moves slowly towards the enemy.

It was once believed to usher in the dry season.
Whenever there was a drought the previous year, people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers, hoping to bring about a plentiful harvest in the next year.

Whenever there was a flood the previous year, people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers, hoping to avert disaster in the coming year.

description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal's Movement Speed increases by (5~25)% for each other Water Pal in your party. (Excluding Suzaku Aqua)

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 将岩石从眼前的地上吸附起来 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 战冠雀的专用技能。 一口气提高速度，向前方突进。
description.en: Dazemu's exclusive skill. Accelerates all at once and dashes forward at high speed.

description.zh: 撼动地面， 使大块岩石射向四面八方
description.en: Causes the ground to shake before hurling a massive stone mass at its surroundings.

description.zh: 生成复数个砂龙卷。 龙卷风们将一边自旋一边绕中心旋转。
description.en: Creates multiple sand tornadoes. The tornadoes continuously spin in circles.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 行一步，断迷茫。 行两步，舍忧虑。 行三步，离怯懦。 敌虽魍魉，吾亦往。
description.en: Take one step forward and forget your doubts. Take two steps forward and forget your worries. Take three steps forward and forget your fears. Face any enemy.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 在砂地上时，移动速度提高(50~100)%。
description.en: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased by (50~100)% while mounted on sand.

description.zh: 用蕴藏龙之力的能量弹 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with draconic energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 生成酸性云朵 在敌人头上下酸雨。
description.en: Creates acidic clouds that pour down acid rain on enemies.

description.zh: 向前方呼出蕴含龙之力的气息 ，持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Exhales breath imbued with draconic energy, dealing continuous damage to those in front of it.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大水球 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of water and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 召唤大量小陨石 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Summons numerous small meteorites and launches them at an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 将天羽龙当作抱枕一同入睡， 就能体验如同身处天堂一般的舒适感。 但如果个体的睡相很差，那么会因被压扁而进入天堂。
description.en: Sleeping while cuddling a Quivern is said to be a heavenly experience, but there are some who have been crushed and sent to heaven by ones that toss and turn in their sleep.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 若它在队伍中，龙属性帕鲁的攻击力会提升(15~30)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases Attack of Dragon Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 用蕴藏龙之力的能量弹 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with draconic energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 向前方呼出蕴含龙之力的气息 ，持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Exhales breath imbued with draconic energy, dealing continuous damage to those in front of it.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 召唤陨石垂直落下， 并在撞击点产生冲击波。
description.en: Drops a meteorite straight down, generating a shock wave around the impact area.

description.zh: 在敌人的位置和其周围刺出尖锐的根刺。
description.en: Sprouts sharp roots in and around the enemy's location.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 在拥抱翠羽龙时， 如果闻到了太阳的味道和草原的馨香，那明天就是晴天。 如果闻到一股发霉的味道，那明天就是倾盆大雨。
description.en: When you hug Quivern Botan, if it smells like sunshine and meadows, tomorrow will be sunny. If it smells damp, tomorrow will be wet and miserable.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 骑乘期间玩家的攻击会转变为草属性，且攻击力提升(5~20)%。
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Grass and increases Attack by (5~20)%.

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 瞄准敌人发射 3发直线飞行的超高速风刃。
description.en: The user fires three high-speed blades of wind in quick succession that fly straight at enemies.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 在敌人的位置和其周围刺出尖锐的根刺。
description.en: Sprouts sharp roots in and around the enemy's location.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 一到开春时节，就会乘风在岛上散布花粉。 波娜兔之所以会得花粉症， 都怪春彩娘。
description.en: In early spring, pollen floats on the wind throughout the island. Flopie's hay fever is Lullu's fault.

description.zh: 若它在据点里，春彩娘会为农园注入元气，使作物的生长加速(50~70)%。 levelvalue1
description.en: While at a base, Lullu fills farms with good spirits, increasing the growth rate of the crops by (50~70)%. levelvalue1

description.zh: 曾经有一段时间流行过球犰足球这项运动。 虽然因为收到帕鲁保护组织的强烈反对，很快就被废除， 但其实被当球踢能够清理死皮，球犰也并非不情不愿。
description.en: A decade ago, Kikit soccer was popular. However, it quickly fell out of favor due to fierce opposition from the Free Pal Alliance. Nevertheless, the Kikit's themselves didn't mind because it helped shed their old carapace.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，地属性帕鲁的防御力提升(15~30)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in team, Kikit helps carry supplies, decreasing the weight of crude oil in the player's inventory.

description.zh: 快速连续向敌人进行啃咬攻击。
description.en: Bites rapidly in succession to attack enemies.

description.zh: 快速地向敌人飞扑，咬住敌人进行攻击。
description.en: Quickly lunges at the enemy and bites to deal damage.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 扇形发射锋利的气刃。
description.en: Sends out sharp blades of air in a fan shape.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 有着辟邪的特性， 昔日曾经作为优秀的伙伴，和岛民构筑起了良好的关系。 而现在，八云犬和人们之间已经垒起了名为「邪念」的高墙。
description.en: It has a strong sense of justice and despises evil. In the past they were faithful and loving companions to the islanders. Nowadays, Yakumos are hostile to humans wherever they spot them.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 与它并肩作战时，遇到和它有着相同被动技能的帕鲁的概率将提升(15~30)%。 ※部分被动技能除外
description.en: Can be ridden. While fighting together, (15~30)% increased chance of encountering pals with the same Passive Skill as this Pal. (Excludes certain Passive Skills)

description.zh: 朝敌人发射高速水弹。
description.en: Hurls a high speed ball of water at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射大量泡沫 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 召唤一束直线前进的水柱。
description.en: Generates a column of water that travels in a straight line.

description.zh: 向前方发射高压水流。 片刻后，水流会向左右分岔。
description.en: Fires a high-pressure stream of water forward. After a short delay, the stream branches off to the left and right.

description.zh: 用压缩水流一扫前方。 被扫过的区域会在片刻后喷出水柱。
description.en: Mows down the frontal area with a blast of compressed water. The area struck by the blast erupts with water after a short delay.

description.zh: 猛烈地释放出水流 并向前方大范围横扫。
description.en: Shoots pressurized water at extreme velocities, sweeping over a wide area in front of it.

description.zh: 在敌人四周掀起波浪并涌向敌人， 最后在中心点爆炸，喷出高高的水柱。
description.en: Generates waves that surge around the enemy from all sides. They converge and explode at the center, erupting into a column of water.

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh: 有着将骨骼和身躯暂时分离，用骨骼斩断敌人的疯狂生态。 如若不赶快收回体内，自己也会力竭倒下。 有传言在年轻的个体间流行着比赛身体分离时长的危险游戏，但真假未知。
description.en:
A bizarre species which temporarily separates its body and uses its bones to slice through enemies, at the risk of perishing itself upon taking too long.
While unconfirmed, older individuals are said to deliberately stay separated in order to trigger their survival instincts and prolong their lifespans.

description.zh: 发动后，鞘刀鱼会化身为玩家的刀（攻击：(2600~3900)）。 若不及时解除，鞘刀鱼将陷入濒死状态。 发动居合斩后同样会陷入濒死状态。 levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, Skutlass becomes the player's katana (Attack: (2600~3900)). If it does not revert to its normal form quickly, Skutlass will become incapacitated. It will also become incapacitated if Iaigiri is used. levelvalue1

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 使敌人周围地面活性化， 并在一定时间后爆炸。
description.en: Infuses the surrounding ground with energy, causing it to explode after a set amount of time.

description.zh: 于敌人周围生成数个暗黑龙卷风。
description.en: Generates several dark vortexes around the enemy.

description.zh: 夜冥驹的专用技能。 周身缠绕跃动的火焰，朝敌人冲锋。
description.en: Starryon's exclusive skill. Cloaks the body in flickering flames and charges toward the enemy.

description.zh: 夜冥驹的专用技能。 用鬼魅般的步伐玩弄敌人， 同时用锐利的角挥出斩击。
description.en: Starryon's exclusive skill. Confuses enemies with flickering steps and launches slashing attack with its sharp horn.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 它最为自豪的，就是自己如流水般柔顺的鬃毛。 如果发现了毛发分叉，就会害羞的无法集中精力奔跑。 由于静电会导致炸毛，绝对不会让驭雷马靠近。
description.en: It takes great pride in its flowing, gorgeous mane. If it finds a split end, it becomes so mortified it can't focus on running properly. Because static electricity makes its hair frizzy, it avoids Azurmane at all costs.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。骑乘期间跳跃能力提升。 夜晚期间，此帕鲁的移动速度提升(50~100)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. Boosts Jump Power while mounted. This Pal's movement speed increases by +(50~100)% at night.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 扇形发射锋利的气刃。
description.en: Sends out sharp blades of air in a fan shape.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 日耀驹的专用技能。 周身缠绕炽烈火焰，朝敌人冲锋。
description.en: Starryon Primo's exclusive skill. Cloaks the body in radiant flames and charges toward the enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 日耀驹的专用技能。 以华丽步伐戏耍敌人， 同时用锐利的角挥出斩击。
description.en: Starryon Primo's exclusive skill. Confuses enemies with an elegant stride and launches slashing attack with its sharp horn.

description.zh: 它最为自豪的就是自己光彩夺目的鬃毛。 只要有一点脏污，就会害羞的无法集中精力奔跑。 因为容易沾上皮脂污垢，即便是最喜欢的帕鲁驯养师， 它也不希望被黏糊糊的摸个不停。
description.en: It takes great pride in its glowing, gorgeous mane. If it gets even slightly dirty, it becomes so mortified it can't focus on running properly. Because skin oils ruin its coat, it wants to avoid being touched too much, even by its favorite Pal Tamer.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动，骑乘期间跳跃能力提升。 日耀驹的移动速度，会随着队伍中其他无属性帕鲁的数量提升，每只增加(5~25)%。
description.en: Can be ridden. Boosts Jump Power while mounted. This Pal's Movement Speed increases by (5~25)% for each other Neutral Pal in your party. (Excluding Starryon Primo)

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 将岩石从眼前的地上吸附起来 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 撼动地面， 使大块岩石射向四面八方
description.en: Causes the ground to shake before hurling a massive stone mass at its surroundings.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的岩石长矛。
description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 生成复数个砂龙卷。 龙卷风们将一边自旋一边绕中心旋转。
description.en: Creates multiple sand tornadoes. The tornadoes continuously spin in circles.

description.zh: 磐峰兽的专用技能。 以角刨开地面并顺势上挑， 朝敌人飞射岩石弹。
description.en: Pierdon's exclusive skill. Rakes the ground with its horn, then hurls a rock projectile at enemies.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh:
防御力+20%
免疫击退
description.en:
Defense +20%
Immune to Knockback

description.zh: 通过撞击更坚硬的岩石，来保持自己中意的形体。 至于那些躯体凹陷的低沉个体还是放任自流吧。 用人来类比的话，就像不小心把刘海剪过头了。
description.en: It smashes its body against harder rocks to maintain its preferred shape. Those with noticeable dents are best left alone, much like people with a botched haircut.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁对泥泞状态的敌人造成的伤害将提升(50~65)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Muddy by (50~65)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 在上空生成尖锐的冰柱 瞄准敌人后发射冰柱。
description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的冰刃。
description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.zh: 召唤朝前方三个方向推进的冰柱
description.en: Generates pillars of ice that move in a straight line in three directions.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 寒峰兽的专用技能。 以角刨开地面并顺势上挑， 朝敌人飞射雪块。
description.en: Pierdon Cryst's exclusive skill. Rakes the ground with its horn, then hurls a snow chunk at enemies.

description.zh: 大范围的在敌人脚下生成冰柱穿刺。
description.en: Throws icicles in a wide area from under the enemy's feet.

description.zh:
防御力+20%
免疫击退
description.en:
Defense +20%
Immune to Knockback

description.zh: 通过变换姿势晒日光浴，来将冰块融成中意的形状。 至于那些形态失衡的个体还是不要去打扰了。 用人来类比的话，就像不小心剪多了鬓角。
description.en: It basks in the sun, rotating just enough to melt its ice into its preferred shape. Lopsided ones should be left alone, much like a person who was a little too bold with their sideburns.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁受到的龙属性伤害减轻(15~30)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, player and party Pals take (15~30)% less Dragon damage. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.en: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.zh: 冰棘兽的专用技能。 在两次挥击后，使出浑身力气大幅挥动巨爪。 每次挥动巨爪时，都会向前方扇形区域飞出冰柱。
description.en: Cryolinx's exclusive skill. First, it strikes with its claws, followed by a second slash, and culminates with a powerful slash using its entire body. When swinging the claws, ice pillars are launched forward in a fan shape.

description.zh: 朝敌人喷出冰冷空气， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 它的那双坚硬的爪子可使它轻而易举地登上险峻的山岭。 可是因为腿短的关系，并不擅长下山， 因此常常把自己困在山上，难以抽身。
description.en: It can easily climb steep mountains with its hard claws. However, its short legs make it difficult to descend, often leaving it stranded in high places.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，击倒龙属性帕鲁时获得的掉落道具增加(40~80)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, Dragon Pals drop (40~80)% more items when defeated. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.en: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 金棘兽的专用技能。 在两次挥击后，使出浑身力气大幅挥动巨爪。 每次挥动巨爪时，都会向前方扇形区域飞出碎岩。
description.en: Cryolinx Terra's exclusive skill. First, it strikes with its claws, followed by a second slash, and culminates with a powerful slash using its entire body. When swinging the claws, rocks are launched forward in a fan shape.

description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 召唤巨大的雷属性龙卷风。 龙卷风将追踪敌人缓慢移动。
description.en: Generates a huge tornado of lightning that moves slowly towards the enemy.

description.zh: 它的那双巨大的爪子可使它轻轻松松搬起大量东西。 可是因为腿短的关系，走起来很慢， 经常在半路上天就黑了。
description.en: It can easily carry many items with its large hands. However, its short legs slow its pace, often leaving it overtaken by nightfall.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，攻击击中弱点部位时，下次击中弱点部位的攻击威力提升(30~60)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, when attacking enemy weak point, increases the power of the next weak point attack by (30~60)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.en: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 在空中生成复数个冰锥， 瞄准敌人一齐射出。
description.en: Generates multiple sharp ice blocks in the sky and fires them at the enemy.

description.zh: 召唤朝前方三个方向推进的冰柱

description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 「直视雪墩墩的眼睛」 这句话的意思是要透过现象看本质。 说起来不知为何，从来没有想要探究雪墩墩到底有没有眼睛的研究者。
description.en: “To look at a Snugloo's eyes” is an expression which means to seek the unseen essence of things. Ironically, no researcher has ever confirmed whether Snugloos have eyes in the first place.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，会使玩家不容易被敌人发现。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, reduces the chance of being detected by enemies. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 在上空生成尖锐的冰柱 瞄准敌人后发射冰柱。
description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.en: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 白绒雪怪的专用技能。 一边向前方突进一边滚动雪球， 在雪球滚的足够大时投掷出去，使其炸裂。
description.en: Wumpo's exclusive skill. Rolls a snowball as it moves forward, and when it grows large enough, it throws it to cause an explosion.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh:
防御力+20%
免疫击退
description.en:
Defense +20%
Immune to Knockback

description.zh: 研究者为了揭开它的内部结构，而将它的毛都剃光。 结果只剩下满地毛发， 仿佛从最开始这团毛里面就空无一物。
description.en: Researchers once tried to shave off its hair to reveal its true form. In the end, only hair was left, as if that was all there was to begin with.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在据点里，其他据点帕鲁的搬运工作适应性等级+1。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While at a base, increases the Transporting Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射水弹 笔直飞向对方。
description.en: Hurls a ball of water straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 用地下尖锐的根部追击敌人 并从脚下贯穿敌人。
description.en: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

description.zh: 绿苔绒怪的专用技能。 一边向前方突进一边滚动草球， 在草球滚的足够大时投掷出去，使其炸裂。
description.en: Wumpo Botan's exclusive skill. Rolls a ball made of grass as it moves forward, and when it grows large enough, it throws it to cause an explosion.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大水球 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of water and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh:
防御力+20%
免疫击退
description.en:
Defense +20%
Immune to Knockback

description.zh: 研究者为了揭开它的内部结构，而将它身上的草都剃光。 结果只剩下满地杂草， 仿佛从最开始这团草里面就空无一物。
description.en: Researchers once tried to cut the grass off its body to reveal its true form. In the end, only grass was left, as if that was all there was to begin with.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁受到的地属性伤害减轻(15~30)%，并且不会陷入泥泞状态。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take (15~30)% less Ground damage and are immune to Muddy status. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 瞄准后发射可笔直飞向敌人 的火焰弹。
description.en: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 使用火焰的力量做出复数个球体， 然后向敌人发射无数火球。
description.en: Creates multiple spheres of fiery energy, from which countless fireballs shoot towards the enemy.

description.zh: 向上空喷射无数熔岩弹。 一段时间后，射出的熔岩弹将如雨一般散落在周围。
description.en: Fires countless volcanic bombs into the sky. After a while, the bombs rain down around their originator.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 古人曾认为，越接近世界末日，恐炬灵的火焰就越弱。 末日主义者曾屡次因火焰减弱了而产生骚乱， 最后发现火势强弱全看它的心情， 至少到目前还是这样的。
description.en: It was once believed that as the world approached its end, the flame would weaken. Doomsayers would repeatedly rejoice when the flame began to weaken, but in the end, it turned out to be a prank by Sootseer. At least, for now.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁受到的无属性伤害减轻(15~30)%。（不可叠加） 将它分派到家畜牧场，它就有机会从地里挖出骨头。 levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, player and party Pals take (15~30)% less Neutral damage. (Does not stack) Sometimes digs up Bone when assigned to Ranch. levelvalue1

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 用地下尖锐的根部追击敌人 并从脚下贯穿敌人。
description.en: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

description.zh: 在敌人的位置和其周围刺出尖锐的根刺。
description.en: Sprouts sharp roots in and around the enemy's location.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 在敌人前方生成风刃， 并对其发动十字斩击。
description.en: Conjures blades of wind in front of the enemy, converging to deliver a cutting cross attack.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 什么奇怪的东西都毫不在意地往嘴里塞， 导致头顶的嘴有时会患上口腔溃疡。 每当这种时候，就由脸部的嘴来替代。 但是胡乱吃东西的毛病依然不改，最终两张嘴都得了口腔溃疡。
description.en: Prone to eating indiscriminately, the mouth atop its head frequently breaks out in agonizing ulcers, causing it to use the mouth on its face instead. However, its behavior doesn't change, which leads to both mouths suffering the same ulcers.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家进行翻滚或滑步动作时，颚莉丝会卷起旋风攻击接触到的敌人（草属性 / 威力: (40~80)）。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, when the player performs a dodge roll or dodge step, Carnibora creates a whirlwind that deals damage to enemies it touches (Grass / Power: (40~80)). (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 瞄准后发射可笔直飞向敌人 的火焰弹。
description.en: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 面向敌人释放火焰， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Shoots flames at an enemy, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 使敌人周围地面活性化， 并在一定时间后爆炸。
description.en: Infuses the surrounding ground with energy, causing it to explode after a set amount of time.

description.zh: 焰煌及亚种的专用技能。 伸展开手臂，使肌肉剧烈膨胀后， 猛地拍击在一起引发巨大爆炸。
description.en: Blazamut's exclusive skill. Raises and inflates its arms, then slams them together, causing a massive explosion in the surrounding area.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的岩石长矛。
description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 火属性攻击伤害增加30%
description.en: 30% increase in Fire attack damage.

description.zh: 传说它是火山喷发之际一同诞生的产物。 曾有可疑的团体主张， 这片大陆其实就是巨大焰煌的背。
description.en: Legends say it was born during a volcanic eruption. A strange group even claims that this continent is laid upon the back of a giant Blazamut.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，打倒敌人时，一同并肩作战的帕鲁的攻击力与防御力会提升(5~10)%。 该效果最多可累积5层，持续20秒。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, increases the Attack and Defense of the Pal fighting alongside you by (5~10)% whenever you defeat an enemy. This effect lasts 20 seconds and stacks up to five times.

description.zh: 快速释放龙之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges draconic energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 面向敌人释放火焰， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Shoots flames at an enemy, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 在敌人的位置燃起火焰之墙。 火墙将持续一段时间， 对碰到的敌人造成伤害。
description.en: Creates a wall of flames at the enemy's location. The wall of flames will remain for a while, and deal damage to the enemies it touches.

description.zh: 召唤陨石垂直落下， 并在撞击点产生冲击波。
description.en: Drops a meteorite straight down, generating a shock wave around the impact area.

description.zh: 用龙属性的射线一扫前方。 被扫过地方将产生延迟爆炸。
description.en: Mows down the area in front with a beam imbued with dragon power. The area struck by the beam will also explode after a short delay.

description.zh: 焰煌及亚种的专用技能。 伸展开手臂，使肌肉剧烈膨胀后， 猛地拍击在一起引发巨大爆炸。
description.en: Blazamut's exclusive skill. Raises and inflates its arms, then slams them together, causing a massive explosion in the surrounding area.

description.zh: 殁殃的专用技能。 高高跃上空中后，边在空中高速移动，边积蓄力量。 然后打出全力一击。
description.en: Blazamut Ryu's exclusive skill. After a big jump, moves at high speed in the air, gathering strength to unleash a powerful punch.

description.zh: 召唤无数陨石落下， 并在撞击点产生冲击波。
description.en: Drops countless meteorites, generating an array of shock waves.

description.zh:
火属性攻击伤害增加30%
雷属性攻击伤害增加30%
description.en:
30% increase to Fire attack damage.
30% increase to Lightning attack damage.

description.zh: 自太古时期，其于地底现身。 焚天的烈火在将一切焚烧殆尽前，永远都不会熄灭。 此谓「永炎」。
description.en: Long ago, it emerged from the depths of the earth. With relentless, raging flames showing no mercy, it burned the entire island until nothing remained. It was known as the Eternal Flame.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁以龙属性攻击克制的属性时伤害提升(25~40)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals' Dragon attacks when hitting the enemy's elemental weakness by (25~40)%. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 撼动地面， 使大块岩石射向四面八方
description.en: Causes the ground to shake before hurling a massive stone mass at its surroundings.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 双心岩傀及亚种的专用技能。 将左臂从本体分离，横扫敌人。 随后再射出右臂。
description.en: Dualiths exclusive skill. Detaches its left arm to sweep enemies, then launches its right arm.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 双心岩傀的专用技能。 从手臂发射草属性能量弹。 能量弹落地后会化为根须，紧追敌人，并从其脚下破土贯穿。
description.en: Dualiths exclusive skill. Fires a Grass-elemental energy projectile from its arm. Upon impact, the blast transforms into persistent roots that track and pierce the enemy from below.

description.zh:
防御力+20%
免疫击退
description.en:
Defense +20%
Immune to Knockback

description.zh: 一副身躯，两个意识。 有时会因为思路分歧而发生争吵。 在它们和好前，完全不知道躯体会往哪里去！
description.en: One entity, two minds. When their wills clash, it's impossible to tell where the armor will wander until they reconcile.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间，可以从双心岩傀的右手发射草属性的强力激光。
description.en: Can be ridden. While mounted, Dualith fires a powerful Grass laser from its right hand.

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的高速暗黑球。
description.en: Fires high-speed dark orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 将带有黑暗力量的高速能量弹射向敌人。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with dark energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 使用暗之力连续发射数支高速箭追击敌人。
description.en: Fires off dark energy that homes in on an enemy.

description.zh: 撼动地面， 使大块岩石射向四面八方
description.en: Causes the ground to shake before hurling a massive stone mass at its surroundings.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 双心岩傀及亚种的专用技能。 将左臂从本体分离，横扫敌人。 随后再射出右臂。
description.en: Dualiths exclusive skill. Detaches its left arm to sweep enemies, then launches its right arm.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh:
防御力+20%
免疫击退
description.en:
Defense +20%
Immune to Knockback

description.zh: 一副身躯，两个意识。 平时意见向来不合，总是吵个没完， 可一旦进入战斗，它们就会在转瞬之间身心合一！
description.en: One entity, two minds. They rarely agree and bicker constantly, but once battle begins, mind and body instantly unite as one!

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间，可以从咒心岩傀的右手发射暗属性的强力激光。
description.en: Can be ridden. While mounted, Dualith Noct fires a powerful Dark laser from its right hand.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成砂砾龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 阿努比斯的专用技能。 用强健的腿脚回旋飞踢，大范围横扫周围的敌人。
description.en: Anubis' exclusive skill. Performs a spin kick with its strong legs, sweeping enemies over a wide area.

description.zh: 阿努比斯的专用技能。 快速移动追击敌人， 释放能量同时不断挥出强劲利拳。
description.en: Anubis' exclusive skill. Rapidly pursues its foes while releasing energy and unleashing a powerful punch.

description.zh: 阿努比斯的专用技能。 高高跃起后，对地面使出猛力一击。 产生的衝击波将对大范围的目标造成伤害。
description.en: Anubis' exclusive skill. Leaps high into the air and strikes a punch to the ground, causing a shockwave that deals damage over a wide area.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的岩石长矛。
description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 生成复数个砂龙卷。 龙卷风们将一边自旋一边绕中心旋转。
description.en: Creates multiple sand tornadoes. The tornadoes continuously spin in circles.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 地属性攻击伤害增加30%
description.en: 30% increase in Earth attack damage.

description.zh: 它的外表曾被视作高贵的象征。 而在那些蔑视权贵的人眼里，它就成了醒目的标靶。 于是在不知不觉间，阿努比斯成为了死亡的象征。
description.en:
Once seen as a symbol of nobility, and an idol for those who shunned wealth and power.
Yet over time, this Pal became a token of death.

description.zh: 发动后，阿努比斯会将力量分给玩家，让玩家的攻击转变为地属性，且攻击力提升(30~50)%。 战斗时偶尔会以高速移步回避攻击。 Lv.Skill1
description.en: When activated, Anubis changes the player's attack type to Ground and increases Attack by (30~50)%. Occasionally evades attacks with a flash sidestep during battle. Lv.Skill1

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 扇形发射锋利的气刃。
description.en: Sends out sharp blades of air in a fan shape.

description.zh: 塞赫麦特的专用技能。 抓挠敌人的同时向后翻跃，与敌人拉开距离。
description.en: Sekhmets exclusive skill. Scratches the enemy while performing a backward somersault to create distance.

description.zh: 塞赫麦特的专用技能。 旋转突进，一口气拉近距离并抓挠敌人。
description.en: Sekhmets exclusive skill. Spins forward to quickly close the distance and scratch the enemy.

description.zh: 生成复数个砂龙卷。 龙卷风们将一边自旋一边绕中心旋转。
description.en: Creates multiple sand tornadoes. The tornadoes continuously spin in circles.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 曾经脾气暴躁并被当作死亡的象征。 在阿努比斯变为死亡的象征后，寻求替代的富人们用酒灌醉塞赫麦特，并将其驯服。 不知从何时起，塞赫麦特成为了高贵的象征。
description.en: Once a fierce creature feared as a symbol of death. When Anubis claimed that mantle, wealthy elites looking for a replacement beguiled the species with wine. Before long, Sekhmet became a symbol of high nobility.

description.zh: 若它在据点里，据点中的阿努比斯的工作速度提升(20~40)%。（不可叠加） 塞赫麦特在工作台或作业工厂等处工作时，工作效率将会提升(30~60)%。 levelvalue1
description.en: While at a base, boosts Anubis's work speed by (20~40)%. Increases efficiency by (30~60)% if Sekhmet is working at a Workbench, Workshop, or other related facilities. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.zh: 将带有黑暗力量的高速能量弹射向敌人。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with dark energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成砂砾龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的岩石长矛。
description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 身怀5000多种毒素。 虽然其中甚至有能够立刻致死的可怕剧毒， 但是由于剂量都太低了，并没有什么卵用。
description.en: It has about 5,000 types of venom. Some of them are deadly enough to cause instant death, but none are present in a high enough concentration to have any effect.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁对中毒状态的敌人造成的伤害将提升(50~65)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Poison by (50~65)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 快速放电 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

description.zh: 生成可笔直前进的雷击。
description.en: Generates a lightning bolt that moves forward in a line.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成砂砾龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 同时发射直线飞行的高速雷球， 和追踪敌人的慢速雷球。
description.en: A high-speed lightning ball that flies in a straight line. Simultaneously fires slow lightning balls that track the enemy.

description.zh: 向八个方向召唤直线推进的雷击。
description.en: Generates lightning strikes that travel in a straight line in all directions.

description.zh: 电针妖的专用技能。 通过超导快速缩短和敌人的距离， 狠狠的用钳子使出上勾拳。
description.en: Prixter Lux's exclusive skill. Uses superconductivity to closes the distance to the enemy at high speed, then swings its pincers upward with full force.

description.zh: 锁定敌人后，连续射出超高速的雷射。
description.en: After aiming at the enemy, fires multiple ultra-fast lightning lasers.

description.zh: 能将尾针刺入敌人体内，并释放电流。 但是，由于电流实在太弱了， 还是直接抡起钳子更有杀伤力。
description.en: It pierces foes with its tail to deliver an electric jolt directly into their bodies. However, the current it generates is extremely weak, so a simple punch would do far more damage.

description.zh: 发动后，电针妖会将力量分给玩家，让玩家的攻击转变为雷属性，且攻击力提升(30~50)%。 Lv.Skill1
description.en: When activated, Prixter Lux changes the player's attack type to Electric and increases Attack by (30~50)%. Lv.Skill1

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 将岩石从眼前的地上吸附起来 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成砂砾龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.en: Creates multiple sand tornadoes. The tornadoes continuously spin in circles.

description.zh: 重岩龟的专用技能。 高高跃起至空中， 随即以压倒性的重量将敌人压垮。
description.en: Tetroise's exclusive skill. Leaps into the air and crushes enemies with its massive weight.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 背部堆砌的石头有一定自我意识。 若是取下来放到别处， 就会自己移动，试图回到本体所在的地方。
description.en: Those stones on its back are not just cargo. Set them down somewhere distant and they will slowly make their way back home.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在据点里，其他据点帕鲁的采矿工作适应性等级+1。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden While at a base, increases the Mining Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 扇形发射锋利的气刃。
description.en: Sends out sharp blades of air in a fan shape.

description.zh: 召唤朝前方三个方向推进的冰柱
description.en: Generates pillars of ice that move in a straight line in three directions.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 净岩龟的专用技能。 高高跃起至空中，将敌人压垮。 随后扩散光芒，以光柱进行追击。
description.en: Tetroise Primo's exclusive skill. Leaps into the air and crushes enemies with its massive weight. Upon landing, light spreads outward, forming pillars of light that burst forth and strike nearby enemies.

description.zh: 背部堆砌的石头即便被拿到某处， 净岩龟也能感应石头的位置。 就算相隔天涯海角，它也一定要去找出来。
description.en: Even if the stones on its back were to be removed, Tetroise Primo will know where they are. No matter how far apart, it will always track them down.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，武器和防具的耐久度损耗减缓(80~100)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces durability loss of all weapons and armor by (80~100)%. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 于前方制造毒雾， 使目标陷入中毒状态。
description.en: Generates a fog of poison in front, causing the opponent to become poisoned.

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.
