description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 快速释放黑暗之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 使出浑身力量 向各个方向喷洒毒球。
description.en: Focuses energy into the body and scatters poison orbs in all directions.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 异常讨厌被人看到双眼。 如果有人强行盯着，它就会突然哭出来 之后两周左右的时间，对对方不理不睬。
description.en: Strongly dislikes anyone catching a glimpse of its concealed eye. If you insist on trying, it'll burst into tears and ignore you for two weeks.

description.zh: 发动后，妮瞅莎会在一段时间内用霰弹枪攻击附近的敌人。 若它在队伍中，玩家的霰弹枪攻击伤害提升(10~35)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: When activated, Nyafia will fire a shotgun at nearby enemies for a limited time. While in party, increases the player's shotgun damage by (10~35)%. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 将带有黑暗力量的高速能量弹射向敌人。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with dark energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 扇形发射锋利的气刃。
description.en: Sends out sharp blades of air in a fan shape.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 曾经岛上存在过一个王国， 王国里有一个传统，每年都会赐予死法最愚蠢的人奖赏。 值得纪念的最初的死因便是「没有识破旺财，打开箱子而被咬死。」
description.en: There was once a tradition of handing out an award to the person who met their end in the most foolish way. The first award was given for |being unaware of Mimog, opening the chest, and being bitten to death.|

description.zh: 与它并肩作战时，能借助旺财的力量，在不使用钥匙的情况下打开各种等级的宝箱。 但无法打开需要特定工作适应性的宝箱。 levelvalue1
description.en: While fighting together, Mimog can open treasure chests without using a key. Does not apply to chests that require a specific Work Suitability. levelvalue1

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的高速暗黑球。
description.en: Fires high-speed dark orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 使用暗之力连续发射数支高速箭追击敌人。
description.en: Fires off dark energy that homes in on an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 杰诺贝达的专用技能。 灵活的跃起，用左手撕裂敌人。
description.en: Xenovader's exclusive skill. Swiftly pounces and slashes with its left hand.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh:
攻击力+10%
火属性伤害减免15%
雷属性伤害减免15%
description.en:
Attack +10%
Fire damage reduction 15%
Lightning damage reduction 15%

description.zh: 具有将信息传输中的损耗变换为能量的能力。 会定期的向不明对象发送情报。 「发现目标，请立刻前往破坏，见信速回。」
description.en: Can send information and convert it into energy by forgetting it. Regularly seems to be sending information to someone. - Respond. Target located. Proceed to immediate destruction.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，全自动武器的弹匣中最后一发子弹的伤害提升(100~160)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases the damage of the last bullet fired from a full-auto weapon by (100~160)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 用蕴藏龙之力的能量弹 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with draconic energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 快速释放龙之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges draconic energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 扇形发射锋利的气刃。
description.en: Sends out sharp blades of air in a fan shape.

description.zh: 向前方呼出蕴含龙之力的气息 ，持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Exhales breath imbued with draconic energy, dealing continuous damage to those in front of it.

description.zh: 召唤朝前方三个方向推进的冰柱
description.en: Generates pillars of ice that move in a straight line in three directions.

description.zh: 召唤陨石垂直落下， 并在撞击点产生冲击波。
description.en: Drops a meteorite straight down, generating a shock wave around the impact area.

description.zh: 用龙属性的射线一扫前方。 被扫过地方将产生延迟爆炸。
description.en: Mows down the area in front with a beam imbued with dragon power. The area struck by the beam will also explode after a short delay.

description.zh: 召唤大量小陨石 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Summons numerous small meteorites and launches them at an enemy.

description.zh:
攻击力+10%
火属性伤害减免15%
雷属性伤害减免15%
description.en:
Attack +10%
Fire damage reduction 15%
Lightning damage reduction 15%

description.zh: 具有吞食信息并转换为能量的能力。 会定期的向不明对象发送情报。 「喂喂？在查看刚才的讯息前不小心吃掉了，你说了啥？」
description.en: Consumes information and turns it into energy. Regularly seems to be sending information to someone. - Hello? What was the message you just sent? I devoured it before checking.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，玩家使用能量武器时的伤害提升(10~35)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, increases the player's energy weapon damage by (10~35)%. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 于前方制造毒雾， 使目标陷入中毒状态。
description.en: Generates a fog of poison in front, causing the opponent to become poisoned.

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 使出浑身力量 向各个方向喷洒毒球。
description.en: Focuses energy into the body and scatters poison orbs in all directions.

description.zh: 用地下尖锐的根部追击敌人 并从脚下贯穿敌人。
description.en: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 因为它头脑聪明，行为举止富有格调 在岛上的贵族间，曾被作为照顾起居的近侍。 但是由于在晚上碰到的话，非常容易被脸吓到 很快就失去了人气。
description.en: Intelligent and graceful in its demeanor, it was frequently employed as an attendant by the island's nobles. However, when encountered at night, its face looked so eerie that it quickly fell out of favor.

description.zh: 若它在据点里，梅莉姆会进行祈祷， 让作物的收获量提升(18~35)%。 levelvalue1
description.en: While at a base, Prunelia's prayers bless the crops, increasing their harvest by (18~35)%. levelvalue1

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的高速暗黑球。
description.en: Fires high-speed dark orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 将带有黑暗力量的高速能量弹射向敌人。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with dark energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 使用暗之力连续发射数支高速箭追击敌人。
description.en: Fires off dark energy that homes in on an enemy.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 它手里捧着的，是自己的灵魂。 当它找到了心仪的对象，就会将对方的灵魂强行抽出 并与自己的灵魂融合，以求成为一心同体。
description.en: What it carries is its own soul. When it falls for someone, it forcibly extracts their soul and merges it with its own, yearning to become one.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，击倒帕鲁时帕鲁之魂的获得量提升+(100~200)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While fighting together, Pals drop +(100~200)% more Pal Souls when defeated. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人的位置和其周围刺出尖锐的根刺。
description.en: Sprouts sharp roots in and around the enemy's location.

description.zh: 发射风刃， 在击中敌人或树木时反弹并连续造成攻击， 最多可反弹4次。
description.en: Launches a blade of wind that rebounds off enemies or trees, striking repeatedly. Can ricochet up to four times.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 在敌人前方生成风刃， 并对其发动十字斩击。
description.en: Conjures blades of wind in front of the enemy, converging to deliver a cutting cross attack.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 它手里捧着的，是自己的灵魂。 当它找到了心仪的对象，就会将自己的灵魂抛向对方 渴望与对方的灵魂融合，成为一心同体。
description.en: What it carries is its own soul. When it falls for someone, it flings its soul at them to merge it with theirs, yearning to become one.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，草属性帕鲁的防御力提升(15~30)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases Defense of Grass Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 快速连续向敌人进行啃咬攻击。
description.en: Bites rapidly in succession to attack enemies.

description.zh: 快速地向敌人飞扑，咬住敌人进行攻击。
description.en: Quickly lunges at the enemy and bites to deal damage.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的高速暗黑球。
description.en: Fires high-speed dark orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 将带有黑暗力量的高速能量弹射向敌人。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with dark energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 快速释放黑暗之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 召唤陨石垂直落下， 并在撞击点产生冲击波。
description.en: Drops a meteorite straight down, generating a shock wave around the impact area.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 黑色火焰即便摸上去也不过只是微热 但是持续接触的物体则会慢慢从内部开始融化。 如果用来烤乳酪，可谓绝品。
description.en: The black flames are merely warm to the touch, but anything left in contact with them slowly melts from the inside. Hold some cheese over them, and it becomes a true delicacy.

description.zh: 发动后能够以敏锐的嗅觉，来探测附近铬铁矿的位置。 与它并肩作战时，铬铁矿的掉落量也会提升(100~200)%。
description.en: When activated, uses its sharp sense of smell to detect nearby Chromite. While fighting together, Chromite acquisition increases by +(100~200)%.

description.zh: 快速连续向敌人进行啃咬攻击。
description.en: Bites rapidly in succession to attack enemies.

description.zh: 快速地向敌人飞扑，咬住敌人进行攻击。
description.en: Quickly lunges at the enemy and bites to deal damage.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 朝敌人喷出冰冷空气， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 在空中生成复数个冰锥， 瞄准敌人一齐射出。
description.en: Generates multiple sharp ice blocks in the sky and fires them at the enemy.

description.zh: 召唤朝前方三个方向推进的冰柱
description.en: Generates pillars of ice that move in a straight line in three directions.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 苍白的火焰即便摸上去也只感到些微的凉意， 但是持续接触的物体则会逐渐冻结。 放上一瓶牛奶，就能得到一瓶冰冻牛奶！
description.en: The blue flames are merely cool to the touch, but anything left in contact with them slowly freezes. Hold a milk bottle over them, and you get a frozen milkshake!

description.zh: 若它在据点里，其他据点帕鲁的冷却工作适应性等级+1。（不可叠加）
description.en: While at a base, increases the Cooling Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的高速暗黑球。
description.en: Fires high-speed dark orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 将带有黑暗力量的高速能量弹射向敌人。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with dark energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 快速释放黑暗之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 面惧的专用技能。 突然出现在敌人附近并用双手将其束缚， 并吸收受到束缚敌人的HP。
description.en: Omasculs exclusive skill. Suddenly appears near the enemy, firmly restraining them with its arms, and absorbs the HP of the restrained enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 像是假面的部分，貌似并不是它的脸。 仿佛就在眼前，但实际上又似乎并不存在。 常常不知道从哪里，仿佛有双眼睛在注视这边。 转头看去，似乎就在背后。
description.en: The mask it wears is not its face, they say. It seems in front, but it's not there, no way. From shadows deep, it watches night and day. Glance away, and closer it will stray.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，队伍帕鲁获得的经验值会提升(40~80)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases Party Pals' EXP gained by (40~80)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 在上空生成尖锐的冰柱 瞄准敌人后发射冰柱。
description.en: Creates ice lances in the air that fly towards enemies.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的冰刃。
description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.zh: 召唤一束直线前进的水柱。
description.en: Generates a column of water that travels in a straight line.

description.zh: 从地面召唤出冰墙。 冰墙会持续一段时间， 并在承受一定伤害后碎裂。
description.en: Creates a wall of ice that rises from the ground. The ice wall remains standing for a while, and breaks after taking enough damage.

description.zh: 凉晶鲸及亚种的专用技能。 笔直突进后短暂潜伏， 接着高高跃起进行攻击。 跃起时会引发冰属性爆炸。
description.en: Whalaska's exclusive skill. Charges straight ahead and briefly submerges, then bursts high into the air to launch an attack. An ice-element explosion occurs upon emerging.

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 它在睡着时会被其他帕鲁误将其当作浮冰，并在它身上休息。 因为性格温柔，即便醒过来也不会强行赶走它们。 但是由于私人空间被侵犯，心中会积攒压力。
description.en:
When it sleeps, Pals often mistake it for a drifting piece of ice and rest on it.
Although gentle and unwilling to push them away when awake, it feels quietly stressed by the intrusion on its personal space.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在水上移动。 若它在队伍中，垂钓的捕获计量槽在小游戏开始时的初始位置升高(5~14)%，并且在判定条与鱼的图标重合期间，捕获计量槽的上升量增加(5~14)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, fishing minigames start with the capture gauge increased by (5~14)%. Additionally, while the bars overlap, capture progress increases by (5~14)%. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 瞄准后发射可笔直飞向敌人 的火焰弹。
description.en: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 连续发射3支高速火箭 并追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three flaming arrows in succession that home in on an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的冰刃。
description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人的位置燃起火焰之墙。 火墙将持续一段时间， 对碰到的敌人造成伤害。
description.en: Creates a wall of flames at the enemy's location. The wall of flames will remain for a while, and deal damage to the enemies it touches.

description.zh: 从地面召唤出冰墙。 冰墙会持续一段时间， 并在承受一定伤害后碎裂。
description.en: Creates a wall of ice that rises from the ground. The ice wall remains standing for a while, and breaks after taking enough damage.

description.zh: 向上空喷射无数熔岩弹。 一段时间后，射出的熔岩弹将如雨一般散落在周围。
description.en: Fires countless volcanic bombs into the sky. After a while, the bombs rain down around their originator.

description.zh: 凉晶鲸及亚种的专用技能。 笔直突进后短暂潜伏， 接着高高跃起进行攻击。 跃起时会引发冰属性爆炸。
description.en: Whalaska's exclusive skill. Charges straight ahead and briefly submerges, then bursts high into the air to launch an attack. An ice-element explosion occurs upon emerging.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 为了不再被错认成浮冰，硬生生将身体变为红色。 但是对于那些红色盲的帕鲁来说毫无意义， 努力只换来了空虚，到头来私人空间还是继续受到侵犯。
description.en:
Determined never to be mistaken for drift ice again, it turned bright red through sheer will.
Unfortunately, some Pals can’t see red.
So despite its efforts, its personal space continues to be invaded.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在水上移动。 若它在队伍中，垂钓的捕获计量槽在小游戏开始时的初始位置升高(7~17)%，并且在判定条与鱼的图标重合期间，捕获计量槽的上升量增加(7~17)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, fishing minigame begins with the capture gauge (7~17)% higher than usual, and capture progress increases by (7~17)% while the bars overlap. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 将岩石从眼前的地上吸附起来 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 踏春兔的专用技能。 向前方跳起的同时高速回旋踢击， 将周围一扫而净。
description.en: Verdash's exclusive skill. While jumping forward, it sweeps the surroundings with a high-speed spinning kick.

description.zh: 用地下尖锐的根部追击敌人 并从脚下贯穿敌人。
description.en: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 踏春兔跑过的地面会变得土质肥沃，草木也会长得很茂盛。 但如果喷上除草剂后， 它们就不会在这里跑动了。
description.en: Land that Verdash has run across becomes extremely fertile, with thick vegetation growing soon after. It will not run anywhere that herbicide has been used.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，可以额外进行+1次跳跃和+1次空中冲刺。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, grants 1 additional jump and 1 additional mid-air dash. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的高速暗黑球。
description.en: Fires high-speed dark orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 将带有黑暗力量的高速能量弹射向敌人。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with dark energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 快速释放黑暗之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 幽恋娜的专用技能。 从原先位置瞬间移动的同时打出斩击。 然后瞬移至目标头顶， 用利刃刺穿猎物并产生暗属性能量波。
description.en: Splatterina's exclusive skill. Teleports instantly and launches a slash. It then teleports above the enemy, drives its weapon into them, and unleashes a wave of dark energy.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

Attack +15%
Defense -15%

description.zh: 有着无法抑制住的想要将猎物大卸八块的本能。 具体从哪个部位开始，不同个体有着不同的讲究。 若是被幽恋娜抓到了，就祈祷它会从脑袋开始吧。
description.en: It has an uncontrollable urge to tear its prey apart. Each individual has their own meticulous order for dismemberment. If caught by Splatterina, pray that your head is taken first.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中， 使用切肉刀进行解体时，获得的掉落道具增加(100~200)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, the amount of items obtained from using the Meat Cleaver increases by (100~200)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 快速连续向敌人进行啃咬攻击。
description.en: Bites rapidly in succession to attack enemies.

description.zh: 快速地向敌人飞扑，咬住敌人进行攻击。
description.en: Quickly lunges at the enemy and bites to deal damage.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 撼动地面， 使大块岩石射向四面八方
description.en: Causes the ground to shake before hurling a massive stone mass at its surroundings.

description.zh: 金驰兽的专用技能。 在气势汹汹突进的同时，令碎岩向左右飞溅。
description.en: Gildane's exclusive skill. Charges forward, hurling rocks to the left and right with great force.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 在岛上还盛行炼金术的时候， 它持续闪耀的金色毛发作为炼金的触媒很受欢迎。 不久之后，人们提出了跨时代的见解。 既然同是金色的，那么炼金就只加工金毛不就好了嘛。
description.en: During the golden age of alchemy on the island, its ever-glowing golden fur was highly prized as a catalyst for transmuting gold. In time, a remarkable revelation was made: the same golden hue could be achieved simply by processing its mane.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间玩家的攻击会转变为地属性，且攻击力提升(5~20)%。
description.en: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Ground and increases Attack by (5~20)%.

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 将岩石从眼前的地上吸附起来 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 扇形发射锋利的气刃。
description.en: Sends out sharp blades of air in a fan shape.

description.zh: 汪宗师的专用技能。 摆出合气道的架势，在架势中受到的攻击将无效化， 同时一瞬间迫近敌人，使出全身力量掌击。
description.en: Dogen's exclusive skill. Adopts an aiki stance. While in this stance, nulify any incoming attack, instantly close in on the enemy, and counter with a full-forced palm strike.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 为了到达「无我」的境地而不停的冥想。 直面烦恼并顿悟之后，它都会胃口大开吃到撑， 每当此时就会有所感悟──今天吃太多了。
description.en: Striving for a state of selflessness, it meditates endlessly. After confronting its worldly desires, it eats a meal and reflects. It ate too much today.

description.zh: 发动后可以移动至最近的据点。 无法在地下城里使用。 levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, teleports to the nearest base. Cannot be used inside dungeons or similar areas. levelvalue1

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 将岩石从眼前的地上吸附起来 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 撼动地面， 使大块岩石射向四面八方
description.en: Causes the ground to shake before hurling a massive stone mass at its surroundings.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的岩石长矛。
description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 生成复数个砂龙卷。 龙卷风们将一边自旋一边绕中心旋转。
description.en: Creates multiple sand tornadoes. The tornadoes continuously spin in circles.

description.zh: 力士獒的专用技能。 高高抡起右后腿重踏地面，释放冲击波， 对前方扇形范围造成攻击。
description.en: Bulldosu's exclusive skill. Raises its right hind leg high and stomps the ground, creating a shockwave that strikes enemies in a fan-shaped area ahead.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 曾经岛上有过力士獒相扑的娱乐活动， 若是最高级别的力士獒的话， 在受到草莽猪的突进攻击时， 结果反而是草莽猪会被击飞。
description.en: In the old islands, Bulldosu sumo was widely enjoyed. At the highest levels, even a charging Rushoar would be sent flying instead.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁受到的雷属性伤害减轻(15~30)%，并且不会陷入感电状态。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take (15~30)% less Electric damage and are immune to Electrify. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 扇形发射锋利的气刃。
description.en: Sends out sharp blades of air in a fan shape.

description.zh: 召唤陨石垂直落下， 并在撞击点产生冲击波。
description.en: Drops a meteorite straight down, generating a shock wave around the impact area.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 净世鹿的专用技能。 在前方引发大范围的圣光爆炸后， 边缓慢行走边在自身周围降下神圣之光。
description.en: Celesdir's exclusive skill. After igniting a burst of holy light across a vast area ahead, it strides forward, radiating holy light around itself.

description.zh: 发射一个缓慢追踪敌人的光球。 光球在接近目标时会分裂成无数光弹攻击敌人。
description.en: Unleashes a sphere of light that slowly tracks down an enemy. As it nears its target, it splits into countless light bullets that strike all at once.

description.zh: 古文书中，它被记载为「救赎之兽」。 净世鹿释放出的光芒能够将各种东西净化的一干二净。 字面意义上的，一点痕迹都不留的从世间消失。
description.en: Ancient texts refer to it as the |Beast of Salvation.| The light emitted by Celesdir purifies everything, literally causing things to vanish from existence without leaving a trace.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 净世鹿的攻击力和移动速度，会随着队伍中其他无属性帕鲁的数量提升，每只增加(2~6)%。 若它在队伍中，非战斗时每秒令玩家与队伍帕鲁的生命值恢复(0.15~0.75)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. This Pal's Attack and Movement Speed increases by (2~6)% for each other Neutral Pal in your party. When in party, recovers Health of the player and Party Pals by (0.15~0.75)% per second. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 将带有黑暗力量的高速能量弹射向敌人。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with dark energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 使用暗之力连续发射数支高速箭追击敌人。
description.en: Fires off dark energy that homes in on an enemy.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 于敌人周围生成数个暗黑龙卷风。
description.en: Generates several dark vortexes around the enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 织夜鹿的专用技能。 在前方引发大范围的暗属性爆炸， 随后边缓慢前行，边在自身周围降下暗之柱。
description.en: Celesdir Noct's exclusive skill. After igniting a burst of darkness across a vast area ahead, it strides forward, generating pillars of darkness around itself.

description.zh: 光芒越是耀眼，阴影就越是深邃。 散布笼罩万物的黑暗，重拾本应存在的混沌。 平衡对这个世界是必要的。
description.en: Where blinding radiance shines, dark shadows are born. It scatters an all-enveloping darkness to reclaim the chaos that ought to be. Balance is what the world requires.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，一同并肩作战的帕鲁的生命值会逐渐减少，但攻击力将提升(40~80)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, the Pal fighting alongside you gradually loses Health in exchange for (40~80)% Attack increase. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 用蕴藏龙之力的能量弹 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with draconic energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方呼出蕴含龙之力的气息 ，持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Exhales breath imbued with draconic energy, dealing continuous damage to those in front of it.

description.zh: 魔渊龙的专用技能。 在向前方挥出两拳后， 向下呼出龙属性的吐息。
description.en: Astegon's exclusive skill. After throwing two punches forward, it exhales a dragon breath downward.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 召唤大量小陨石 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Summons numerous small meteorites and launches them at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.
Defense +10%

description.zh: 来自深渊，暴乱之兽。 汝不得立于此兽之前。 汝不得聆听此兽之声。
description.en: A savage beast born of the abyss. Thou shall not stand before the beast. Thou shall not heed the beast.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 骑乘期间对矿石造成的伤害将提升(1100~3300)%，且金属矿石的掉落量提升(150~300)%。
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Increases the damage dealt to ores by (1100~3300)%, and you can obtain (150~300)% more Ore while mounted.

description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 泰锋的专用技能。 大幅回旋身体投掷出背后的岩盘。 岩盘将会以圆弧轨道状飞行。
description.en: Knocklem's exclusive skill. Takes a big swing and throws the ring from its back. The ring flies in a circular trajectory.

description.zh: 生成复数个砂龙卷。 龙卷风们将一边自旋一边绕中心旋转。
description.en: Creates multiple sand tornadoes. The tornadoes continuously spin in circles.

description.zh:
防御力+20%
免疫击退
description.en:
Defense +20%
Immune to Knockback

description.zh: 即便被拆解成215块零件，只要再拼装到一起， 便又能完好如初正常活动的神奇帕鲁。 需注意如果拼装过程中混进其他个体的零件， 它就会因为失去人格同一性而陷入抑郁。
description.en: Can be disassembled into 215 parts. It is capable of being reassembled and functioning again even if the parts are scattered. Mixing parts from different individuals will trigger a malfunction due to mistaken identity.

description.zh: 发动后会以钢铁般的意志，在一定时间内提高泰锋的攻击力(50~200)%，防御力(50~200)%。 Lv.Skill1
description.en: When activated, a steel resolve increases Knocklem's Attack by (50~200)% and Defense by (50~200)% for a limited time. Lv.Skill1

description.en: Fires three flaming arrows in succession that home in on an enemy.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成炙热的龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two flaming tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人的位置燃起火焰之墙。 火墙将持续一段时间， 对碰到的敌人造成伤害。
description.en: Creates a wall of flames at the enemy's location. The wall of flames will remain for a while, and deal damage to the enemies it touches.

description.zh: 使用火焰的力量做出复数个球体， 然后向敌人发射无数火球。
description.en: Creates multiple spheres of fiery energy, from which countless fireballs shoot towards the enemy.

description.zh: 向上空喷射无数熔岩弹。 一段时间后，射出的熔岩弹将如雨一般散落在周围。
description.en: Fires countless volcanic bombs into the sky. After a while, the bombs rain down around their originator.

description.zh: 使敌人周围地面活性化， 并在一定时间后爆炸。
description.en: Infuses the surrounding ground with energy, causing it to explode after a set amount of time.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.en: Knocklem Ignis's exclusive skill. Takes a big swing and throws the flaming ring from its back. The ring flies in a circular trajectory.

Defense +20%
Immune to Knockback

description.zh: 即便被拆解，只要再拼装到一起， 便又能完好如初正常活动的神奇帕鲁。 如果拼装过程中混进其他个体的零件，其思维就会发生致命错误， 最终导致过热。
description.en: Upon disassembly, it is capable of being reassembled and functioning again. Mixing parts from different individuals will trigger a fatal cognitive error that causes its systems to overheat.

description.zh: 发动后会以钢铁般的意志，在一定时间内提高丹烽的攻击力(60~210)%，防御力(60~210)%。 Lv.Skill1
description.en: When activated, a steel resolve increases Knocklem Ignis's Attack by (60~210)% and Defense by (60~210)% for a limited time. Lv.Skill1

description.zh: 用蕴藏龙之力的能量弹 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with draconic energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的冰刃。
description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方呼出蕴含龙之力的气息 ，持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Exhales breath imbued with draconic energy, dealing continuous damage to those in front of it.

description.zh: 向敌人的位置发射充满龙属性的能量弹。 能量弹在着弹时将向周围扩散，在前方广范围引发爆炸。
description.en: Fires an energy bullet imbued with dragon power at the enemy's location. Upon impact, the bullet shatters and creates a frontal long-range explosion.

description.zh: 向敌人发射积蓄着龙属性力量的能量弹。 能量弹在着弹时将引发大范围爆炸。
description.en: Fires an energy orb infused with draconic power at the enemy. The orb causes a wide-area explosion upon impact.

description.zh: 艾基鲁迦的专用技能。 在前方展开能够减轻各种伤害的能量盾的同时， 将突进道路上的敌人碾碎。
description.en: Silvegis's exclusive skill. Deploys a shield in front that reduces all types of attacks, then charges forward, crushing the enemy.

description.zh: 召唤大量小陨石 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Summons numerous small meteorites and launches them at an enemy.

description.zh:
防御力+20%
免疫击退
description.en:
Defense +20%
Immune to Knockback

description.zh: 颈部周围覆盖的金属部件，有着类似磁铁的性质。 如果靠近脚部的部件，就会自己互相吸附在一起。 虽然在颈部堆积了金属垃圾之后，会不情不愿的开始清理 但是由于总也取不下而变得暴躁。
description.en: The metallic components around its neck possess magnetic properties. If the leg pieces get too close, they cling to it. When metal debris builds up on its neck, it grudgingly begins cleaning, and grows frustrated when they won't come off easily.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，玩家的护盾开始修复的等候时间缩短(30~60)%，且护盾受到的伤害减少(65~80)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces shield regeneration delay by (30~60)% and reduces damage taken by your shield by (65~80)%. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的雷电球。
description.en: Releases lightning orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 快速放电 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

description.zh: 生成可笔直前进的雷击。
description.en: Generates a lightning bolt that moves forward in a line.

description.zh: 同时发射直线飞行的高速雷球， 和追踪敌人的慢速雷球。
description.en: A high-speed lightning ball that flies in a straight line. Simultaneously fires slow lightning balls that track the enemy.

description.zh: 向八个方向召唤直线推进的雷击。
description.en: Generates lightning strikes that travel in a straight line in all directions.

description.zh: 驭雷马的专用技能。 周身缠绕雷电，朝敌人高速猛冲。
description.en: Azurmane's exclusive skill. Cloaks the body in lightning and performs a high-speed charge toward the enemy.

description.zh: 驭雷马的专用技能。 以闪电般的速度移动， 并将途径的所有存在都卷入。
description.en: Azurmane's exclusive skill. Moves with the speed of lightning, engulfing everything in its path.

description.zh: 召唤巨大的雷属性龙卷风。 龙卷风将追踪敌人缓慢移动。
description.en: Generates a huge tornado of lightning that moves slowly towards the enemy.

description.zh: 和雷角马一样，曾经被视作雷神的使者。 由于雷角马不再受到人们信仰 便使得驭雷马被当作真正的雷神的使者 然而随着时代的变迁，它最终得到了拉车的马的地位。
description.en: Like Univolt, it was once believed to be connected to the Thunder God. As faith in Univolt waned, Azurmane was deemed the God's true envoy. Even so, time reduced both to the same lowly status of ordinary workhorses.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 此外，可在空中进行冲刺以高速移动。
description.en: Can be ridden. Grants Air Dash, to move at even higher speeds.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 扇形发射锋利的气刃。
description.en: Sends out sharp blades of air in a fan shape.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成砂砾龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 它在旧画籍上被描绘的体型要比现在娇小得多。 不知为何，近年来该物种的各方面体长数据都观察到急速上升。 照目前增长速度，预计100年后体长会达到现在的10倍。
description.en: In older paintings, it is depicted as much smaller than it is today. For reasons unknown, various parts of its body have begun to elongate rapidly in recent years, and it is predicted to reach nearly ten times its current size within the next century.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家承受的重力减弱，跳跃或坠落时会漂浮落地。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, reduces the effects of gravity on the player, making them more floaty while jumping and falling. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 快速放电 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

description.zh: 生成可笔直前进的雷击。
description.en: Generates a lightning bolt that moves forward in a line.

description.zh: 同时发射直线飞行的高速雷球， 和追踪敌人的慢速雷球。
description.en: A high-speed lightning ball that flies in a straight line. Simultaneously fires slow lightning balls that track the enemy.

description.zh: 让自己化作避雷针引来雷电， 并在原地引发闪电爆炸。
description.en: Acts as a lightning rod, calling down thunderbolts that electrocute the surrounding area.

description.zh: 积蓄雷电之力 瞄准敌人释放强劲电击。
description.en: Charges electric energy before blasting enemies with a powerful shock.

description.zh: 向八个方向召唤直线推进的雷击。
description.en: Generates lightning strikes that travel in a straight line in all directions.

description.zh: 电涡蜗及亚种的专用技能。 缩入壳中减伤并积蓄电能。 充满后释放电流，对周围敌人造成伤害。 放电后，短时间内自身雷属性技能攻击力提升。
description.en: Snock's exclusive skill. Withdraws into its shell to reduce damage taken while building electric charge. Once fully charged, it discharges, damaging nearby enemies. After discharging, the Attack of this Pal's Electric skills is increased for a limited time.

description.zh: 传统的健康疗法中有着，向浴缸中放入电涡蜗， 然后享受电疗浴的做法。 换句话说就是，古老偏方，切勿模仿。
description.en: Tossing an Snock into the bath for a shock spa is considered a traditional health practice. That is to say, the results may be rather shocking.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，会为玩家的攻击附加(2~6)点感电异常状态值。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, the player's attacks increase Electrify buildup by (2~6). (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 快速放电 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

description.zh: 将岩石从眼前的地上吸附起来 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 撼动地面， 使大块岩石射向四面八方
description.en: Causes the ground to shake before hurling a massive stone mass at its surroundings.

description.zh: 同时发射直线飞行的高速雷球， 和追踪敌人的慢速雷球。
description.en: A high-speed lightning ball that flies in a straight line. Simultaneously fires slow lightning balls that track the enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的岩石长矛。
description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 生成复数个砂龙卷。 龙卷风们将一边自旋一边绕中心旋转。
description.en: Creates multiple sand tornadoes. The tornadoes continuously spin in circles.

description.zh: 电涡蜗及亚种的专用技能。 缩入壳中减伤并积蓄电能。 充满后释放电流，对周围敌人造成伤害。 放电后，短时间内自身雷属性技能攻击力提升。
description.en: Snock's exclusive skill. Withdraws into its shell to reduce damage taken while building electric charge. Once fully charged, it discharges, damaging nearby enemies. After discharging, the Attack of this Pal's Electric skills is increased for a limited time.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 将滚烫的金涡蜗放进浴缸， 享受一场火热浴，这在遥远的古代曾经十分流行。 由于近年复古风潮兴起，它也再度成为了火热新趋势。
description.en: Tossing a heated Snock Terra into the bath for a scorching spa was once a fad of the distant past. Owing to a recent revival, it is now quite literally a hot trend.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁受到的水属性伤害减轻(15~30)%，并且不会陷入浸湿状态。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, player and party Pals take (15~30)% less Water damage, and are immune to Soak. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射风刃， 在击中敌人或树木时反弹并连续造成攻击， 最多可反弹4次。
description.en: Launches a blade of wind that rebounds off enemies or trees, striking repeatedly. Can ricochet up to four times.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 在敌人前方生成风刃， 并对其发动十字斩击。
description.en: Conjures blades of wind in front of the enemy, converging to deliver a cutting cross attack.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 它会将不好的记忆封存在绒毛球里。 风一吹，绒毛乘风而去， 忧郁的心情也随之飘散。
description.en: Its fluff can be used to hide away unpleasant memories. Once carried off by the wind, you can bid farewell to the darkness they carried.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，提升对陷入缠绕状态帕鲁的捕获概率。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases the capture rate of Pals afflicted with Ivy-Covered. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 将岩石从眼前的地上吸附起来 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

description.en: Generates two sand tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.en: Causes the ground to shake before hurling a massive stone mass at its surroundings.
