description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 生成复数个砂龙卷。 龙卷风们将一边自旋一边绕中心旋转。
description.en: Creates multiple sand tornadoes. The tornadoes continuously spin in circles.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 聆听大地的声响，避开不稳固的落脚点奔跑。 但若与某些地面不投缘，它就会被迷了眼， 然后摔得兔仰马翻。
description.en: Listens to the earth as it runs, avoiding unstable footing with ease. However, uncooperative terrain will trick it into falling over constantly.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家在冲刺期间的防御力提升(50~65)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases the player's Defense by (50~65)% while sprinting. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 将带有黑暗力量的高速能量弹射向敌人。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with dark energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 快速释放黑暗之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 于敌人周围生成数个暗黑龙卷风。
description.en: Generates several dark vortexes around the enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 睡着就变瘪了。 睡着了就不在里面了。 因为不存在睡着了的兜兜灵， 所以兜兜灵并没有睡着。
description.en: When it sleeps, it deflates. When it sleeps, it's no longer there. A sleeping Hoodle cannot exist; Therefore, Hoodle never sleeps.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家对非战斗状态的敌人造成的伤害提升(50~100)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases the player's damage dealt to enemies that are not in combat by (50~100)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 向敌人发射高速直线飞行的雷枪。
description.en: Fires a high-speed lightning spear straight ahead towards the enemy.

description.zh: 快速放电 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

description.zh: 生成两个蕴含雷电能量的球 然后瞄准敌人，从中发射无数雷球。
description.en: Creates two balls of electric energy that fire numerous lightning orbs at enemies.

description.zh: 生成可笔直前进的雷击。
description.en: Generates a lightning bolt that moves forward in a line.

description.zh: 同时发射直线飞行的高速雷球， 和追踪敌人的慢速雷球。
description.en: A high-speed lightning ball that flies in a straight line. Simultaneously fires slow lightning balls that track the enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄雷电之力 瞄准敌人释放强劲电击。
description.en: Charges electric energy before blasting enemies with a powerful shock.

description.zh: 向八个方向召唤直线推进的雷击。
description.en: Generates lightning strikes that travel in a straight line in all directions.

description.zh: 想吃就吃，想睡就睡，想干什么就干什么。 电懒懒们为了维持这样的生活，一定也在我们看不见的地方努力着。 ......如果不强迫自己这么想的话，以前的岛民们的日子就没法过了。
description.en: Doing as they please, sleeping when they wish, and eating whatever they like. Surely, Slowatt must be toiling in secret to maintain such a luxury. ...Or so the old islanders told themselves, just to get by.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家的攻击击中感电状态的敌人时，会令敌人放电，对周围的敌人造成相当于玩家攻击力(40~60)%的伤害。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Electrify, the enemy discharges electricity, dealing damage equal to (40~60)% of the player's attack damage to nearby enemies. (Does not stack.) levelvalue1

description.zh: 快速释放黑暗之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 于敌人周围生成数个暗黑龙卷风。
description.en: Generates several dark vortexes around the enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 吓唬人就是它的生存意义，但是却完全不可怕。 但因为它太过可爱，大家总会忍不住装出被吓到的样子。 吓丝妮已经成为给人们带来笑容的使者了。
description.en: It lives entirely for the thrill of the scare, but is utterly un-frightening. As most cannot help but indulge it with feigned surprise for its cuteness, Bakemi now leaves a trail of smiles in its wake.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，攻击陷入中毒状态的敌人时，会使该敌人的攻击力降低(40~80)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, attacking enemies afflicted with Poison reduces their Attack by (40~80)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 发射大量泡沫 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 召唤一束直线前进的水柱。
description.en: Generates a column of water that travels in a straight line.

description.zh: 向前方发射高压水流。 片刻后，水流会向左右分岔。
description.en: Fires a high-pressure stream of water forward. After a short delay, the stream branches off to the left and right.

description.zh: 连续在敌人的脚下生成水柱结成的墙壁。
description.en: Continously creates walls made from water columns at the enemy's location.

description.zh: 用压缩水流一扫前方。 被扫过的区域会在片刻后喷出水柱。
description.en: Mows down the frontal area with a blast of compressed water. The area struck by the blast erupts with water after a short delay.

description.zh: 猛烈地释放出水流 并向前方大范围横扫。
description.en: Shoots pressurized water at extreme velocities, sweeping over a wide area in front of it.

description.zh: 在敌人四周掀起波浪并涌向敌人， 最后在中心点爆炸，喷出高高的水柱。
description.en: Generates waves that surge around the enemy from all sides. They converge and explode at the center, erupting into a column of water.

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh: 通过旋转螺旋桨般的尾巴获得推进力。 根据以前的研究，若是能忽视肉体的崩溃， 理论上能够实现时速141.6km/h的游泳速度。
description.en: Its corkscrew tail acts as a propeller. Research claims that if its body could withstand the strain, it could reach speeds beyond 88 mph.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在水上移动。 若它在队伍中，会更容易钓上高潜力帕鲁。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden to travel on water. While in party, makes it easier to fish up talented Pals. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 发射水弹 笔直飞向对方。
description.en: Hurls a ball of water straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 快速放电 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

description.zh: 向前方发射高压水流。 片刻后，水流会向左右分岔。
description.en: Fires a high-pressure stream of water forward. After a short delay, the stream branches off to the left and right.

description.zh: 同时发射直线飞行的高速雷球， 和追踪敌人的慢速雷球。
description.en: A high-speed lightning ball that flies in a straight line. Simultaneously fires slow lightning balls that track the enemy.

description.zh: 召唤雷电 在一定时间后生成大量落电。
description.en: Calls lightning that strikes an enemy after a set amount of time has passed.

description.zh: 在敌人四周掀起波浪并涌向敌人， 最后在中心点爆炸，喷出高高的水柱。
description.en: Generates waves that surge around the enemy from all sides. They converge and explode at the center, erupting into a column of water.

description.zh: 召唤巨大的雷属性龙卷风。 龙卷风将追踪敌人缓慢移动。
description.en: Generates a huge tornado of lightning that moves slowly towards the enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh: 通过旋转螺旋桨般的尾巴从而产生电力。 虽然理论上能产生1.21吉瓦的电力， 但是肉体会在瞬间崩溃，并没有实际应用价值。
description.en: Its corkscrew tail acts as a propeller. Research claims that if its body could withstand the strain, it could generate over 1.21 gigawatts of power.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在水上移动。 骑乘期间玩家的攻击会转变为雷属性，且攻击力提升(5~20)%。 此外，若它在队伍中，会更容易钓上高潜力帕鲁。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Electric and increases Attack by (5~20)%. While in party, makes it easier to fish up talented Pals. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 发射大量泡沫 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。
description.en: Charges a massive amount of energy before firing a large destructive ball.

description.zh: 扇形发射锋利的气刃。
description.en: Sends out sharp blades of air in a fan shape.

description.zh: 连续在敌人的脚下生成水柱结成的墙壁。
description.en: Continously creates walls made from water columns at the enemy's location.

description.zh: 用压缩水流一扫前方。 被扫过的区域会在片刻后喷出水柱。
description.en: Mows down the frontal area with a blast of compressed water. The area struck by the blast erupts with water after a short delay.

description.zh: 积蓄破坏性的能量， 朝前方大范围射出威力惊人的光束。
description.en: Charges destructive energy before firing a high-powered beam forward across a wide area.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 爪尖的长毛是炫耀的资本。 它对于污渍很敏感，一直都小心翼翼的护理着毛发。 要是附近扬起了灰尘，就会露出非常嫌弃的表情。
description.en: It uses the long, flowing fur on its hands to attract attention, always taking the utmost care to keep them maintained. Highly sensitive to dirt and meticulously clean, kicking up dust nearby will invite a very disgusted glare.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，其他队伍帕鲁的伙伴技能冷却时间缩短(10~50)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, reduces the Partner Skill cooldowns for other party Pals by (10~50)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 快速释放龙之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges draconic energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 向前方呼出蕴含龙之力的气息 ，持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Exhales breath imbued with draconic energy, dealing continuous damage to those in front of it.

description.zh: 用龙属性的射线一扫前方。 被扫过地方将产生延迟爆炸。
description.en: Mows down the area in front with a beam imbued with dragon power. The area struck by the beam will also explode after a short delay.

description.zh: 召唤陨石接连落下， 并在撞击点产生冲击波。
description.en: Drops meteorites one after another, generating shock waves around the impact areas.

description.zh: 灵曦龙及亚种的专用技能。 高速逼近敌人，以尾巴进行斩击。
description.en: Eidrolon's exclusive skill. Closes in on the enemy at high speed to deliver a cleaving swipe with its tail.

description.zh: 召唤大量小陨石 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Summons numerous small meteorites and launches them at an enemy.

description.zh: 灵曦龙及亚种的专用技能。 持续喷吐高温光线。 最终在光线落点引发剧烈爆炸。
description.en: Eidrolon's exclusive skill. Emits a superheated light beam for a short time. At the final moment, the targeted area is engulfed in a massive explosion.

description.zh: 召唤无数陨石落下， 并在撞击点产生冲击波。
description.en: Drops countless meteorites, generating an array of shock waves.

description.zh: 直到最近才开始被目击到的新型帕鲁。 性情沉稳又安静，只想要自由的生活着。 已经，不再有任何束缚了。
description.en: A new Pal that was only recently discovered. Calm and entirely docile, it spends its time as it pleases. It is no longer bound by anything.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 灵曦龙的攻击力和移动速度，会随着队伍中其他龙属性或暗属性帕鲁的数量提升，每只增加(2~6)%。
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal's Attack and Movement Speed increase by (2~6)% for each other Dragon or Dark Pal in your party.

description.zh: 快速释放龙之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges draconic energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 面向敌人释放火焰， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Shoots flames at an enemy, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 向敌人的位置发射充满龙属性的能量弹。 能量弹在着弹时将向周围扩散，在前方广范围引发爆炸。
description.en: Fires an energy bullet imbued with dragon power at the enemy's location. Upon impact, the bullet shatters and creates a frontal long-range explosion.

description.zh: 向敌人发射积蓄着龙属性力量的能量弹。 能量弹在着弹时将引发大范围爆炸。
description.en: Fires an energy orb infused with draconic power at the enemy. The orb causes a wide-area explosion upon impact.

description.zh: 灵曦龙及亚种的专用技能。 高速逼近敌人，以尾巴进行斩击。
description.en: Eidrolon's exclusive skill. Closes in on the enemy at high speed to deliver a cleaving swipe with its tail.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 灵曦龙及亚种的专用技能。 持续喷吐高温光线。 最终在光线落点引发剧烈爆炸。
description.en: Eidrolon's exclusive skill. Emits a superheated light beam for a short time. At the final moment, the targeted area is engulfed in a massive explosion.

description.zh: 召唤无数陨石落下， 并在撞击点产生冲击波。
description.en: Drops countless meteorites, generating an array of shock waves.

description.zh: 直到最近才开始被目击到的新型帕鲁。 性情暴躁，总是对什么东西发泄怒气。 已经，不会再去相信任何事物了。
description.en: A new Pal that was only recently discovered. It trusts nothing and no one, and its tempermental nature leads to it constantly venting its rage at the nearest target.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 狱熙龙的攻击力和移动速度，会随着队伍中其他龙属性或火属性帕鲁的数量提升，每只增加(2~6)%。
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal's Attack and Movement Speed increase by (2~6)% for each other Dragon or Fire Pal in your party. (Excluding Eidrolon Ignis)

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的雷电球。
description.en: Releases lightning orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 快速放电 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

description.zh: 发射雷电球 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires an electric ball that slowly pursues an enemy.

description.zh: 扇形发射锋利的气刃。
description.en: Sends out sharp blades of air in a fan shape.

description.zh: 在敌人头上生成3次落雷。
description.en: Generates lightning that strikes an enemy three times from above.

description.zh: 让自己化作避雷针引来雷电， 并在原地引发闪电爆炸。
description.en: Acts as a lightning rod, calling down thunderbolts that electrocute the surrounding area.

description.zh: 召唤雷电 在一定时间后生成大量落电。
description.en: Calls lightning that strikes an enemy after a set amount of time has passed.

description.zh: 召唤巨大的雷属性龙卷风。 龙卷风将追踪敌人缓慢移动。
description.en: Generates a huge tornado of lightning that moves slowly towards the enemy.

description.zh: 要在食物匮乏的高空生存 有时甚至会连猎物的脑子都吃。 一种说法是，雷云鹫为了寻求更稳定的食物来源， 一部分族群从高空迁移到了低空，最终演化成了迅雷鸟。
description.en: With so little to eat at high altitudes, it will occasionally even feast on its enemies' brains. It is thought that groups seeking a more dependable food source descended to lower skies, ultimately diverging into Beakon.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 若它在据点里，帕鲁蛋的孵化速度加快(20~40)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While at a base, shortens the time it takes to incubate eggs by (20~40)%. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 扇形射出锐利的风刃。
description.en: Launches sharp blades of air that fan out.

description.zh: 发射风刃， 在击中敌人或树木时反弹并连续造成攻击， 最多可反弹4次。
description.en: Launches a blade of wind that rebounds off enemies or trees, striking repeatedly. Can ricochet up to four times.

description.zh: 在敌人前方生成风刃， 并对其发动十字斩击。
description.en: Conjures blades of wind in front of the enemy, converging to deliver a cutting cross attack.

description.zh: 大红呱的专用技能。 先轻柔地浮空，再以利爪重重砸向地面。
description.en: Tropicaw's exclusive skill. Leaps lightly into the air, then forcefully slams its sharp claws into the ground.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 有人认为它之所以经常摇头晃脑的，是为了拟态成被风吹动的花朵。 但是也有人反驳， 难道不是快速扭来扭去的红花看起来太掉SAN，所以谁都不想接近吗。
description.en: While some say that it flails around to mimic flowers swaying in the wind and avoid predators, others argue that a crimson flower thrashing violently at high speeds is simply so unsettling that nothing dares approach it.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家进行翻滚或滑步动作时，无敌时间延长(15~30)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, extends the invincibility period during dodge rolls and dodge steps by (15~30)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 聚精会神，从火焰中窥探未来。 要是看见了不合心意的未来，就会一直重抽，直到抽出满意的结果。 所以昭炎狐的未来一直都是一片光明！
description.en:
It focuses its mind and reads the future through flames.
Should it glimpse an inconvenient destiny, it relentlessly rerolls the prophecy until it gets a favorable result.
That is why the future of Flaracle is always exceptionally bright!

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家的攻击击中点燃状态的敌人时，会使敌人爆炸，额外造成相当于玩家攻击力(40~60)%的伤害。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Burn, the enemy explodes, dealing damage equal to (40~60)% of the player's attack damage to nearby enemies. (Does not stack.) levelvalue1

description.zh: 发射大量泡沫 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 向前方发射高压水流。 片刻后，水流会向左右分岔。
description.en: Fires a high-pressure stream of water forward. After a short delay, the stream branches off to the left and right.

description.zh: 在敌人的位置和其周围刺出尖锐的根刺。
description.en: Sprouts sharp roots in and around the enemy's location.

description.zh: 猛烈地释放出水流 并向前方大范围横扫。
description.en: Shoots pressurized water at extreme velocities, sweeping over a wide area in front of it.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 沁莲龙的专用技能。 潜入地下隐匿身形。 随后化作花苞现身地表，绽放时对大范围敌人发动攻击。
description.en: Ophydia's exclusive skill. Burrows into the ground and vanishes. It then emerges at the surface as a flower bud, blooms, and unleashes a wide-area attack.

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh: 沁莲龙居住的水边，生有大量的外观相似的花朵。 研究者虽多次实验人工繁育花朵， 但只要进行了人为干预，无论怎样花朵都会枯萎。
description.en: Waters where Ophydias dwell are often filled with flowers that mimic its form. Many attempts have been made to directly propagate these blooms, but they inevitably wither the moment human hands interfere.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，会为玩家的攻击附加(2~6)点浸湿异常状态值。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, the player's attacks increase Soak buildup by (2~6). (Does not stack)

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 面向敌人释放火焰， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Shoots flames at an enemy, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 在敌人的位置燃起火焰之墙。 火墙将持续一段时间， 对碰到的敌人造成伤害。
description.en: Creates a wall of flames at the enemy's location. The wall of flames will remain for a while, and deal damage to the enemies it touches.

description.zh: 使用火焰的力量做出复数个球体， 然后向敌人发射无数火球。
description.en: Creates multiple spheres of fiery energy, from which countless fireballs shoot towards the enemy.

description.zh: 向上空喷射无数熔岩弹。 一段时间后，射出的熔岩弹将如雨一般散落在周围。
description.en: Fires countless volcanic bombs into the sky. After a while, the bombs rain down around their originator.

description.zh: 使敌人周围地面活性化， 并在一定时间后爆炸。
description.en: Infuses the surrounding ground with energy, causing it to explode after a set amount of time.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 拉比耶尔的专用技能。 制造2道幻影迷惑敌人， 本体则从丝绸礼帽中放出炎鸟进行攻击。
description.en: Dupin's exclusive skill. Creates two illusions to distract enemies, then launches fire birds from its top hat.

description.zh: 有时会被自己召唤的分身打败，并被取而代之。 就连它自己也不太清楚昨天的拉比耶尔和今天的拉比耶尔还是同一只吗。
description.en: A copy it created might quietly replace it, leaving even the Dupin itself unsure whether it is still the original.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，当玩家的生命值低于50%时，拉比耶尔会在玩家周边掀起爆炸冲击波（火属性 / 威力: (100~200) / 点燃积蓄值: 777）。）。 此外，玩家的生命值低于50%期间，玩家的攻击力提升(30~50)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, when the player's Health falls below 50%, Dupin generates an explosion around the player (Fire / Power: (100~200) / Burn buildup: 777). Additionally, while the player's Health is below 50%, the player's Attack is increased by (30~50)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的高速暗黑球。
description.en: Fires high-speed dark orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 将带有黑暗力量的高速能量弹射向敌人。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with dark energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 使用暗之力连续发射数支高速箭追击敌人。
description.en: Fires off dark energy that homes in on an enemy.

description.zh: 扇形发射锋利的气刃。
description.en: Sends out sharp blades of air in a fan shape.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 于敌人周围生成数个暗黑龙卷风。
description.en: Generates several dark vortexes around the enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 爪子有些不太老实，会趁人不注意顺爪牵羊。 就算快暴露了也没关系。 只要迅速连「眼睛」一起偷走，那就不会被目击到行窃现场了。
description.en: A thief by nature, it snatches items when no one is looking. No reason to be concerned when caught in the act. Once it swiftly steals your eyes, you won’t be seeing anything anyway.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁对黑暗状态的敌人造成的伤害将提升(50~65)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Blind by (50~65)%. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 于前方制造毒雾， 使目标陷入中毒状态。
description.en: Generates a fog of poison in front, causing the opponent to become poisoned.

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.zh: 快速释放黑暗之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 使出浑身力量 向各个方向喷洒毒球。
description.en: Focuses energy into the body and scatters poison orbs in all directions.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 梅杜娜的专用技能。 头部的蛇会吐出呈抛物线飞行的毒液球。 毒液球落地便会化为沼泽，令接触沼泽者陷入中毒状态。
description.en: Venusa's exclusive skill. The snakes on her head spit toxic globs in a wide arc. The poisonous pool left at the impact point inflicts Poison on anyone who touches it.

description.zh: 一遇到不明白的事情，就会和脑袋上的蛇一起开会。 但由于所有的蛇本质上都是它自己， 因此它唯一能弄明白的是，自己什么都不明白。
description.en: Whenever it's confused, it resorts to consulting with the snakes on its head. However, since they're all ultimately the same being, it comes to understand that nothing is understood.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，会为玩家的攻击附加(2~6)点黑暗异常状态值。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, the player's attacks increase Blind buildup by (2~6). (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 用蕴藏剧毒之力的淤泥 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls poison sludge at an enemy.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 扇形射出锐利的风刃。
description.en: Launches sharp blades of air that fan out.

description.zh: 使出浑身力量 向各个方向喷洒毒球。
description.en: Focuses energy into the body and scatters poison orbs in all directions.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 在敌人前方生成风刃， 并对其发动十字斩击。
description.en: Conjures blades of wind in front of the enemy, converging to deliver a cutting cross attack.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 在它眼中，人类不过是方便的寄生对象罢了。 红菇娘之所以演化成现在的模样， 就是为了让人类放松警惕，从而更高效地传播孢子。
description.en: It views humans as nothing more than convenient parasitic hosts. The reason Mycora has taken this form is to deceive humans into lowering their guard, allowing its spores to spread more efficiently.

description.zh: 若它在据点里，其他据点帕鲁的制药工作适应性等级+1。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While at a base, increases the Medicine Production Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 使用火焰的力量做出复数个球体， 然后向敌人发射无数火球。
description.en: Creates multiple spheres of fiery energy, from which countless fireballs shoot towards the enemy.

description.zh: 向上空喷射无数熔岩弹。 一段时间后，射出的熔岩弹将如雨一般散落在周围。
description.en: Fires countless volcanic bombs into the sky. After a while, the bombs rain down around their originator.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 妖焰灯的专用技能。 高举提灯，召唤出多个执念深重的怨灵， 紧追敌人不放。
description.en: Loomen's exclusive skill. Raises a lantern and summons multiple spirits that relentlessly pursue enemies.

description.zh: 闪烁着妖异光芒的提灯，映照出世界的真实样貌。 若是感到提灯的光芒刺眼， 那想必是做了亏心事吧。
description.en: Its lantern glows with an eerie light that lays bare the truth of the world. If that light strikes you as blinding, then you most likely have something to hide.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家射箭命中目标时会爆炸，额外造成相当于玩家攻击力(15~30)%的伤害。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, the player's arrows explode on contact, dealing additional damage equal to (15~30)% of the player's attack damage. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 将带有黑暗力量的高速能量弹射向敌人。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with dark energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 使用暗之力连续发射数支高速箭追击敌人。
description.en: Fires off dark energy that homes in on an enemy.

description.zh: 召唤陨石垂直落下， 并在撞击点产生冲击波。
description.en: Drops a meteorite straight down, generating a shock wave around the impact area.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 召唤陨石接连落下， 并在撞击点产生冲击波。
description.en: Drops meteorites one after another, generating shock waves around the impact areas.

description.zh: 在敌人周围生成一碰就爆炸的星星。 星星在经过一定时间后，没有触碰也会爆炸。
description.en: Generates stars around the enemy that explode on contact. Stars also explode after some time.

description.zh: 召唤大量小陨石 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Summons numerous small meteorites and launches them at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 当其生命走到尽头时，夜空中的某处便会多出一颗星星。 一生中的回忆越多，其光芒越是璀璨。
description.en: At the end of its life, a new star appears somewhere in the skies, glowing with the weight of its memories.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，暗属性帕鲁的防御力提升(15~30)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases Defense of Dark Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 发射逐渐加速的黑暗能量弹
description.en: Fires a dark energy projectile that accelerates over time.

description.zh: 将带有黑暗力量的高速能量弹射向敌人。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with dark energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 扇形发射锋利的气刃。
description.en: Sends out sharp blades of air in a fan shape.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 墨罗娜的专用技能。 向斜前方跃起，投掷黑色锋利的羽刃进行攻击。
description.en: Solenne's exclusive skill. Jumps diagonally and throws sharp black feathers at enemies.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 经历过美好的体验之后，若不经历同等程度糟糕的体验就无法释怀。 若要精心养育墨罗娜的话， 必须要做好相应的心理准备。
description.en: Joy and misery come in equal measure for Solenne. Those who choose to take care of one must be prepared for what that entails.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，并且所有队伍帕鲁的种类都不同时，玩家的攻击力会提升(30~80)%。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases the player's Attack by (30~80)% if all Pals in party are different species. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 瞄准后发射可笔直飞向敌人 的火焰弹。
description.en: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 面向敌人释放火焰， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Shoots flames at an enemy, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 在敌人的位置燃起火焰之墙。 火墙将持续一段时间， 对碰到的敌人造成伤害。
description.en: Creates a wall of flames at the enemy's location. The wall of flames will remain for a while, and deal damage to the enemies it touches.

description.zh: 使用火焰的力量做出复数个球体， 然后向敌人发射无数火球。
description.en: Creates multiple spheres of fiery energy, from which countless fireballs shoot towards the enemy.

description.zh: 向上空喷射无数熔岩弹。 一段时间后，射出的熔岩弹将如雨一般散落在周围。
description.en: Fires countless volcanic bombs into the sky. After a while, the bombs rain down around their originator.

description.zh: 使敌人周围地面活性化， 并在一定时间后爆炸。
description.en: Infuses the surrounding ground with energy, causing it to explode after a set amount of time.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 和敌人对峙时， 总是会做一些看似破绽百出的夸张动作。 可神奇的是，对手往往会被震慑住，愣愣地盯着它看。
description.en: At a glance, its movements appear exaggerated and full of openings. Strangely, however, any opponents become overwhelmed, and become unable to look away, as if transfixed.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，会为玩家的攻击附加(2~6)点点燃异常状态值。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, the player's attacks increase Burn buildup by (2~6). (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 向前方射出大量的小石头碎屑。
description.en: Fires a barrage of stones forward.

description.zh: 向敌人的位置发射充满龙属性的能量弹。 能量弹在着弹时将向周围扩散，在前方广范围引发爆炸。
description.en: Fires an energy bullet imbued with dragon power at the enemy's location. Upon impact, the bullet shatters and creates a frontal long-range explosion.

description.zh: 撼动地面， 使大块岩石射向四面八方
description.en: Causes the ground to shake before hurling a massive stone mass at its surroundings.

description.zh: 向敌人发射积蓄着龙属性力量的能量弹。 能量弹在着弹时将引发大范围爆炸。
description.en: Fires an energy orb infused with draconic power at the enemy. The orb causes a wide-area explosion upon impact.

description.zh: 生成复数个砂龙卷。 龙卷风们将一边自旋一边绕中心旋转。
description.en: Creates multiple sand tornadoes. The tornadoes continuously spin in circles.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 召唤大量小陨石 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Summons numerous small meteorites and launches them at an enemy.

description.zh: 磐甲龙的专用技能。 从羽翼射出无数爆裂导弹，对敌人进行轰炸。
description.en: Aegidron's exclusive skill. Launches countless explosive missiles from its wings.

description.zh:
防御力+20%
免疫击退
description.en:
Defense +20%
Immune to Knockback

description.zh: 很久以前，在通信手段匮乏的年代， 人们曾通过闪烁磐甲龙翅膀内侧的光芒， 传递简单的信号。
description.en: In ancient times, when means of communication were limited, the light within Aegidron's wings was used to send simple flash signals.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁受到的爆炸攻击伤害减轻(60~80)%，并且不会陷入眩晕状态。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take (60~80)% less damage from explosive attacks, and are immune to Stun. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的雷电球。
description.en: Releases lightning orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 快速放电 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

description.zh: 暴电熊的专用技能。 飞扑向敌人，并用带电流的爪子将其劈开。 飞扑2次后，面向地面伸出爪子， 大范围扩散电流。
description.en: Grizzbolt's exclusive skill. After leaping at an enemy and tearing at it twice with its electrically charged claws, it attacks the ground, sending an electric shock throughout the area.

description.zh: 生成可笔直前进的雷击。
description.en: Generates a lightning bolt that moves forward in a line.

description.zh: 在敌人头上生成3次落雷。
description.en: Generates lightning that strikes an enemy three times from above.

description.zh: 让自己化作避雷针引来雷电， 并在原地引发闪电爆炸。
description.en: Acts as a lightning rod, calling down thunderbolts that electrocute the surrounding area.

description.zh: 积蓄雷电之力 瞄准敌人释放强劲电击。
description.en: Charges electric energy before blasting enemies with a powerful shock.

description.zh: 暴电熊的专用技能。 不知从哪取出加特林机枪进行扫射。 最后一发将射出强力的充能弹。
description.en: Grizzbolt's exclusive skill. Pulls out a minigun out of nowhere and starts blasting. Finishes with a single, charged power shot.

description.zh: 锁定敌人后，连续射出超高速的雷射。
description.en: After aiming at the enemy, fires multiple ultra-fast lightning lasers.

description.zh: 它拥有豪迈的笑容和强壮的体格。 在自己认可的搭档面前会表现得相当温顺。 可是不知为何，一旦拿到机关枪时就会性情大变。
description.en: With a friendly smile and a hardy physique, it is docile towards one it recognizes as a partner. For reasons unexplained, its personality undergoes a drastic change when wielding a minigun.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间它还能用机关枪连续攻击。
description.en: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a minigun while mounted.

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大水球 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of water and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 在左右两侧生成龙卷风， 并扇向敌人。
description.en: Generates two tornadoes on either side before launching them at an enemy.

description.zh: 用地下尖锐的根部追击敌人 并从脚下贯穿敌人。
description.en: Generates spiny thorns that chase an enemy along the ground, piercing them from below.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 百合女王的专用技能。 使用治愈的力量恢复范围内同伴的HP。
description.en: Lyleen's exclusive skill. Restores health to all allies within range using the power of healing.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 草属性攻击伤害增加30%
description.en: 30% increase in Grass attack damage.

description.zh: 这是一种充满慈爱且温和的帕鲁。 会照顾失去双亲的小帕鲁们。 管教方式是全力释放太阳光束。
description.en:
A docile Pal full of love.
It watches over small Pals who have lost their parents.
It uses a full-power to discipline naughty Pals.

description.zh: 发动后便能通过女王的疗愈能力，为玩家和队伍内的帕鲁恢复(80~90)%的生命值。 levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, the queen's soothing graces restore the Health of the player and Party Pals by (80~90)%. levelvalue1

description.zh: 制造出新月型的冰刃， 将之射向前方。
description.en: Creates a crescent blade of ice and hurls it forward.

description.zh: 快速释放黑暗之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 朝敌人喷出冰冷空气， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 在敌人周围生成一碰就爆炸的星星。 星星在经过一定时间后，没有触碰也会爆炸。
description.en: Generates stars around the enemy that explode on contact. Stars also explode after some time.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 这是一种风度翩翩且行为优雅的帕鲁。 会使用超强巴掌对付无礼之人。 但偶尔也会出现以此为乐的帕鲁。
description.en: An elegant Pal full of grace. It admonishes any who are disrespectful with a painful slap. Some Pals actively seek out this punishment.

description.zh: 发动后便能通过女王的疗愈能力，为玩家和队伍内的帕鲁恢复(85~95)%的生命值。 levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, the queen's soothing graces restore the Health of the player and Party Pals by (85~95)%. levelvalue1

description.zh: 波鲁杰克斯的专用技能。 向上跳起后召唤雷枪， 将之丢向敌人。
description.en: Orserk's exclusive skill. Summons a spear of lightning while leaping into the air before throwing it at an enemy.

description.zh: 让自己化作避雷针引来雷电， 并在原地引发闪电爆炸。
description.en: Acts as a lightning rod, calling down thunderbolts that electrocute the surrounding area.

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的雷电球。
description.en: Releases lightning orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 向前方呼出蕴含龙之力的气息 ，持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Exhales breath imbued with draconic energy, dealing continuous damage to those in front of it.

description.zh: 生成可笔直前进的雷击。
description.en: Generates a lightning bolt that moves forward in a line.

description.zh: 在敌人头上生成3次落雷。
description.en: Generates lightning that strikes an enemy three times from above.

description.zh: 积蓄雷电之力 瞄准敌人释放强劲电击。
description.en: Charges electric energy before blasting enemies with a powerful shock.

description.zh: 波鲁杰克斯的专用技能。 召唤数把雷枪，向敌人投掷而出，并引发爆炸。
description.en: Orserk's exclusive skill. Summons numerous thunder spears and hurls them at the enemy. The first spear is imbued with the power of lightning and explodes after a few seconds.

description.zh: 召唤无数陨石落下， 并在撞击点产生冲击波。
description.en: Drops countless meteorites, generating an array of shock waves.

description.zh: 雷属性攻击伤害增加30%
description.en: 30% increase in Lightning attack damage.

description.zh: 它的电击能从伤口进入，以此灼烧对手的全身。 波鲁杰克斯同类之间发生的争吵， 能在一瞬间决出胜负。
description.en: It sends electricity into its foes' wounds, roasting them from the inside out. Fights between Orserk end in the blink of an eye.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，子弹击中敌人时，一同并肩作战的帕鲁的攻击力与防御力会提升(1~5)%。 该效果最多可累积30层，持续5秒。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, hitting an enemy with a bullet increases the Attack and Defense of the Pal fighting alongside you by (1~5)% for 5 seconds. This effect stacks up to 30 times. (Does not stack.) levelvalue1

description.zh: 瞄准后发射可笔直飞向敌人 的火焰弹。
description.en: Hurls a ball of fire straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 连续发射3支高速火箭 并追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three flaming arrows in succession that home in on an enemy.

description.zh: 向敌人发射火球。 稍作飞行后会破裂 并向前方放射小型火球。
description.en: Shoots a fireball toward an enemy. The fireball explodes after a short distance, generating smaller fireballs that spread forward.

description.zh: 面向敌人释放火焰， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Shoots flames at an enemy, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 荷鲁斯的专用技能。 扇起炙热龙卷风后， 身体被狱火包围，一边滑翔一边突袭敌人。
description.en: Faleris' exclusive skill. After creating scorching tornadoes, it cloaks itself in hellfire and charges forward.

description.zh: 使敌人周围地面活性化， 并在一定时间后爆炸。
description.en: Infuses the surrounding ground with energy, causing it to explode after a set amount of time.

description.zh: 在头上生成巨大火球，并向敌人发射。 中弹后会爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of flame and hurls it at an enemy. The ball explodes over a wide area upon impact.

description.zh: 荷鲁斯的专用技能。 卷起数个灼热的龙卷风， 同时身缠烈焰，飞空向敌人突进。 龙卷风最终将融合为巨大火龙卷。
description.en: Faleris' exclusive skill. Generates multiple scorching tornadoes and charges forward while gliding. The tornadoes converge in the center and eventually merge into a single massive tornado.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 一旦它发现猎物的族群， 就会用灼热的旋风，将那片区域焚烧殆尽。 因此荷鲁斯的栖息地总是飘荡着美味的气息。
description.en: When it finds its prey it unleashes a whirlwind of flames, burning the entire area to ash. Faleris breath is known for its pleasing scent.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 若它在队伍中，击倒冰属性帕鲁时获得的掉落道具增加(40~80)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, Ice Pals drop (40~80)% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 朝敌人发射高速水弹。
description.en: Hurls a high speed ball of water at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射大量泡沫 并缓慢追击敌人。
description.en: Fires numerous bubbles that slowly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 生成酸性云朵 在敌人头上下酸雨。
description.en: Creates acidic clouds that pour down acid rain on enemies.

description.zh: 召唤一束直线前进的水柱。
description.en: Generates a column of water that travels in a straight line.

description.zh: 连续在敌人的脚下生成水柱结成的墙壁。
description.en: Continously creates walls made from water columns at the enemy's location.

description.zh: 伊西斯的专用技能。 扇起漩涡龙卷风后， 化身为波涛，一边滑翔一边突袭敌人。
description.en: Faleris Aqua's exclusive skill. After summoning a massive tornado, it envelops its body in water and charges forward.

description.zh: 猛烈地释放出水流 并向前方大范围横扫。
description.en: Shoots pressurized water at extreme velocities, sweeping over a wide area in front of it.

description.zh: 在敌人所在位置及其周围区域 喷出大量水柱。
description.en: Erupts massive pillars of water beneath and around the enemy.

description.zh: 一旦它发现猎物的族群， 就会用强力的水流，将那片区域冲刷殆尽。 由于基本上都会把猎物冲到不知道什么地方去， 这一行为究竟能否定义为捕猎，非常的有待商榷。
description.en:
When it finds its prey, it unleashes a mighty torrent, sweeping the entire area.
More often than not, the prey gets swept away in the chaos, leaving one to wonder whether this truly counts as hunting.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 若它在队伍中，击倒火属性帕鲁时获得的掉落道具增加(40~80)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, Fire Pals drop (40~80)% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 以急速射出空气团块。
description.en: Quickly fires a burst of highly pressurized air.

description.zh: 快速释放黑暗之力 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges dark energy, damaging those around it.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 异构格里芬的专用技能。 在向前猛冲的同时制造出光球。 光球会自动捕捉敌人，并射出大量激光。
description.en: Charges forward, generating orbs of light that automatically target enemies and unleash a barrage of lasers.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 异构格里芬的专用技能。 一边突进，一边从身体的圆环出射出无数的蓝色光束。 光束会自动追踪敌人。
description.en: Shadowbeak's exclusive skill. As it charges forward, emits countless blue rays that automatically locate and pursue the enemy.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 于癫狂尽头诞生的禁忌之存在。 它已与其他帕鲁毫无任何基因上的关联， 可能其存在早已脱离了帕鲁的范畴。
description.en:
Born from the depths of insanity, its very existence defies reason.
Having lost all genetic ties to other Pals, one wonders if it could still even be considered a Pal.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 骑乘期间的暗属性攻击将提升(15~30)%。 且飞行时移动速度会提升。
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, Movement Speed is increased. Enhances Dark attacks by (15~30)% while mounted.

description.zh: 将带有黑暗力量的高速能量弹射向敌人。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with dark energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 使用暗之力连续发射数支高速箭追击敌人。
description.en: Fires off dark energy that homes in on an enemy.

description.zh: 扇形发射锋利的气刃。
description.en: Sends out sharp blades of air in a fan shape.

description.zh: 召唤陨石垂直落下， 并在撞击点产生冲击波。
description.en: Drops a meteorite straight down, generating a shock wave around the impact area.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 辉月伊的专用技能。 挥出蕴含月光力量的高速二连斩击。
description.en: Selyne's exclusive skill. Fires two consecutive high-speed blades imbued with the power of moonlight.

description.zh: 在敌人周围生成一碰就爆炸的星星。 星星在经过一定时间后，没有触碰也会爆炸。
description.en: Generates stars around the enemy that explode on contact. Stars also explode after some time.

description.zh: 辉月伊的专用技能。 将能量积蓄于背后的月亮， 然后向前方发出新月形的射线。
description.en: Selyne's exclusive skill. Stores energy in the moon on its back, then fires a crescent-shaped beam forward.

description.zh: 辉月伊的专用技能。 挥出蕴含月光力量的高速三连斩击。
description.en: Selyne's exclusive skill. Fires three consecutive high-speed slashes imbued with the power of moonlight.

description.zh: 据传，其身后漂浮的形似新月的物体， 会随着世代的交替一点点的接近圆形。 至于到满月月相时会发生什么，就没有人知道了。
description.en: The object floating behind, resembling the moon, is said to gradually become more circular with each passing generation. No one knows what will happen when the moon is full.

description.zh: 可坐在它背后的月亮在空中飞行。 骑乘期间的无属性和暗属性攻击将强化(15~30)%。
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, enhances Neutral and Dark attacks by (15~30)%.

description.zh: 将岩石从眼前的地上吸附起来 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的冰刃。
description.en: Summons a sharp ice lance under an enemy.

description.zh: 朝敌人喷出冰冷空气， 持续对目标造成伤害。
description.en: Enshrouds an enemy in a frigid blast of air, dealing continuous damage.

description.zh: 霜牙王的专用技能。 踩踏地面，在前方产生断裂的冰川。 之后一口气接近敌人，用右手将其撕裂。
description.en: Bastigor's exclusive skill. Stomps the ground, creating a fissure of ice ahead. Then, rapidly closes the distance and slashes with the right hand.

description.zh: 撼动地面， 使大块岩石射向四面八方
description.en: Causes the ground to shake before hurling a massive stone mass at its surroundings.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 在敌人头顶生无数个冰块， 随后接连落下攻击目标。
description.en: Creates numerous lumps of ice that are consecutively dropped on a foe's head.

description.zh: 霜牙王的专用技能。 大声咆哮的同时高高跳起， 落地后将双臂埋入地面，产生巨大的龟裂冰川。 之后不断向地面积蓄力量，最终引发巨大的冰属性爆炸。
description.en: Bastigor's exclusive skill. Let out a mighty roar and leap into the air. Then, embed both arms into the ground to create a massive ice crack. Continue to channel power into the ground, ultimately causing a large explosion of ice energy

description.zh: 做出两个巨大的冰块， 瞄准敌人先后发射。 撞击后对周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates two huge ice blocks and fires them at the enemy one after another. On impact, it also shocks those close by.

description.zh: 一旦看见了圆形的物体，就不自觉的想要来上一拳。 对于霜牙王来说，仅次于生存的难题 就是完成堆雪人。
description.en: The sight of anything round gives it an uncontrollable urge to punch it. For Bastigor the toughest challenge, after simply living, is making a snowman.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上移动。 骑乘期间它还能挥下冰属性的大锤进行攻击。
description.en: Can be ridden. While mounted, delivers crushing blows with a hammer forged from Ice.

description.zh: 发射水弹 笔直飞向对方。
description.en: Hurls a ball of water straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 生成酸性云朵 在敌人头上下酸雨。
description.en: Creates acidic clouds that pour down acid rain on enemies.

description.zh: 召唤陨石垂直落下， 并在撞击点产生冲击波。
description.en: Drops a meteorite straight down, generating a shock wave around the impact area.

description.zh: 向敌人的位置发射充满龙属性的能量弹。 能量弹在着弹时将向周围扩散，在前方广范围引发爆炸。
description.en: Fires an energy bullet imbued with dragon power at the enemy's location. Upon impact, the bullet shatters and creates a frontal long-range explosion.

description.zh: 霄龙的专用技能。 周身缠绕水流，笔直地向前猛冲。
description.en: Shaolong's exclusive skill. Cloaks the body in water and charges straight forward.

description.zh: 霄龙的专用技能。 喷吐龙属性烈焰横扫四方， 将周围尽数化为焦土。
description.en: Shaolong's exclusive skill. Breathes Dragon-elemental flames in a sweeping motion, scorching the surrounding area.

description.zh: 霄龙的专用技能。 召唤直冲天际的巨大漩涡。 吞噬周围的敌人，将其一网打尽。
description.en: Shaolong's exclusive skill. Summons a massive vortex reaching into the heavens. The vortex draws in and eliminates all surrounding enemies at once.

description.zh: 召唤无数陨石落下， 并在撞击点产生冲击波。
description.en: Drops countless meteorites, generating an array of shock waves.

description.zh: 灵环寄吾心，长相伴君身。 悠悠青天鉴，袅袅霄龙吟。
description.en: Its ring is reserved for a special occasion: upon meeting its destined companion, the rings are traded, a symbol of their eternal partnership.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 霄龙的攻击力，会随着队伍中其他龙属性帕鲁的数量提升，每只增加(4~8)%。
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal's Attack increases by (4~8)% for each other Dragon Pal in your party.

description.zh: 扇形发射锋利的气刃。
description.en: Sends out sharp blades of air in a fan shape.

description.zh: 发射风刃， 在击中敌人或树木时反弹并连续造成攻击， 最多可反弹4次。
description.en: Launches a blade of wind that rebounds off enemies or trees, striking repeatedly. Can ricochet up to four times.

description.zh: 生成巨大的冰块 瞄准敌人后高速发射。 中弹时，可同时给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Creates a giant lump of ice and hurls it at an enemy. It deals damage to those in the surrounding area upon impact.

description.zh: 在敌人前方生成风刃， 并对其发动十字斩击。
description.en: Conjures blades of wind in front of the enemy, converging to deliver a cutting cross attack.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 暮尘蛾的专用技能。 发射追踪敌人的巨大孢子。 命中后爆炸，造成大范围爆炸冲击波。
description.en: Silvance's exclusive skill. Fires a massive tracking spore that pursues enemies. It explodes on impact, releasing a wide-area blast.

description.zh: 暮尘蛾的专用技能。 大范围散布爆炸孢子， 并在一定时间后同时引爆。
description.en: Silvance's exclusive skill. Scatters explosive spores over a wide area, then triggers a mass explosion after a set period of time.

description.zh: 其自古时起便静静伫立在“世界树”旁，一直守护着什么。 现今Mothmon已然不知道要守护什么，又为什么要守护了。 毕竟，“世界树”会给予指引。 毕竟，被操纵的孢子们，也理应知晓敌人是谁。
description.en: Since ancient times, it has remained within the World Tree, continuing its vigil. What it protects, and for what purpose, Silvance does not know. After all, the World Tree will tell it everything. The spores it commands surely know who the enemy is.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家的攻击击中缠绕状态的敌人时，会使敌人爆炸，额外造成相当于玩家攻击力(40~60)%的伤害。（不可叠加） 另外，能让玩家与帕鲁不受世界树的爆炸孢子影响。 levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Ivy-Covered, the enemy explodes, dealing additional damage equal to (40~60)% of the player's attack damage. (Does not stack) Also grants immunity to the World Tree's Explosive Spores to both the player and their Pals. levelvalue1

description.zh: 将带有黑暗力量的高速能量弹射向敌人。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with dark energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 在敌人的位置和其周围刺出尖锐的根刺。
description.en: Sprouts sharp roots in and around the enemy's location.

description.zh: 积蓄黑暗之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges dark energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 夜蔓爵的专用技能。 喷吐腐蚀雾的同时贴地滑行突进。 雾气会在原地残留一段时间。
description.en: Dandilord's exclusive skill. Charges forward while sliding along the ground, spraying corrosive mist. The mist remains in the area for a limited time.

description.zh: 夜蔓爵的专用技能。 舞动的同时喷射腐蚀雾。 雾气会在原地残留一段时间。
description.en: Dandilord's exclusive skill. Performs a dance while releasing corrosive mist. The mist remains in the area for a limited time.

description.zh: 其自古时起便静静伫立在“世界树”旁，一直守护着什么。 现今夜蔓爵已经看不到要守护什么，又为什么要守护了。 毕竟，“世界树”知晓一切。 毕竟，唯有它操纵的浓雾能揭露那片真相。
description.en: Since ancient times, it has remained within the World Tree, continuing its vigil. What it protects, and for what purpose, Dandilord does not care. After all, the World Tree knows everything. Only the mist it wields can reveal the truth.

description.zh: 发动后，为玩家的攻击附加(2~6)点中毒异常状态值。（不可叠加） 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁不会陷入中毒状态，并且不受世界树区域的毒气影响。 Lv.Skill1
description.en: When activated, the player's attacks increase Poison buildup by (2~6). While in party, grants the player and party Pals immunity to Poison, and nullifies the effects of toxic gas in the World Tree area. (Does not stack) Lv.Skill1

description.zh: 将带有黑暗力量的高速能量弹射向敌人。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with dark energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的高速暗黑球。
description.en: Fires high-speed dark orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 使用暗之力连续发射数支高速箭追击敌人。
description.en: Fires off dark energy that homes in on an enemy.

description.zh: 发射3个怨念 并执着追击敌人。
description.en: Fires three balls of malice that relentlessly pursue an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 于敌人周围生成数个暗黑龙卷风。
description.en: Generates several dark vortexes around the enemy.

description.zh: 贝菈诺娃的专用技能。 趁敌人不注意时隐去身影，并在再次现身的瞬间射出无数光线。
description.en: Bellanoir's exclusive skill. Disappears suddenly, then reappears while firing a barrage of beams.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh: 不为实体存在的她，曾经只是静静的凝视着这个世界。 不知从何时开始，萌生出了被他人注视的渴望。 不断膨胀的欲望甚至凝聚成对外界的恶意 渐渐她被人们称作狂乱淑女。
description.en: Without existing, she quietly gazed upon the world. One day, she was seized with a longing to be seen. With unbridled lust for vengeance against reality, thus was born the Eclipsed Siren.

description.zh: 发动后会以噩梦射线攻击锁定的目标敌人。 此帕鲁使用的噩梦射线的威力将提升至(1.1~2.5)倍。 levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Nightmare Ray. When this Pal uses Nightmare Ray, it has a x(1.1~2.5) damage multiplier. levelvalue1

description.zh: 将带有黑暗力量的高速能量弹射向敌人。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with dark energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的高速暗黑球。
description.en: Fires high-speed dark orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 使用暗之力连续发射数支高速箭追击敌人。
description.en: Fires off dark energy that homes in on an enemy.

description.zh: 生成巨大的黑暗之球 瞄准敌人并高速发射。
description.en: Creates a giant ball of darkness and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 于敌人周围生成数个暗黑龙卷风。
description.en: Generates several dark vortexes around the enemy.

description.zh: 贝菈露洁的专用技能。 在摇曳起舞的同时製造一圈圈火焰， 使之向周围扩散， 并发射妖异的火球来追击敌人。
description.en: Bellanoir Libero's exclusive skill. With a graceful dance, conjuries expanding rings of fire, then unleashes eerie flames that seek the enemies.

description.zh: 贝菈露洁的专用技能。 趁敌人不注意时隐去身影，并在现身的瞬间射出无数光线， 且光线会犹如绽放的花朵般扩散。
description.en: Bellanoir Libero's exclusive skill. Disappears suddenly, then reappears while firing a barrage of beams. The beams spread like a beautiful flower in bloom.

description.zh: 发射多个可以追击敌人的黑暗之球。
description.en: Fires a menacing ball of dark energy that pursues enemies.

description.zh:
暗属性攻击伤害增加30%
冰属性攻击伤害增加30%
description.en:
30% increase in Dark attack damage.
30% increase in Ice attack damage.

description.zh: 被解放的欲望，终于再也无法抑制。 「『我』渴望得到『自我』的注视。」 凝聚为恶意的，渴望被注视的姐妹 终于被放逐回世界的狭缝，闭上了凝视的眼睛。
description.en: With her desires set loose, she was soon overwhelmed. She longed for a self to gaze upon herself. And the sisters who gazed, resenting reality, were driven into the abyss and, at last, closed their eyes.

description.zh: 发动后会以噩梦绽放攻击锁定的目标敌人。 此帕鲁使用的噩梦绽放的威力将提升至(1.1~2.5)倍。 levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Nightmare Bloom. When this Pal uses Nightmare Bloom, it has a x(1.1~2.5) damage multiplier. levelvalue1

description.zh: 用蕴藏龙之力的能量弹 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls an energy ball imbued with draconic energy at an enemy.

description.zh: 向前方发射呈扇形扩散的高速暗黑球。
description.en: Fires high-speed dark orbs in a fan shape, spreading as they travel.

description.zh: 杰诺多兰的专用技能。 召唤4个有自动攻击能力的卫星型羽毛。 羽毛在进行攻击时会自动追踪敌人。
description.en: Xenolord's exclusive skill. Generates four satellite-like wings with auto-attack functionality. These wings will automatically track and attack the enemy when the next attack is launched.

description.zh: 杰诺多兰的专用技能。 在右手生成高功率的光剑， 高速移动同时进行二连斩击。
description.en: Xenolord's exclusive skill. Generates a high-output beam sword with the right hand and delivers two powerful slashes while moving at high speed.

description.zh: 杰诺多兰的专用技能。 集中充盈暗黑力量的能量， 一口气以直线状放出。
description.en: Xenolord's exclusive skill. Concentrates energy filled with darkness and releases it all at once in a straight line.

description.zh: 杰诺多兰的专用技能。 以光速飞上高空，射出无数的流星弹。 之后将自身化为彗星向地面突进， 在撞击的地点引发大范围的爆炸。
description.en: Xenolord's exclusive skill. Soars into the air at the speed of light and releases countless meteor projectiles. Afterwards, transforms into a comet and charges forward, causing a massive explosion upon impact.

description.zh: 杰诺多兰的专用技能。 从亚空间呼唤毁灭的光束不断进行横向垂直扫射， 将视野范围内的一切燃烧殆尽。
description.en: Xenolord's exclusive skill. Summons the light of destruction from subspace and continuously fires it in all directions, burning everything in its sight to ashes.

description.zh: 召唤无数陨石落下， 并在撞击点产生冲击波。
description.en: Drops countless meteorites, generating an array of shock waves.

description.zh:

龙属性攻击伤害增加30%

30% increase in Dark attack damage.
30% increase in Dragon attack damage.

description.zh: - 已抵达目的地，优先搜索个体：流星龙。 - 备注：镇压完成时限 年前。 - 追记：未发现镇压痕迹，确认目标已被同化，开始清剿。 - 业务联络：不可以忘掉或吃掉重要情报！
description.en: -Destination reached. Priority: Locate entity |Supersonic Dragon| -Note: Conquest deadline exceeded by years. -Update: No conquest traces found. Naturalization confirmed. Commence elimination protocol. -Staff Memo: Refrain from forgetting or consuming critical data!

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 若它在队伍中，持有武器的帕鲁的伙伴技能伤害将提升(20~50)%。（不可叠加）
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, damage done by Partner Skills of weapon-wielding Pals increases by (20~50)%. (Does not stack)

description.zh: 积蓄能量， 并将其化作子弹射出。
description.en: Charges energy into a focused blast.

description.zh: 积蓄大量能量， 并将其化作巨大球体射出。

description.zh: 发射一个缓慢追踪敌人的光球。 光球在接近目标时会分裂成无数光弹攻击敌人。

Hartalis' exclusive skill. Leaps back and sprouts wings of light, then dives toward the enemy.

description.zh: 默世鹿的专用技能。 一瞬间隐去身姿，然后以自身为中心在大范围召唤大量光柱落下。
description.en: Hartalis' exclusive skill. Fades from sight, then calls down a massive barrage of light pillars centered on its position.

description.zh: 默世鹿的专用技能。 跃向空中，凝聚巨大的能量然后投向地面。 煌煌天光，涤净尘世。
description.en: Hartalis' exclusive skill. Leaps high into the air, condensing immense energy into a descending sphere of light. When it strikes the ground, it purifies all on the ground below.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh:
无属性攻击伤害增加30%
草属性攻击伤害增加30%

30% increase in Neutral attack damage.
30% increase in Grass attack damage.

description.zh: 于此幽寂之地，不觉心神凝定。 此处已无人，众人皆蒙救度。 救赎之王，请携我共赴无尽之寂。 ──古文书至此戛然而止。
description.en:
The silence is unsettling, yet strangely soothing.
No one else remains. All have been delivered.
O King of Salvation, carry me too into eternal stillness.
-The ancient text cuts off here.

After the sealing of the calamity, a champion from Feybreak emerged.
It stares out to sea, awaiting one it deems worthy.
For such encounters are no coincidence—they are fate.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 骑乘期间它还能用导弹发射器连续攻击。
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.

description.zh: 奥沧鲸的专用技能。 发射大量追踪泡泡。 泡泡着地后会停留在原地。 触碰或数秒后爆裂，对周围造成伤害。
description.en: Panthalus's exclusive skill. Fires a large cluster of homing bubbles that remain in place upon landing. Bubbles burst and deal damage upon contact or after several seconds.

description.zh: 奥沧鲸的专用技能。 在敌人周围生成大量泡泡，将其团团包围并发动攻击。
description.en: Panthalus's exclusive skill. Generates a multitude of bubbles around the enemy to surround and attack them.

description.zh: 奥沧鲸的专用技能。 释放锋利的水刃，对敌人进行攻击。
description.en: Panthalus's exclusive skill. Launches sharp water blades at enemies.

description.zh: 奥沧鲸的专用技能。 利用全身猛然撞击敌人，掀起波浪。
description.en: Panthalus's exclusive skill. Slams the body into the enemy, generating a massive wave on impact.

description.zh: 奥沧鲸的专用技能。 在敌人周围生成漩涡。 将敌人卷入并不断向中心收缩， 最终爆裂，掀起水柱。
description.en: Panthalus's exclusive skill. Creates a vortex around the enemy. The vortex pulls targets toward its center while shrinking, ending in a high-pressure water pillar explosion.

description.zh: 奥沧鲸的专用技能。 潜入水中，片刻后破水而出。 借鲸跃之势，在周围掀起扩散的波纹。
description.en: Panthalus's exclusive skill. Dives underwater and leaps out after a short delay. The momentum of the leap creates ripples that damage the surrounding area.

description.zh: 在敌人脚下和四周引发大范围的光柱爆炸。
description.en: Creates a wide explosion of light at the enemy's location and around it.

description.zh: 奥沧鲸的专用技能。 腾空而起，召唤多个巨型龙卷风。 龙卷风会缓慢追踪敌人。
description.en: Panthalus's exclusive skill. Soars into the sky and generates multiple massive tornadoes that slowly track enemies.

description.zh: 怀揣着使命一直等待着，种群中最后的幸存者。 即便履行了职责的它呼唤着母亲， 回应的，也已经只剩余音。
description.en:
The last of its species, keeping its sacred duty close to heart.
Even should its long obligation ever be fulfilled, its cries for its mother would only be answered by a solitary echo.

description.zh: 可骑在它的背上在空中飞行。 在据点最多只能召唤1只。 若它在据点里，会在据点上空持续盘旋，远程炮轰入侵据点的敌人。 levelvalue1
description.en: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Only 1 can be summoned to a base. While at a base, it constantly patrols the skies and bombards intruders from high above. levelvalue1

description.zh: 快速放电 给周围造成冲击。
description.en: Quickly discharges electricity, shocking those around it.

description.zh: 将岩石从眼前的地上吸附起来 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Digs up a boulder and hurls it at an enemy.

description.zh: 撼动地面， 使大块岩石射向四面八方
description.en: Causes the ground to shake before hurling a massive stone mass at its surroundings.

description.zh: 同时发射直线飞行的高速雷球， 和追踪敌人的慢速雷球。
description.en: A high-speed lightning ball that flies in a straight line. Simultaneously fires slow lightning balls that track the enemy.

description.zh: 在敌人的脚边 生成尖锐的岩石长矛。
description.en: Generates a sharp rock spear under an enemy.

description.zh: 生成复数个砂龙卷。 龙卷风们将一边自旋一边绕中心旋转。
description.en: Creates multiple sand tornadoes. The tornadoes continuously spin in circles.

description.zh: 电涡蜗及亚种的专用技能。 缩入壳中减伤并积蓄电能。 充满后释放电流，对周围敌人造成伤害。 放电后，短时间内自身雷属性技能攻击力提升。
description.en: Snock's exclusive skill. Withdraws into its shell to reduce damage taken while building electric charge. Once fully charged, it discharges, damaging nearby enemies. After discharging, the Attack of this Pal's Electric skills is increased for a limited time.

description.zh: 震动地面， 并令巨大的岩石飞起。
description.en: Shakes the ground and lifts a massive boulder into the air.

description.zh: 将滚烫的金涡蜗放进浴缸， 享受一场火热浴，这在遥远的古代曾经十分流行。 由于近年复古风潮兴起，它也再度成为了火热新趋势。
description.en: Tossing a heated Snock Terra into the bath for a scorching spa was once a fad of the distant past. Owing to a recent revival, it is now quite literally a hot trend.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁受到的水属性伤害减轻(15~30)%，并且不会陷入浸湿状态。（不可叠加） levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, player and party Pals take (15~30)% less Water damage, and are immune to Soak. (Does not stack) levelvalue1

description.zh: 发射超高速风刃 瞄准后笔直飞向敌人。
description.en: Fires a high speed blade of wind that flies straight at an enemy.

description.zh: 用黏糊糊的泥巴 瞄准敌人并发射。
description.en: Hurls sticky mud at an enemy.

description.zh: 释放大量坚硬的种子 攻击前方的敌人。
description.en: Fires a volley of hard seeds at enemies in front of it.

description.zh: 发射危险的种子。 碰到敌人会绽开并爆炸。
description.en: Launches a deadly seed. If it hits an enemy, the seed explodes.

description.zh: 扇形射出锐利的风刃。
description.en: Launches sharp blades of air that fan out.

description.zh: 在敌人的位置和其周围刺出尖锐的根刺。
description.en: Sprouts sharp roots in and around the enemy's location.

description.zh: 积蓄太阳之力 瞄准敌人发射强劲光线。
description.en: Charges solar energy before blasting enemies with a powerful beam.

description.zh: 以自身为中心掀起巨大的风暴漩涡， 发动强力攻击。
description.en: Summons a massive wind vortex around itself and unleashes a powerful attack.

description.zh: 这种帕鲁的脸上总是挂著微笑。 捣蛋猫偶尔会恶作剧，把它的缎带打成死结， 每到这时，它都会笑眯眯的把捣蛋猫暴揍一顿。
description.en: Always wears a cheerful smile. Sometimes, thanks to Cattiva's pranks, they end up tangled in tentacles and have to fight their way out! Even in tough situations, they keep smiling cheerfully.

description.zh: 若它在队伍中，玩家和帕鲁以草属性攻击克制的属性时伤害提升(25~40)%。（不可叠加） 艾小兔在武器制作台或武器工厂等处工作时，工作效率将会提升(200~400)%。 levelvalue1
description.en: While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals' Grass attacks when hitting the enemy's elemental weakness by (25~40)%. (Does not stack) Increases Ribbuny Botan's efficiency by (200~400)% when working at a Weapon Workbench, Weapon Assembly Line, or other related facilities. levelvalue1

description.zh: 于遥远过去降临于帕洛斯群岛，神秘的帕鲁迎来其终焉。 作为灾厄带来过无数毁灭，后被长久封印。 最终被某位帕鲁驯养师所击败。
description.en: A shadow of its former self, this mysterious Pal descended upon the Palpagos long ago. Bringing ruin and calamity, it was sealed away for millennia until it was ultimately defeated by a certain Pal Tamer

description.zh: 克苏鲁之眼的专用技能。 多次朝敌人发起冲锋。
description.en: Eye of Cthulhu's exclusive skill. Repeatedly charges at the enemy.

description.zh: 克苏鲁之眼的专用技能。 召唤4个仆从撞向敌人并造成伤害。仆从会在受到攻击或经过一定时间后消失。
description.en: Eye of Cthulhu's exclusive skill. Summons four Servants that charge at enemies to deal damage. Servants disappear after taking damage or after a short time.

description.zh: 克苏鲁之眼的专用技能。 多次朝敌人发起冲锋。
description.en: Eye of Cthulhu's exclusive skill. Repeatedly charges at the enemy.

description.en: Eye of Cthulhu's exclusive skill. Summons four Servants that charge at enemies to deal damage. Servants disappear after taking damage or after a short time.

description.en: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.

description.zh: 发动后，克苏鲁之眼会向前方突进并攻击锁定的敌人。 levelvalue1
description.en: When activated, Eye of Cthulhu charges and attacks targeted enemy. levelvalue1

description.zh: 恶魔眼的专用技能。 朝敌人发起冲锋。撞到地面或墙壁时会反弹。
description.en: Demon Eye's exclusive skill. Charges at the enemy, bouncing off the ground or walls on impact.
